articleTitle: Real Time Railway Security System using Sensor Network
abstract: In India, the means of transportation that is used the most often is the train system. It is also one of those forms of transportation that suffers a lot of obstacles due to human mistakes such as level cross accidents, accidents due to damaged track or obstruction either static or mobile and thefts on the trains. In addition, it is one of those modes of transport that faces a lot of challenges due to natural disasters. Therefore, there is a need to think about new technology which gives full-bodied, competent and stable solution to these problems. In this paper, an unmanned gate crossing system, a broken rail track and obstacle detection system and a theft detection system on trains have been proposed with the help of hardware, including microcontroller Arduino, infrared (IR) sensors, ultrasonic sensors and fingerprint sensor. The proposed system will solve all above mentioned problems.

articleTitle: Using Deep Learning and MobileNet50V2 CNN Model to Classify Chest X-Ray Images for Pneumonia Disease Detection
abstract: Pneumonia is a pathological condition characterised by the inflammation of the alveoli in either one or both lungs. Symptoms including productive cough, fever, chills, and dyspnea may develop when fluid or purulent material builds up within the air sacs. Many different kinds of organisms, such as bacteria, viruses, and fungi, may cause pneumonia. Pneumonia may range in intensity from quite mild to severe. The population groups most vulnerable to this condition are newborns and young children, those aged 65 and above, as well as those with underlying health conditions or compromised immune systems. This research focuses on the categorization of pneumonia sickness by using the MobileNet50V2 Model and exploiting chest X-ray images. The primary objective is to enhance the accuracy of the classification process. The use of artificial intelligence in the medical sector is seen as a significant and auspicious application. The research further proposes strategies to augment the current practises used by the medical community. It is important to consider that the development of a pneumonia classification model necessitates the integration of deep learning techniques, medical imaging expertise, and domain knowledge proficiency. In order to ensure the clinical validity and safety of the model, it is essential to engage in collaborative efforts with medical professionals.

articleTitle: Regressor Based Supermarket Sales Prediction Using Time Series Data
abstract: In a variety of problem domains, including sales, finance, healthcare, the stock market, etc., forecasting techniques are applied. The supermarket sales forecast aids in increasing sales in a professional setting. The method aids in problem-domain decision-making. Most supermarket chains estimate and evaluate sales for the following year using, at most, ad hoc techniques and technologies. Many issues remain unresolved as a result of using traditional statistical methods to anticipate grocery sales. Supermarkets are in need of accurate sales forecasts. Most supermarket chain stores, use informal strategies and methodologies to analyze and forecast sales. This is due to a lack of knowledge about optimizing the prediction result. In order to solve this problem, this study creates the most accurate model for forecasting product sales at the supermarket based on training and testing results. Three models are created in this study to forecast product sales in a supermarket. These models, which forecast product sales in supermarkets across branches, are trained using historical supermarket data collected in diverse places. It investigates and compares the three machine learning models—Random Forest, Decision Tree, and Linear Regression for forecasting supermarket sales. This makes it easier for supermarkets to forecast product sales and helps them turn a profit. To identify the most accurate model, the prediction errors are computed.

articleTitle: Plant Disease Detection Using Machine Learning
abstract: Agricultural productivity is the factor on which many countries' economies heavily rely on. Identifying plant diseases is extremely crucial in the agricultural sector as they can hamper the plant's robustness and health which is important in agricultural productivity. These obstacles are regular in plant production ,and if adequate procedures of prevention are not followed it may inversely affect the cultivation. Farmers are confronting financial loss due to various crop diseases. The traditional method of disease detection is achieved by the opinion of an expert and physical inspection, which takes much time and is expensive in the practical life. And when the cultivated area is big in acres, it becomes very tough for the cultivators to track the crops periodically. That's why an automated computer based disease detection system has become essential. The system developed in this project involves using image processing techniques such as opencv2 that are designed using python to segment the disease part from the leaf while using machine learning techniques like SVM and CNN to categorize the leaves of the plant as healthy or infected. For classification purposes, morphological characteristics and properties such as colour, strength and measurements of the plant leaves are taken into account.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Insights on EEG Signals for Seizures in Human Brain
abstract: Seizures can affect not only human brain but also the human body in many ways. Its detection and categorization is one tough task but thanks to modern technologies like Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (D L) tools this task is become easy and now the treatment has become faster than before. ML techniques like Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree, XGBoost, Random Forest classification will be used in this paper to compare the performance of the various ML algorithms so that we can quickly and efficiently detect the occurrence and categorise the seizure from the data which is live or recorded. ML has emerged as a powerful tool in the field of healthcare, particularly in the detection and prediction of neurological dis-orders. This paper explores the application of machine learning techniques to the analysis of Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals for the early detection of seizures in the human brain. Seizures, characterized by abnormal electrical activity in the brain, can have severe consequences if not detected and treated promptly. EEG signals provide valuable information about brain activity and are commonly used in the diagnosis of epilepsy and other seizure- related disorders. Machine learning algorithms, that are mentioned above have shown promise in automating the analysis of EEG data, enabling faster and more accurate seizure detection.

articleTitle: Agricultural Pests Classification Using Deep Convolutional Neural Networks and Transfer Learning
abstract: Pest image categorization, a novel method based on machine learning algorithms, is used to detect and categorise insects that cause damage to crops in the field of agroforestry. Systems that use a mix of image processing and machine learning to categorise pest pictures in fields may discover pests early, allowing for swift action to be taken to avert crop loss that are vulnerable. Classifying agricultural pests is difficult since there are so many different kinds of pests with such different behaviours and looks. The Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) we presented, when paired with Transfer Learning, have proven successful in a variety of picture classification applications, including those of agricultural pests. Therefore, the purpose of this project is to create an exchange-learning-based photo classification model capable of recognising insects from a dataset culled from Kaggle. Good classification performance was shown for recognising pests using our suggested EfficientNetV2 model, with an accuracy rate of 88%. We can easily measure the accuracy using different metrics like training and validation loss and accuracy graphs.

articleTitle: A Dynamic System for Classifying Bird Species Using the InceptionV3 Model
abstract: Bird categorization tasks have been employed with the deep convolutional neural network architecture known as InceptionV3. This approach has been presented to accomplish remarkably well in a variation of photo classification tasks, including recognizing numerous bird species. To extract features from input photos, the model combines convolutional layers, max-pooling layers, and inception modules. The input picture is then classified using these characteristics after being passed through fully linked layers. InceptionV3 has improved on datasets for bird classification, leading to great performance and accuracy in recognizing bird species. Wildlife protection, ecosystem management, nature conservation, and ornithology may benefit from the categorization of birds using InceptionV3.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis Using Telugu SentiWordNet
abstract: Sentiment analysis in dialects with few assets and territorial dialects has turned into another area in regular language handling lately. Scientists are more keen on sorting out how individuals feel in Indian dialects like Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Bengali, Malayalam, etc. Supposedly, no nitty-gritty work has been finished on Indian dialects so far in light of the fact that there aren't an adequate number of marked informational indexes. In this work, we recommended that Telugu SentiWordNet be utilized to break down the mindset of Telugu news words in two stages. In the first place, it recognizes the meaning of subjectivity, which is the way words are marked as abstract or goal. Since they have no profound worth, objective words are treated as though they have no close-to-home estimation. Then, Feeling Order was finished, where the abstract sentences were additionally arranged into good and pessimistic expressions. With the ongoing Telugu SentiWordNet, our recommended framework gets a predisposition grouping accuracy of 74% and a temperament characterization exactness of 83%.

articleTitle: Detection of Kidney Disease in X-Ray Images Using Machine Learning on MobileNetV3 CNN Model
abstract: Classifying kidney pictures or patient data according to various disease categories, such as stages of chronic kidney disease (CKD), PKD, kidney stones, renal tumours, and other kidney-related illnesses, is known as kidney disease classification. These circumstances may be automatically recognised and categorised by machine learning algorithms that have been trained on labelled datasets. Renal cell carcinoma (RCC), angiomyolipoma (AML), oncocytoma, and various kinds of benign and malignant tumours are only few of the tumours or lesions that are the primary focus of Kidney Disease Classification. Kidney tumours may be easier diagnosed and treated with the help of this categorization. Kidney transplant recipients who are suffering rejection of their donated kidneys might have their biopsy samples classified according to the Kidney Disease Classification system. Acute cellular rejection, acute antibody-mediated rejection, chronic rejection, and no rejection are all possible categories. Social research in this field helps enhance quality of life by allowing the creation of new characteristics or feature combinations that may increase categorization accuracy. Creating a deep learning-based X-ray classifier that can detect renal disease is important to this study's overarching goal of better patient care. Classification tests showed that our MobileNetV3 model was <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$97{{\% }}$</tex> accurate in detecting renal illness.

articleTitle: Pcos Prediction: Advancements in Medical Informatics Using Artificial Intelligence
abstract: A hormonal condition known as a polycystic ovarian syndrome (PCOS) affects around 1 in 10 persons throughout their reproductive years. Weight gain, ovarian cysts, and irregular menstruation periods are all signs of PCOS. A hormone called androgens, which may cause excessive facial hair, acne, and other cosmetic changes, is linked to the disorder via elevated amounts. In addition to higher risks for miscarriage. According to a research paper from the overall population of India, 11.8% of women are not diagnosed with PCOS and 22.7% of women are suffering from PCOS.PCOS may be accurately predicted and early identified, which can considerably improve patient outcomes and enable appropriate therapies. This study examines the use of multinomial logistic regression analysis to forecast the development of PCOS based on pertinent clinical and demographic data. An online survey was conducted to collect the data for the research. About 73.2% of women who participated in the survey said they had never tested or PCOS. The trained model had an accuracy of 82%. The mean crossvalidation for the model is 0.75%. A confusion matrix was used to assess the proposed model's classification performance. The PCOD/PCOS categorization problem's anticipated and actual classes were shown in a matrix. All 22 samples were accurately categorized into class 1 (PCOD/PCOS present), demonstrating the model's strong predictive accuracy. Twenty of the twenty samples for class 3 (missing PCOD/PCOS) were correctly categorized. Class 0 (misclassified as PCOD/PCOS missing) had two misclassifications from class 1 and one correct prediction. Finally, the classification of all four samples from class 4 (PCOD/PCOS type 5) was correct. These findings emphasize the model's potential l for clinical use by showing how well it can predict the likelihood of PCOD/PCOS.

articleTitle: ResNet-50 Transfer Learning Model for Diabetic Foot Ulcer Detection Using Thermal Images
abstract: Diabetic Foot Ulcer (DFU) is a major global healthcare challenge, entailing substantial costs and increased mortality rates. The aim of this work is to develop a ResNet-50 transfer learning model for DFU detection using thermal images. The ResNet-50 transfer learning model is fine-tuned to adapt its pre-trained features to DFU detection, yielding improved accuracy and dataset generalisation. The developed model achieves 90.52% accuracy, 92.06% precision, 96.97% AUC, and 92.06% recall, showing significant performance gains. Furthermore, a 7% increase in accuracy is observed in comparison to the previous state-of-the-art. This work presents substantial enhancements in DFU detection accuracy, highlighting the potential of deep learning and data augmentation in medical image analysis. The developed model's improved performance underscores its relevance for clinical applications, suggesting its potential to enhance patient care and outcomes.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Methods for Signature Verification
abstract: In the contemporary digital landscape, individuals are increasingly utilizing online services with remarkable ease. Deep learning technology has become indispensable in applications where precision and efficiency are paramount. Among these, handwritten signature verification is a pivotal application demanding exceptional accuracy. This paper compares different deep-learning techniques applied to signature verification to ascertain an individual's authorization status. We explore various methodologies, including CNN, LSTM, Google Net, and Mobile Net, to discern the authenticity of the signature and confirm the individual's identity. Our proposed method demonstrates promising results in improving the security of digital transactions and identity verification processes.

articleTitle: Early Detection of Pneumothorax Using EfficientNet B0 Transfer Learning Model
abstract: Pneumothorax is a condition which requires immediate care. It is a commonly encountered state that experienced radiologists and clinicians in diverse clinical specialties may evaluate and diagnose using chest radiographs. It has been observed to have an impact on mortality rates. In the biomedical industry, the early detection of pneumothorax is required for better treatment of patients. This research paper proposes a DL neural network model to identify region of pneumothorax in chest radiographs. In this research work EfficientNet B0, a transfer learning model, has been implemented for the early analysis of pneumothorax in chest radiographs. The dataset consists of 1403 X-ray images divided into train, test, and validation, with 1200 training images, 102 test images, and 101 validation images. The batch size of the model was set to 32, and it has been trained 25 epochs altogether. A learning rate of 0.001 was used. The model has been evaluated regarding performance parameters such as precision, recall, accuracy, and F1-score. The model achieved an accuracy rate of 83%. This automatic method for early detection of pneumothorax can assist the radiologist in better treatment planning.

articleTitle: Intelligent Transformation of Lab Based on OpenHarmony
abstract: With the continuous development of information technology and artificial intelligence technology, low-cost information technology and artificial intelligence technology can be used to rapidly develop a set of systems to transform computer rooms and multimedia classrooms in colleges and universities, improve the efficiency of management, use and maintenance of instruments and equipment, and ensure the timeliness, accuracy and scientific nature of data. And based on deep learning and other technologies, the teachers' class situation and equipment use situation are predicted, so that multimedia classrooms and computer laboratories in colleges and universities can better play the role of scientific research and talent training platforms.

articleTitle: Assessing the Impact of Multipath Propagation on Electromagnetic Compatibility of Network Nodes
abstract: this paper aims to assess the impact of multipath propagation on electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) of community nodes, such as an analysis of the layout issues and radiation characteristics of the device. A multipath propagation-based version for evaluating the radiated emission from devices in a community environment is also hooked up. This model is then used to calculate the radiation disturbance potential (RDP) as a metric to compare the impact of various kinds of propagation on EMC. The effects display that a larger quantity of multipath can bring about a reduction or even removal of the EMC problem through lowering the RDP. The examination additionally highlights the significance of considering multipath propagation while designing the EMC of community notes to ensure the most advantageous performance. This paper evaluates the impact of multipath propagation on the Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) of community nodes. A model-based analysis of the impact of multipath propagation at the EMC of Wi-Fi and wired nodes is provided. It consists of a theoretical analysis of multipath propagation, accompanied by a simulation to quantify its results on community nodes. Moreover, this paper provides techniques to enhance the areas of multipath EMC, such as receiver designs, antenna structures, and multipath mitigation algorithms. Sooner or later, experiments are carried out to measure the propagation traits in actual-global surroundings to determine the impact of multipath at the EMC of networks…

articleTitle: Elevating Bengali Speech Recognition with Phonological Harmony
abstract: This paper introduces a novel avenue for advancing speech recognition accuracy by integrating phonological features. Despite remarkable progress, speech recognition systems encounter challenges with varying accents and speech patterns. This study proposes an innovative approach incorporating phonological attributes like stress patterns, phoneme duration, and intonation into the recognition process. The system aims to capture intricate speech nuances essential for precise understanding by assimilating these linguistic cues. Extensive experiments conducted on diverse datasets demonstrate the efficacy of this phonology-enriched approach in enhancing recognition accuracy across different speech styles and variations. The outcomes underscore the potential of phonological integration in constructing adaptable and inclusive speech recognition systems, holding promise for improved communication technology in real-world multilingual scenarios. The proposed system achieved 86.19% of overall accuracy. Classification task among several places and manner of articulation has been performed also. In this classification task, the system produced 98.9 % accuracy in the case of the manner of articulation and 50.2 % in place of articulation.

articleTitle: Detection & Diagnosis of COVID-19 from CXR Images Through VGG19 Transfer Learning Model
abstract: COVID-19 must be diagnosed rapidly and precisely to control the current pandemic effectively. Using a dataset of 21,165 chest X-ray images, this study suggests a transfer learning approach for identifying and stratification of COVID-19. Three subsets of the dataset—training, validation, and test—each including 16,932, 2,116, and 2,117 images—are created. The VGG19 transfer learning model uses deep learning approaches to extract pertinent image characteristics and accurately classify the input images. By reaching a high accuracy rate, the key objective of this study is to distinguish COVID-19-infected patients from others with distinct lungrelated abnormalities. The model successfully classifies images with an incredible 94.85% accuracy, highlighting its potential for biomedical applications in the real world. The model's robustness and generalizability are aided by the extensive and varied dataset, which includes four annotated classes. The VGG19 model has much to offer regarding healthcare advantages if successfully implemented. The speed and accuracy of diagnosis can be improved by automatically identifying and classifying COVID-19 instances from chest Xray images, allowing for quicker patient triage and resource allocation. Additionally, it can lighten the load on radiologists and health workers and promote efficient management tactics throughout the pandemic. This study emphasizes the potential of models based on deep learning for COVID-19 identification in digital image processing. Future studies should improve the model's effectiveness, determine if it can be used in various groups, and include more clinical data for thorough research. In the continuing COVID-19 pandemic, the proposed model may help medical practitioners identify patients more quickly and accurately, leading to better patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Examining the Promise of Big Data for Business Intelligence and Knowledge Discovery
abstract: Massive statistics can transform how businesses make decisions, tune overall performance, and gain precious insights into their operations or products. This paper outlines the modern kingdom using extensive statistics for commercial enterprise intelligence and knowledge discovery. It establishes the key challenges and possibilities associated with this generation, which includes its ability to boost efficiency, scalability, and accuracy, impact organizational shape and operations, and force new commercial enterprise models. Additionally, the paper explores the opportunities for statistics-pushed decision-making and deep analysis and identifies the primary demanding situations for successfully adopting big data analytics. It examines diverse techniques to attain the most fee from those answers and outlines critical concerns for organizations considering implementing massive facts-driven strategies. This paper aims to offer more information on the position and ability of huge news for business intelligence and understanding discovery. It also aims to help manual companies with their decision-making and investments.

articleTitle: Defected Ground Structure (DGS)-Based Koch Fractal Antenna for S and C-Band Applications
abstract: This paper presents a Koch fractal monopole antenna, which resonates at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2\text{GHz}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3.44\text{GHz}$</tex> with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${S_{11}}$</tex> values of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$ - 20.42\text{dB}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$ - 40.83\text{dB}$</tex> respectively. The radiator is miniaturized by using the fractal technique, and wideband is achieved with the help of the Defected ground structure technique. To achieve impedance matching, a microstrip feedline is considered. FR4 substrate having a permittivity of 4.4 is considered for the design. Overall, the dimensions of the proposed design are restricted to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$58{\mathrm{\;mm\;}} \times {{\;}}38{{\;mm\;}} \times {{\;}}1.6{{\;mm}}$</tex>. This radiator covers the frequency range from <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.76\text{GHz}$</tex> to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$4.29\text{GHz}$</tex> with an impedance bandwidth of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$83.58{{\% }}$</tex>. This monopole exhibits a VSWR of 1.02. In the operational frequency range, the proposed structure maintains a positive gain with a peak gain of 4.06 at 4.19 GHz. Hence, the proposed antenna can be a suitable candidate for <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{S}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{C}$</tex> band applications.

articleTitle: Path Planning of Loading and Unloading Robots Based on Optimal Energy Consumption
abstract: Aiming at the automatic loading and unloading system of turning processing robot, SolidWorks software is used to create a three-dimensional model, and smart components are used to create robot fixtures, feeding systems, and unloading systems in Robotstudio software, and the robot working space is obtained. A greedy RRT robot path planning algorithm is proposed, which realises the optimal energy consumption by simulating and combining the analysis of robot walking speed, energy consumption, running time and stability. This study can provide a reference for the production debugging of loading and unloading robots, which is of great significance for improving the production efficiency and reducing the energy consumption of enterprises.

articleTitle: A Safer Web Experience: Deep Learning-Enhanced Obscene Content Filtering Plugin
abstract: Our lives have benefited greatly from the internet's rapid development, but it has also presented new challenges. Obscene content and advertising on websites is one such issue that users find highly offensive and upsetting. The language or imagery used in the content, as well as any graphic or personal values, may be explicit. When obscene content is readily available, it can pose a major risk to youngsters who are unaware of it, negatively affecting their development. Pictures, videos, or words that are inappropriate for minors' emotional development may be found in this type of content. Users are distressed when obscene content is present on web pages, which has a detrimental effect on their online experience. Users may mistakenly click on obscene adverts or other content that directs them to dangerous websites, endangering their safety and online security. Our study report suggests a novel solution—installing a web plugin or extension in the web browser—to address this crucial issue. This plugin will examine or scan the webpage's elements and advertisements. It will be able to tell the difference between NSFW (Not Safe For Work) and non-NSFW content and use a blocking mechanism to obfuscate the NSFW or offensive material.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Early Detection of Child Depression: A Data-Driven Approach
abstract: Children face trauma due to numerous factors such as parental fights, bullied in school, being below average student, racist comments, physical abuse etc. This trauma deteriorates the child's mental health and may lead to depression as well. Medical field is immensely dedicated to combat the depression among children and one of such approaches adapted includes the use Machine Learning models to predict child depression. This research work is focusing on seven different machine learning algorithms, including SVM Poly, K-Nearest Neighbor, SVM RBF, SVM Linear, Decision Tree, Gradient Boosting, Random Forest and Logistic Regression. This research examines the performance of these algorithms in detecting depressive symptoms in a child and adolescent population. In accordance with the outcomes of the research, SVM Linear algorithm emerged as the most accurate method, with an excellent accuracy rate of 95.54%. This algorithm demonstrated higher sensitivity in detecting depression symptoms in children and teens opening the possibility to prompt intervention and assistance.

articleTitle: Reliability Performance Evaluation of Solar Inverter Considering Monofacial and Bifacial Solar Panels
abstract: Bifacial solar panels are a recent advancement in the field of photovoltaics. The power generated by bifacial photovoltaic modules is from both their sides. Compared to monofacial solar panels, which are usually opaque back sheets, bifacial modules expose the backside and front of the solar panels. Compared to traditional solar panels, bifacial modules are more efficient and provide a higher total energy output. They are also more durable due to their dual sides' UV resistance. In addition, having a smaller footprint allows them to produce more power, which lowers the BOS costs. Furthermore, the reliability performance of the solar inverter is of major concern. Solar inverter is the unreliable component in the solar PV system. Hence in this paper reliability-oriented performance evaluation of solar inverter is proposed. A test case of 3 kW solar PV inverter system is considered. One-year mission profile is logged at Hyderabad for evaluation. The test case is implemented in PLECS Simulink platform. B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf> lifetime is calculated. Finally, comparison analysis is presented between monofaical and bifacial panels. From the results it is observed that the bifacial panels impact the reliability performance of solar inverter significantly.

articleTitle: Bi-Directional Long Short-Term Memory Network (BiDLSTM) Model Based Air Pollution Prediction
abstract: Air pollution is a serious problem over the globe. It could put human life in peril by bringing on illness and occasionally even death. The purpose of air quality forecasting is to provide early warnings and minimize the consequences of air pollution. An important gauge of air quality is the concentration of small particulate matter (PM2.5), which are inhalable particles with a diameter of around 2.5 micrometers. These particles pose major health risks because they can deeply penetrate the lungs. This research investigates precise prediction of PM2.5, which may help to mitigate detrimental outcomes. Authors have proposed stacked bi-directional long short-term memory (BiDLSTM) model for forecasting. This will capture complicated temporal correlations in air quality data, this cutting-edge model makes use of LSTM neural networks' bidirectional sequence processing capabilities. The BiDLSTM model can make extremely precise forecasts about the amount of pollution in the future by examining historical air quality measurements taken in various directions in time. In this paper, air quality dataset of India is used for model performance evaluation. Along with this, LSTM model is used for comparison purpose. Different evaluation parameters like average absolute deviation, root mean square deviation and determination coefficient are calculated to quantify the model's performance. The evaluation findings suggest that BiDLSTM model performs excellently.

articleTitle: Room issue reporting system in buildings using LabVIEW
abstract: This project presents a Room Issue Reporting System utilizing LabVIEW, myDAQ, and the TCP protocol to enhance building maintenance efficiency. The system integrates sensors for temperature, humidity, motion, and gas to monitor room conditions, automatically detecting and reporting maintenance issues in real-time. Secure communication between client and server VIs ensures prompt issue reporting and prioritization based on severity. Prototype testing confirms high reliability, accurate issue categorization, and quick response times. This project aims to provide user friendly and seamless experience with LabVIEW interface.

articleTitle: Hybrid Metaheuristic Based Resource Allocation Approach in SDN-Based Edge Computing Environment
abstract: The demand for an effective controller to guarantee optimal resource utilisation in edge computing (EC) has increased due to the exponential growth of the Internet use and the dispersed nature of computing resources in edge devices. In this study, we focus on one particular aspect of edge computing: the issue of allocating resources, to minimize time delays while conserving the battery power of user devices. For this purpose, we introduced a novel hybrid metaheuristic specifically designed to optimize total time and energy consumption in a hybrid cloud computing environment. The proposed algorithm leverages the strengths of both Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Grey Wolf Optimization (GWO) techniques. To evaluate the effectiveness of our approach, we conducted a comprehensive comparison between the Hybrid PSO-GWO, PSO, and GWO methods. Through simulations and experiments, we examined their performance in terms of time delays and energy consumption. The results demonstrate that the Hybrid PSO-GWO algorithm outperforms both PSO and GWO, proving its efficacy in achieving more efficient and effective resource allocation in wireless edge computing scenarios.

articleTitle: An Automated Approach for Detection and Classification of Plant Diseases
abstract: Plants, including many different foods, from grains to fruits and vegetables, are vital sources of nutrition and essential parts of numerous economies and ecosystems. This project uses the PlantVillage dataset to address automated plant disease identification demand. Using transfer learning, we proposed the EfficientNet B1 model, which has demonstrated encouraging outcomes in earlier studies. The dataset included 20,639 photos that were divided into 15 different classifications. The model was executed using the default learning rate across 40 epochs with a batch size 40. The results of this study show that the EfficientNet B1 model we suggested worked remarkably well, with a 99% accuracy rate. This result emphasizes how well the model can classify plant illnesses, which could be helpful for farmers and other agriculture specialists. Early disease identification made possible by this technology can promote food security and sustainable agriculture. The results of this study have possibilities for the agricultural industry, as quick and accurate disease detection can reduce crop loss and increase productivity. It also emphasizes how advanced deep learning techniques can be used in practical applications.

articleTitle: Responsive Portfolio Website Using React
abstract: The way people use the Internet has changed significantly with the introduction of third-generation cell phones. Nowadays, websites can be read on a variety of devices of different types and sizes. Since the website should be similarly helpful regardless of the type of device used to view it, this place demands on website design. Responsive web design makes it possible to adjust the visual presentation of web pages depending on the device they are accessed with. Although it is a commonly used tool in web development, it has not been fully explored in technical, aesthetic, and practical terms. To this end, standard definitions for this technique were compiled, and a responsive product was implemented in a paper. A fully responsive portfolio website was created by implementing meta tags and scalable components. The process of creating the product made it possible to understand the possibilities and limitations of flexible web design.

articleTitle: Alleviation of Power Loss and Voltage Drop by Integrating Capacitor and PV Systems in Radial Distribution Network: An Impact Analysis
abstract: Power losses and significant voltage drops can be reduced by integrating shunt capacitors into Radial Distribution Networks (RDN). Furthermore, because Solar Photovoltaic (SPV) power penetration offers a competitive alternative to fossil fuel power plants in the existing decontrolled electricity system, it also contributes to lowering distribution losses, enhancing distributor voltage profile, reducing substation load, etc. However, growing SPV penetration causes issues concerning protection, reverse power flow, voltage rises, etc. PV systems and capacitors should be distributed appropriately to reap the benefits, such as a superior voltage profile and lower power losses. The purpose of the paper is to look into the impact of shunt capacitors and SPV penetration. In order to calculate voltage variation and power loss for a radial distribution network, load flow analysis is done both with and without SPV and shunt capacitor penetration simultaneously. For the sake of analysis, various cases have been taken into consideration. The findings showed that for voltage profile and low power loss parameters, distributed SPV with the shunt capacitor injection excelled concentrated SPV penetration.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Performance Prediction Models for Test Cricketers: A Data-Driven Approach
abstract: A potential strategy in the sports sector is to forecast of players' test cricket efficiency using ML methods. The opponent team, the field, the player's current form, etc. All have an impact on how well the players perform. Each batsman assists by scoring as many runs as they can, every bowler serves by taking the most wickets and allowing the fewest runs to be scored, and each all-rounder serves by scoring the most runs and taking the most wickets. The topic of this paper aims to anticipate player performance, especially the number of runs each batter will score, the number of wickets each bowler will take, and the usefulness of an all-rounder. The categorization concerns in each of the three departments, where variations for the number of runs and wickets vary, are meant to be resolved. This abstract gives a summary of the techniques of ML in predicting player performance, highlighting the methodologies, datasets, and benefits associated with this data-driven approach. By leveraging historical performance data of players and their attributes, machine learning models learn patterns and relationships to generate accurate predictions. We have used “orange” platform to create our prediction model in which we have used three different datasets of batsmen, bowlers and allrounders respectively. To create a prediction model for each of the three departments, we employed naive bayes, random forest, KNN, and tree models. For all three departments, the approach with the greatest accuracy was found to be the random forest algorithm with more than 96 percent of classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Security of Encryption Protocols Used in Information Security Models for Networked Applications
abstract: This paper explores the safety of encryption protocols used in data safety models for networked programs. Whilst encryption protocols are designed to shield records from disclosure or manipulation, their protection may be compromised through a variety of assault vectors which includes password cracking or human errors. The paper discusses diverse assault vectors and evaluates answers to enhance the safety of encryption protocols. Additionally, the paper examines diverse encryption protocols utilized in statistics protection models, and explores their strengths and weaknesses. In the end, the paper examines the challenges related to making sure the security of encryption protocols, and provides suggestions for enhancing the safety of records transmission…

articleTitle: Review Paper on Speech Emotion Recognition
abstract: Emotion recognition plays a pivotal role in both the fields of Artificial Intelligence and the Internet of Things. Its significance spans various sectors, including humancomputer interaction, robotics, healthcare, biometric security, and behavioral analysis. Emotion recognition systems are designed to interpret emotional states from a diverse range of input sources. These sources include facial expressions, textual information, bodily gestures, vocal nuances, and even signals from neural and cardiovascular activities. This process not only covers basic emotions but also extends to encompass attitudes, emotional regulation, and the effectiveness of emotional activation for sentiment analysis. This research aims to identify a range of supervised and unsupervised machinelearning approaches tailored for both extracting distinctive features and accurately classifying emotions. Furthermore, it undertakes a comprehensive comparative evaluation of diverse machine-learning algorithms, as evidenced in existing literature. The paper illuminates the far-reaching potential and applications of automatic emotion recognition systems across an assortment of sectors. Additionally, it engages in a discourse concerning diverse parameters that contribute to bolstering the precision, security, and efficacy of such systems.

articleTitle: Classification of Satellite Images and Predicting Field Areas after Fine- Tuning Using Sequential CNN Model
abstract: The categorization of satellite images is a discipline within the domains of remote sensing and computer vision. It is the process of assigning pixels or areas within satellite imagery to predetermined classifications or categories related to land cover or land use. The aforementioned procedure is of utmost importance in the extraction of meaningful information from international Earth observation data for the research development. The categorization of satellite images is dependent upon the use of data obtained from Earth-observing satellites. The satellites in question are designed to acquire electromagnetic radiation, including various wavelengths such as visible, infrared, and microwave, which is either reflected or emitted by the Earth's surface. Multispectral or hyperspectral sensors provide the acquisition of pictures including several spectral bands, hence enabling the retrieval of intricate data pertaining to the Earth's surface. The present research employs a suggested Sequential Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model to classify the Satellite Image. The graphics processing unit (GPU) is used for the purpose of doing data pre-processing. The Deep Learning model is then visualised via a study of the Loss and Accuracy curves. The suggested model is used to forecast the geographical coverage in four distinct categories, namely cloudy, desert, green area, and water respectively which is essential for ecosystem management.

articleTitle: Enhancing Photovoltaic Performance of Lead-Free FASnI3 Solar Cells through Acceptor Density Optimization
abstract: Tin-based photovoltaic (PV) cells have become known as a highly potential contender within the PV sector. However, the full potential of PV systems employing <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{FASn}{\mathrm{I}}_3$</tex> (Formamidinium tin iodide) as the fundamental material has not been fully realized. In order to evaluate the efficiency of the device, research has been done to examine the effects of altering the acceptor density of the absorber layer <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$({\text{FASn}{\mathrm{I}}_3})$</tex>. The present study employed the SCAPS-1D simulation program to conduct thorough device simulations. The device structure suggested for this study had been scheduled to include <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Cu}/\text{PEDOT}:\text{PSS} + \mathrm{W}{\mathrm{O}}_3/\text{FASn}{\mathrm{I}}_3/\text{PCBM}/\text{FTO}$</tex>. The density of acceptors has been methodically modified in increments of 10, spanning from <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${10}^{15}$</tex> to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${10}^{25}{\mathrm{c}}{\mathrm{m}}^{ - 3}$</tex>. Based on the results, the most favorable <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{PV}$</tex> characteristics are seen as follows: a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${J}_{SC} - 21.99{\text{mA}}/\mathrm{c}{\mathrm{m}}^2,{V}_{OC} - 1.5\mathrm{V},\text{FF} - 87.57{{\% }}$</tex>, and PCE - <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$29.52{{\% }}$</tex>. This is predicated on an ideal acceptor density of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${10}^{25}{\mathrm{c}}{\mathrm{m}}^{ - 3}$</tex>. The aforementioned discoveries provide vital insights that can contribute to the improvement of PV device development. Moreover, they hold the potential to greatly improve the overall performance of solar cells that utilize tin as a key component.

articleTitle: Criminal Face Recognition System for Airports
abstract: The airport industry is one of the biggest and busiest industries in the world. It is estimated that more than 3000 million passengers travel worldwide via airplanes in a single year. Airports are often the transit points for crimes like drug trafficking, transnational organized crime, and acts of terrorism. In the past decade, hundreds of hijackings took place worldwide resulting in the lives of thousands. Moreover, it is estimated that tons of drugs like heroin, and opium are trafficked worldwide in a year through airplanes. Such illicit flows have a direct impact on National safety. Manual passport verification and security checks are commonly used to prevent any criminal or a person with a criminal background from entering the airport premises. However, it has the following limitations: manual verification is time-consuming, inaccuracy can be expected, it is prone to corruption, and the readability of personal records is constrained. In this paper, we propose an alternative automatic technique to recognize criminals in airports by making use of a face recognition system. In our work faces are detected from a live video stream using the Haar cascade classifier. Further the pattern-based features the Local Binary Patterns (LBP) are extracted from the detected images. LBP histograms are then used to create the face recognizer. We could achieve an overall accuracy of 92% compared to the traditional face recognition systems based on Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA). Our system is also highly robust to different face variations like aged faces, faces with a beard, faces with pose changes, illumination, etc.

articleTitle: Microcontroller Based Power Factor Correction, Harmonics Analysis, and Mitigation
abstract: The ever-growing need and usage of non-linear loads and power electronics switches in both domestic and industrial applications lead to significant deterioration of power quality. The power quality of the system is mainly dependent on power factor, harmonics generated due to non-linear loads, and pf correction apparatus. The poor power factor leads to a decrease in power quality and efficiency and results in high reactive power losses. The energy authorities often set a threshold to maintain certain power factors. If the threshold is not met, a penalty is issued. This paper mainly discusses the automatic switching of Capacitor banks, analyzing the harmonics due to Capacitor banks and a filter to reduce the current and voltage harmonics. The voltage and current harmonics are analyzed for a three-phase system and an LC oscillator is considered along the Capacitor bank part of the system. The paper also deals with a cloud system, which is used to store and monitor several data pertaining to the power system.

articleTitle: Multi Camera Vehicle Tracking Using OpenCV & Deep Learning
abstract: This Project work proposes a real-time approach for multi-vehicle detection and tracking. It involves detecting and continuously monitoring the status of vehicles from an aerial perspective, encompassing factors such as vehicle speed, vehicle classification, counting in areas under CCTV surveillance. Multicamera tracking is a computer vision task that involves analyzing videos to identify and track objects belonging to one or more categories. New technologies like object detection and tracking have been developed to utilize automated camera surveillance and generate data that can inform decision-making processes. For example, if the police need to locate a suspect's car in an area covered by hundreds of cameras, monitoring all the surveillance videos from each camera and reviewing thousands of hours of footage would be challenging. However, with computer vision technology, we can detect the location of vehicles and filter large amounts of data based on their shape, type, and appearance. In terms of vehicle identification, we implemented a spatial attention mechanism that relies on the background model. Our system's effectiveness was evaluated through the camera vehicle identification task.

articleTitle: Multi-layered Architecture for Secure Inter-network Data Transfer using Data Diode
abstract: Secure data transfer between public network and private network within an organization is a significant area of concern. Manual methods of burning data to disk or copying to USB devices and then reloading in private network raises major security risks. These risks include malware infection, data loss, etc. In addition, majority of the companies forbids the use of USBs and other portable storage devices. A unidirectional network bridge (data diode) that serves as a oneway gateway between two networks with different security classifications can be utilized to bypass this manual technique. Data diode alone will not suffice the security requirements of inter-network data transfer. By implementing numerous levels of defense and a segmented network, cross-network communication path can be secured against security compromise. This paper discusses on the multi-layered architecture and the network segmentation implemented to establish a secure inter-network data transfer solution with the help of a commercial data diode.

articleTitle: Knee Osteoarthritis Classification Using EfficientNet B3 Transfer Learning Model
abstract: Knee osteoarthritis (OA) is a chronic degenerative joint ailment characterized by pain, stiffness, edoema, and a limited range of motion in the knee joint. Boneon-bone contact occurs when the cartilage in the knee joint wears away. Deep neural networks are capable of performing a wide range of machine learning tasks in medical industries, such as diagnosis, prediction, and picture classification. This study categorizes knee osteoarthritis into five levels: minimal, healthy, moderate, suspect, and severe. For the categorizing task. EfficientNet B3 was used to train the model for 10 epochs with Adam as the optimizer and a batch size of 32. The model was trained on a fraction of the training data at each epoch to decrease the error between predicted classifications and actual labels. The model's accuracy was tested using a different validation dataset of 2,578 photos. The study's findings revealed that the model had an overall accuracy of 92%. The study's findings show that machine learning models have the potential to diagnose and treat knee osteoarthritis, while further research is needed to enhance the model's performance on bigger and more diverse datasets.

articleTitle: Diffusion Tensor Imaging for Assess Cognitive and Coast Impairments in Parkinson's Ailment
abstract: Parkinson's (PD) is a progressive neurodegenerative sickness, mainly due to excessive motor and cognitive impairments. Those impairments may be evaluated by using numerous forms of imaging and diffusion tensor imaging (DTI). DTI is an imaging approach that uses magnetic resonance to measure water diffusion in the mind, providing facts about neural pathways' movement and structure. DTI is in for the research of white count pathways related to the cognitive, motor, and non-motor deficits found in PD. It has enabled researchers to reap a more excellent complete picture of the neurodegeneration of PD and to apprehend the impact of the disease on neurological features. Moreover, DTI may be used to monitor and song adjustments in tissue integrity that could accompany ailment development. It can improve PD care by making an allowance for objective assessment of the progress of the infection and imparting insight into affected person-specific treatments. On average, DTI provides an invaluable device for studying and informing the results of PD on cognition and motor characteristics.

articleTitle: Kidney Disease X-Ray Image Classification Using a ResNet50V2 Model based Machine Learning Approach
abstract: The process of Kidney Disease Classification entails the categorization of kidney pictures or patient data into several disease classifications, including but not limited to chronic kidney disease (CKD) phases, polycystic kidney disease (PKD), kidney stones, renal tumours, and many other kidneyrelated illnesses. Machine learning algorithms have the capability to undergo training using datasets that are annotated with labels, enabling them to automatically detect and categorise certain circumstances. The primary objective of Kidney Disease Classification is to categorise kidney tumours or lesions into distinct categories, including renal cell carcinoma (RCC), angiomyolipoma (AML), oncocytoma, and several benign or malignant tumour subtypes. The use of this categorization system may provide valuable support in the process of diagnosing and formulating treatment strategies for individuals afflicted with kidney tumours. The process of Kidney Disease Classification entails the categorization of biopsy samples from patients who have had kidney transplantation, with the aim of ascertaining the presence or absence of rejection in the transplanted kidney. The categorization may include many classifications such as acute cellular rejection, acute antibody-mediated rejection, chronic rejection, or absence of rejection. The advancement of novel traits or combinations thereof, which have the potential to enhance the accuracy of categorization, is facilitated by social research in this domain, therefore contributing to the enhancement of quality of life. The objective of this research is to enhance patient health by using deep learning techniques to develop an X-ray classification system capable of detecting renal illness. The ResNet50V2 model demonstrated robust classification abilities in identifying renal disease, with a notable accuracy rate of 97%.

articleTitle: Video Authentication Using File Structure Analysis
abstract: The video recordings captured from DVR (Digital Video Recorder) machines or from mobile phones are presented in front of the court as the main source of evidence in the crimes such as sexual assaults, child exploitation, kidnapping, armed robberies, murders etc. Admissibility of the CCTV footages or videos procured from DVRs or from mobile phone depends on its proven authenticity. The recent technologies provide easy access of editing in to the digital media and therefore the acceptance of such evidences becomes questionable in the court of law. In this study we presented how the file structure analysis of the video recording file captured from mobile, helped in identifying the tampering. Rather than the frame by frame analysis or content analysis, the file structure analysis is the purely technical approach of video authentication. The original video recording in .mp4 format was deliberately edited using freely available video editors, the file also travelled through social media. The file structures of original file and the edited files were compared and on the basis of the differences in the structures and metadata, results were obtained on authentication.

articleTitle: Pothole Detection Using Deep Learning
abstract: Potholes are a significant road infrastructure problem that poses safety risks to drivers and causes substantial damage to vehicles. Accurate and real time detection of potholes is crucial for timely repairs and road maintenance. This paper presents a novel approach for pothole detection using YOLOv8, an advanced version of the You Only Look Once (YOLO) object detection algorithm. The proposed method leverages the advantages of YOLOv8, which combines state-of-the-art object detection techniques with improved network architecture for enhanced accuracy and efficiency. A comprehensive dataset of road images containing various pothole instances is collected and used to train the YOLOv8 model. Transfer learning techniques are employed to fine-tune the model for pothole detection specifically. To evaluate the performance of the proposed method, extensive experiments are conducted on different road scenarios, including varying lighting conditions, road types, and pothole sizes. The results demonstrate that the YOLOv8-based pothole detection system achieves high accuracy and real-time processing capability, making it suitable for deployment in smart city infrastructure and vehicle navigation systems. The contributions of this work lie in the development of an effective and efficient pothole detection system using YOLOv8, capable of identifying potholes accurately in real-world scenarios. This system can significantly aid road maintenance authorities in identifying potholes promptly, facilitating timely repairs and ultimately leading to safer and smoother road conditions for drivers and pedestrians alike.

articleTitle: Bridging Automated Reasoning and Machine Learning for Information Analysis
abstract: Recent advances in automated reasoning and system studying have appreciably impacted the automation of statistics evaluation. These technologies facilitate understanding the increasingly more complicated volumes of facts in a ramification of approaches. Automatic reasoning helps decide valid solutions based on structured good judgment, while machines can pick out patterns and developments in massive datasets. Bridging those two technologies improves accuracy and efficiency in automated facts evaluation. This paper will overview present-day research on bridging automated reasoning and device-gaining knowledge for such purposes and gift novel approaches to combining the two technologies for more effective data evaluation. Discussion subjects will encompass integrating neural networks and reasoning engines, methods for addressing records incompleteness and uncertainty, and enhancement of reasoning-driven context-conscious systems. Furthermore, the paper will discover the capacity benefits that can be performed via leveraging the strengths of each automated reasoning and gadget gaining knowledge of to optimize answers for a selection of software scenarios.

articleTitle: A Fuzzification Model for Predicting the Malus Infection Using Abiotic Parameters
abstract: Apple plant diseases can cause significant economic losses to the agricultural industry. Traditional disease detection methods are often time-consuming and laborintensive. This paper aims to explore the utilization of fuzzification for the prediction of apple plant diseases. The use of fuzzification provides a powerful framework for automated and accurate disease diagnosis. This paper presents an overview of the methodology applying fuzzy logic for diagnosing the occurrence of disease at early stage. This is based on the crisp values of abiotic factors such as humidity, temperature and soil, gives predicted risk level in apple plant orchard at four levels as: no risk, low risk, moderate risk and high risk corresponding to the membership values 0, 0.3, 0.7 and 1 respectively.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Regulatory Requirements of ATM Network Acceptance
abstract: This paper seeks to research the modern regulatory requirements for the recognition of ATM networks. ATM networks are an crucial part of the worldwide payments infrastructure, imparting customers with the capability to apply coins and test deposits and withdrawals from ATMs at some point of the arena. This paper will evaluate the modernday rules for accepting ATM networks, together with compliance requirements, geographic restrictions, and the inclusion of sure offerings in the networks. It in addition examines the effect that new policies, together with the revised payment offerings Directive, has had on those requirements. Sooner or later, this paper will offer suggestions for network providers and clients if you want to make sure adherence to those requirements. Thru this look at, the authors hope to provide valuable insights into the contemporary policies for ATM networks, at the same time as helping to ensure the reliable and comfortable operation of ATM networks around the sector…

articleTitle: An in-Depth Analysis of Email Protocols Traffic Using Wireshark
abstract: This paper aims to get an in-depth analysis of IP packets containing Email protocols using the packet sniffing tools such as Wireshark. In the current era email communication is one of the most widely used medium for both professional & personal communication, which makes it an attractive target for cybercrime. For any Organization it is important for network administrators to keep an eye on traffic flowing over the mail network. By analyzing email protocol packets, it is possible to detect malicious activities and identify potential security threats, which helps in improving network security and performance. It also helps in tracing the origin, path, and authenticity of emails in the event of a security breach. The paper provides an overview of the Wireshark packet sniffing tool, it's features and capabilities along with the methodology proposed to analyze the email protocol packets. In addition to that, it also highlights the challenges and limitations associated and future courses of action.

articleTitle: Integration of PLC and Robotic Operating System for Enhanced Automation Efficiency”
abstract: The mix of Robotic Operating System (ROS) and Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) has showed promise in improving automation effectiveness in a range of industrial uses. In order to achieve seamless coordination and increased performance in automated systems, this study examines the probable benefits of combining PLCs with ROS. PLCs have long been utilised in industrial settings for control and tracking jobs because they are robust and dependable. However, ROS, which was originally created for robotics, offers an extensible framework for robot control, sensing, and communication. The characteristics of both systems may be exploited to produce a synergistic effect that enhances automation capabilities and ROS integration supports data and order transfer between the two systems, allowing effective coordination and synchronisation of industrial activities. Advanced sensing and control methods in ROS may be applied by PLCs, and ROS may profit from the dependability and real-time capabilities of PLCs. This integration makes it possible for robots, sensors, and other automation components to interact easily, which improves system performance and flexibility. The mix of Robotic Operating System (ROS) and Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) has showed promise in improving automation effectiveness in a range of industrial uses. In order to achieve seamless coordination and increased performance in automated systems, this study examines the probable benefits of combining PLCs with ROS. PLCs have long been utilised in industrial settings for control and tracking jobs because they are robust and dependable..

articleTitle: EGF: An Improved Edge Detection Model for Low-Resolution Images *
abstract: Edge detection can benefit many different industries and domains, including computer vision, machine learning, image analysis, remote sensing, thermal imaging, pattern recognition, and medical imaging. The technique of determining the borders between several objects or regions in an image is known as edge detection. The edges of an object in a picture serve as the object's limits and can reveal crucial details about the object's size, shape, and position. Since low-resolution images have low pixel densities or pixel values, which muddy the images, detecting edges in them is demanding work. This paper proposes a novel edge-detection approach called EGF (Extended Gaussian Filter) for low-resolution images. EGF utilizes the basic concept of Gaussian filter to find the edges of images. The objective function of EGF is developed to reduce the noise and pixel differentiation in images. The outcomes show that the suggested strategy outperforms the conventional edge detection technique.

articleTitle: Implementation of Artificial Neural Network-Based Signal Conditioning Circuit for a Temperature Transducer
abstract: Thermistors are widely used as temperature transducers due to their low cost, small dimensions, and high sensitivity. However, their nonlinear resistance-temperature characteristics make their use in temperature measurement and control applications challenging. This paper presents a new method to linearize thermistors using an op-amp-based astable multivibrator and an artificial neural network. The proposed technique involves obtaining frequency values corresponding to the resistance values of the thermistor using an op-amp-based astable multivibrator circuit. The nonlinear frequency data obtained can then be used to train an ANN to obtain the best-fit linear curve. A signal conditioning circuit is then constructed that takes the read frequency value and matches it to its corresponding linearized value, which is displayed. The method offers several advantages over traditional techniques, including improved accuracy and reduced cost. Additionally, it can improve the accuracy of measuring temperature, and control applications by eliminating the nonlinearities associated with thermistors.

articleTitle: Assignment Model of Earthquake Emergency Rescue Team and its Solving Algorithm
abstract: An emergency rescue team assignment model is proposed to solve the problem of earthquake disaster emergency rescue team assignment. Considering the rescue teams to participate, the establishment of a rescue teams to rescue mission time satisfaction biggest and strongest competencies multiobjective optimization problem, and according to the characteristics of the model in the basic salp swarm algorithm based on discrete salp swarm algorithm was designed, built model is verified by the example analysis and the feasibility and effectiveness of the method, It can provide decision-making reference for emergency management.

Author Keywords: emergency rescue time satisfaction competence assignment model multi-objective optimization

articleTitle: Performance Upgradation of Roof Top Solar PV Systems for Establishing Green Electricity
abstract: It is pragmatic that performances of majority of the installed rooftop solar power plants across the nation are degrading progressively irrespective of their guaranteed performance. To justify the aforesaid statement, an existing 500.3 kWp rooftop solar PV system is considered and its performance for past 3 years is analyzed. It was found that the annual energy generation got reduced from 234551 kWh (2020) to 115888 kWh (2021) and further to 74016 kWh (2022). The root-cause behind it was investigated by introducing continuance check factor and predicting the performance of the system and validating it through physical inspection. A methodology has been proposed for recapturing the generation loss and establish the green electricity.

articleTitle: Research on Active Magnetic Shielding for Electric Vehicle Wireless Power Transfer System
abstract: To mitigate the magnetic induction intensity surrounding the human body during the Wireless Power Transfer (WPT) of electric vehicles, this paper introduces an active coil shielding technique. Firstly, the circuit model of the WPT system is established, and a set of finite element simulation models of active magnetic shielding for 3.3 kW WPT system is designed, and the validity of the active magnetic shielding method is verified through simulation, and active magnetic shielding of the WPT system of the electric vehicle is successfully realized, and the best active magnetic shielding effect is achieved through further optimization of the current amplitude and phase in the active magnetic shielding coil,. The effectiveness of the active magnetic shielding theory and design method is proved.

articleTitle: Forged News Recognition Using Ensemble Machine Learning Classification Techniques
abstract: Forged news broadcast by media outlets poses a real threat to the credibility of information, catching forged news that has become increasingly popular in recent years. Most forged news is deliberately written to mislead readers, making it very difficult to detect forged news based solely on news content. At the same time, forged news will have real evidence to criticize real news, revealing different levels of deception and increasing the difficulty of investigation. On the other hand, forged news creates different types of information from different perspectives. This comprehensive database provides a rich overview of forged news and provides unprecedented access to forged news. In this article, forged detection of forged news with different levels of forged news by combining multiple sources has been developed. Specifically, this model provides a method for combining data from different sources and distinguishing the forged news level, and we offer a multisite, multiclass forged news detection framework, which combines automatic extraction, multisite fusion, and automation level. Experimental results on real world data demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, and further experiments were undertaken to gain a deeper understanding.

articleTitle: Real-Time Diagnostics with AI/ML: An Assessment of its Usefulness in Smart Health Care
abstract: Actual-time diagnostics with AI/ML have been gaining traction in clever fitness care, imparting an efficient and accurate method of diagnosing and handling diverse health situations. By leveraging the power of AI/ML, healthcare professionals, and patients can benefit from progressed accuracy and efficiency in diagnostics, assisting in diagnosing a circumstance quicker and more correctly than a human could. Additionally, AI/ML can assist in automating the complete process, saving time and resources even by ensuring diagnostic outcomes. By utilizing information from diverse sources, clinical facts, imaging, and lab results, AI/ML may be leveraged to facilitate the assessment and diagnosis of a spread of fitness situations, doubtlessly leading to earlier and more effective existence-saving treatments. As such, the capacity for AI/ML programs to offer actual-time diagnostics in clever fitness care can be a helpful device, assisting in improving outcomes and reducing prices.

articleTitle: On Exponential Stability of Neural Networks with Time-Varying Delays
abstract: In contrast to the relevant results on neural network, the commonly adopted differentiable and bounded assumption on the time-varying delay is relaxed, more precisely, we deduce the exponential stability of neural network by Gronwall inequality, under which the initial function is continuous and the time-varying delay is bounded continuous. Several examples are illustrated to applicability of the obtained result.

articleTitle: Lung Sound Based Pulmonary Disease Classification Using Deep Learning
abstract: Respiratory infections are disorders that damage the lungs and airways and make it difficult for patients to breathe. Any part of the respiratory system has the potential to become infected or sick, which could have a variety of negative effects. Early detection of lung disorders results in a person's successful treatment. Using electronically recorded lung sounds, pulmonary diseases can be diagnosed. MelFrequency Cepstral Coefficient (MFCC), one of the Librosa machine learning library features, is used to check that such a brief speech segment is sufficiently steady to permit effective modeling. In this research, Librosa is one of the better preprocessing techniques used when working with audio data. The CNN model is applied to the collected dataset and obtained a train accuracy of 95% and a test accuracy of 85% when trained on extracted MFCC features. And also used a number of performance evaluation indicators, including as F1score, accuracy, precision, and recall. The outcomes of this research enable the use of deep learning models in clinical settings to improve doctors' judgment when identifying lung disorders.

articleTitle: Image based Sudoku Solver using Applied Recursive Backtracking
abstract: For a long time, we have seen people being obsessed with Sudoku, and solving it might take people hours while most of them are not able to solve them at all. It gathered peoples’ attention due to its simple yet brainstorming structure and very low requirement of any special skills. Many algorithms have been developed in the past few years for solving a Sudoku using computational power. One technique that we will be seeing today is the backtracking algorithm which recursively calls the function again and again and goes on building the solution with each step. This algorithm is specifically used to solve problems like Hamiltonian circuit problems and the N-queen problem. There are two types of backtracking and the one which we will be focusing on is the recursive backtracking algorithm. The paper will also focus on the projection of all the solution values directly on the Sudoku image in real-time.

articleTitle: Optimization of Talent Training Model Based on the Problem of Assignment
abstract: A model of university-enterprise cooperation joint training of students based on the assignment problem of operational research is proposed. The Hungarian algorithm is used to analyze in detail the three basic types of universityenterprise cooperation joint training of students, including the number of school majors is equal to the number of enterprises, the number of school majors is less than the number of enterprises, and the number of school majors is more than the number of cooperative enterprises.The optimization results of the cooperation between universities and enterprises are obtained after case analysis. This model has high feasibility and can provide a reference for the joint training of students by universities and enterprises.

articleTitle: Effective Co-Segmentation and Data Augmentation for Unsupervised Multi-View Stereo
abstract: Recent research has shown that view synthesisbased unsupervised methods may significantly improve multi view stereo (MVS). Although this might not always be the case in reality, current approaches assume that points that correlate across perspectives be coloured similarly. This might lower the quality of the reconstructed signal if the self-supervised data is inaccurate. To solve this problem, we present a paradigm that incorporates semantic co-segmentation along with information augmentation to provide more trustworthy supervision. In particular, we use mutual semantic extraction from many views to direct semantic coherence. By using the forecasting of routine samples as pseudo reality to regularise the preprediction of augmented models, we create an efficient dataaugmentation process that guarantees the robustness of the transformation. Our suggested approaches achieve state-ofthe-art performance on the DTU data set, placing them on par with state-of-the-art supervised algorithms, as presented by our experimental findings. Extensive studies on the Tanks & Temples database further show that the suggested strategy has a high degree of generalizability.

articleTitle: Bird Species Identification Using Speech Recognition*
abstract: This article is significant for its potential to automate and streamline bird monitoring, enabling efficient and widespread species identification for conservation purposes. This study employed deep learning techniques to predict different species of birds based on their vocalizations. To categorize bird species, its been built using a deep neural network model with characteristics collected from bird noises. The dataset utilized for the purpose of training and testing the model comprises of recordings of avian vocalizations obtained from five distinct species, namely “American Robin,” “Northern Mockingbird,” “Northern Cardinal,” “Song Sparrow,” and “House Crow.” Pre-processing of the dataset involved the extraction of MFCCs from each recording, which served as the basis for the features used in training the model.

articleTitle: The Blockchain-Powered Edge Computing Platform for Developing Smart Internet of Things (IoT) Applications
abstract: Because of the intensive calculations required by Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) applications, an embedded device with limited hardware, such an IoT device, cannot execute the apps independently. One approach is to send CNN calculations away from the client devices and have them executed by neighboring edge servers [1], which have more powerful hardware. However, the proposed approach has a number of flaws. Providing incentives for the edge server to host the client applications is a problem of availability. Another issue is a problem with scalability, or how to deploy additional servers to handle increased demand for CNN services. Last but not least, there's the problem of data integrity, which concerns the client's ability to have faith in the output from hidden edge servers. We believe that blockchain technology holds the key to resolving these problems and making edge computing a reality. In this work, we present a new blockchain-based structure for CNN edge computing. Due to the inability of existing blockchains like Ethereum to execute a sophisticated programme, we suggest an alternative blockchain structure and protocol.

articleTitle: Investigating Broadcast-Free Opportunistic Network Coding Algorithms with Wireless Systems
