abstract: This paper investigates broadcast-free opportunistic community coding (OFNC) algorithms for Wi-Fi systems. OFNC combines the switch of facts among or more devices with more green transmission of information within the network. It uses a random mixture of packets to create new packets, and then sends the ones new packets back to the sender. By creating more than one copies of the identical statistics, network congestion is reduced and extra green transmission is accomplished. The paper explores how OFNC algorithms can be used in one-of-a-kind wireless applications and evaluates their overall performance via a test performed in a realistic situation. The experiment highlights the benefits of the usage of OFNC and provides insight into how OFNC algorithms can be similarly optimized for Wi-Fi systems.

articleTitle: Understanding the Potential of AI-Powered Image Recognition Systems for Real-Time Applications
abstract: This paper investigates the potential of synthetic Intelligence (AI)–powered image popularity systems for actual-time packages. It explores how these structures can beautify actual-time operations' efficiency, accuracy, and productivity. The paper examines the accuracy, velocity, and effectiveness of image reputation technologies, which include convolutional neural networks (CNNs), switch studying, and item detection. These technologies can create fashions to detect and classify gadgets in real-time and for self-reliant selectionmaking. Additionally, the paper will speak about the security threats associated with the lengthy-time utilization of these structures. Examples of AI-powered image reputation systems for numerous actual-time programs can also be included. Sooner or later, the paper will offer an end, which considers the potential pitfalls of using AI-powered image reputation systems for actual-time packages.

articleTitle: Unleashing the Melodic Potential: Music Generation with Char RNNs
abstract: Recently, the use of ABC notation in music composition employing recurrent neural networks (RNNs) has gained popularity. As a possible tool for ABC-based music creation, our work investigates char RNN models. Due to its simple and clear representation of musical elements, the ABC notation style is used for training RNN models. This study's main objective is to assess the effectiveness and creativity of Character RNN models for generating music. The technical facets of model implementation are examined in this paper, including network design, training approaches, and text preprocessing methods particular to ABC notation. Furthermore, the model's compositions are evaluated for overall coherence, melodic and rhythmic patterns and harmonic progressions. With the aid of this study, we seek to acquire a deeper grasp of the musical creativity potential of Character RNN models and their capability to generate music.

articleTitle: Analysis of Vertically Stacked Ferroelectric Based FinFET for Switching Applications
abstract: This paper presents the study of characteristic parameters of ferroelectric based FinFET with vertically stacked channel engineered ferroelectric based FinFET (VSFe-FinFET) at the nanoscale region and results attained have been compared with conventional Fe-FinFET. The DC characteristics of the device have been investigated in terms of on current, leakage current, switching ratio, subthreshold swing, threshold voltage. All the simulations are performed on Cogenda Visual TCAD simulator and it has been inferred that in comparison to conventional Fe-FinFET, there is reduction of 93.89% in leakage current which enhances the switching ratio 15 times for the VS-Fe-FinFET. Further it shows better performance in terms of threshold voltage and subthreshold swing. The temperature analysis has also been done for the proposed device, VS-Fe-FinFET at temperature range of 300K, 350K and 400K. From the analysis it is found that proposed vertically stacked SiGe/Si ferroelectric based FinFET (VS-FeFinFET) shows high-speed switching performance at lower temperature with less leakage current thus exhibiting a superior performance over Fe-FinFET for electronics industry and high speed switching applications.

articleTitle: The Future of OpenAI Tools: Opportunities and Challenges for Human-AI Collaboration
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has the potential to transform numerous aspects of our lives, from healthcare and education to business and entertainment. OpenAI tools, such as ChatGPT and DALL-E 2, are at the forefront of this revolution, offering exciting opportunities for human-AI collaboration. However, there are also significant challenges to be overcome. This research paper explores the opportunities and challenges of using OpenAI tools for human-AI collaboration, with a focus on their potential applications, challenges, and key factors for successful collaboration. The paper presents case studies of successful collaborations, including their challenges and lessons learned, as well as future prospects of OpenAI tools. The research concludes with recommendations for continued research in human-AI collaboration, emphasizing the importance of responsible development and use of AI tools for the benefit of society.

articleTitle: Thrust Vector Control of Solid Propellant Model Rocket
abstract: Rocket technology is one of the most complex engineering problems, and it was the game changer for humankind in the 20th and 21st centuries. Controlling the rocket during flight is a mathematically challenging task. Since a rocket has many subsystems, it must work mutually for a successful flight. In this work, the control system for changing the direction of the rocket during the flight was studied. In order to control a rocket, it must have its fuel burning, which will produce the required thrust. By controlling the direction of thrust, the moment acting on the rocket can be controlled according to the flight plan. This method is called Thrust Vector Control (TVC). This work is based on controlling the thrust direction of a solid propellant model rocket. The major benefit of TVC is that it can be used even when no air is present in the surrounding of the rocket. Therefore it can be used for outer space missions. Initially, a MATLAB/Simulink model is made to simulate and study the rocket's orientation by controlling the thrust direction along the pitch plane. In order to verify the designed control system, a hardware prototype was developed, and hold down tests were conducted on the model rocket.

articleTitle: Detection of Schizophrenia Based on EEG Signal Using Vision Transformer Techniques
abstract: Schizophrenia is a serious and long-lasting condition characterized by disturbed beliefs, difficulties with thinking, and experiencing things that are not real, which impact emotions, behavior, and thoughts. Detecting and treating schizophrenia early is important to prevent long-term consequences. Electroencephalogram (EEG) data is a biological marker that can identify hidden changes in the brain during schizophrenia. However, EEG signals are unstable and have low intensity, making extracting meaningful information challenging. In this study, we propose using a vision transformer technique, which operates in the time-frequency domain, to detect schizophrenia automatically. The model was built and evaluated using three different validation approaches, including ten-fold cross-validation, with separate publicly available schizophrenia data sets. A new method for automated EEG-based schizophrenia detection has been developed using the DeiT model time-frequency (TF) input images. The method was evaluated on EEG recordings from 45 schizophrenia patients and 39 healthy controls, using morlet wavelet scattering. The overall accuracy of the method was 91% for subject-independent classification. The authors suggest that the ViT model could be used as a disease detection tool for not only schizophrenia but also other neurological symptoms. The suggested model's accuracy rate on dataset 2 was 84.64%, with 49 participants with schizophrenia and 32 healthy controls.

articleTitle: Alzheimer's Disorder Identification from MRI Images with EfficientNetB0
abstract: Alzheimer's disease has been defined as a progressive loss of mental function and is a neurodegenerative condition. For prompt management and better patient outcomes, it is essential to make an early and correct analysis of Alzheimer's illness. Models based on deep learning have recently demonstrated encouraging outcomes in medical image analysis applications, such as Alzheimer's disease sorting. Modern deep learning architecture EfficientNet has shown good precision on a number of computer vision applications. Proposed Research has created models for categorizing Alzheimer's ailment with neuroimaging data by utilizing EfficientNet capabilities. The model's higher performance is a result of its capacity to take advantage of the vast spatial and temporal data recorded in neuroimaging scans. This paper offers a unique method for precise and effective Alzheimer's disease classification using brain imaging data by utilizing the EfficientNet architecture. The results demonstrate the potential of deep learning models to enhance early detection and medical treatment plans for Alzheimer's disease patients.

articleTitle: Whatsapp Chat Analyzer Using Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing
abstract: The most popular and effective form of electronic communication now in use is WhatsApp. There are many different types of conversations that take place among groups of individuals in WhatsApp chats. This data can offer a wealth of information for cutting-edge technologies like machine learning. Users have a platform to analyze WhatsApp conversations through WhatsApp chat analyzer. The input for the WhatsApp chat analyzer is a text file that has been exported from WhatsApp. The main goals of this essay are to identify emotions, present various concepts, visualizations, and analyze discussions. It provides a detailed examination of the total number of messages, each user's activity, the overall volume of words, the monthly timeline, the busiest day, and a variety of other statistics. Also, it provides graphic representations of weekly activity and the busiest users, and we may exploit these results.

articleTitle: Banking Industry Using Artificial Neural Network
abstract: The study aims to create a method to determine the credit rating and evaluate the risks related to the Indian banking business. To create predictive models for credit ratings, Artificial Neural Network (ANN) algorithms are used, which include Multilayer Perceptrons (MLPs), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. For this purpose, secondary data from over 254 Indian banks covering 2014–15 to 2021–22 were considered. The study evaluated crucial factors to predict credit scores while considering business, financial, and industrial hazards. The data includes current liability and Revenues, COGS, SG&A, R&D, EBIT, EBITDA, Interest expense, Abnormal Gains/Losses, Income Taxes, Net Income from Discontinued Op., Net Profit, and Dividends. Current and quick ratios. GDP per capita, The research's main contribution is its capacity to forecast how credit ratings for different Indian banks may change over time based on their financial, commercial, and industrial risk profiles. This cutting-edge method of credit rating prediction improves forecasting accuracy. It boosts the effectiveness of rating systems, providing invaluable insights for the banking sector to navigate these uncharted times while analysing credit risks successfully.

articleTitle: Investigating the Role of Applied Cryptography Algorithms for Malware Detection
abstract: This paper aims to discover the position of implemented cryptography algorithms for malware detection, which has become a critical issue. Malware spread has become a significant problem for individuals, organizations, and governments alike, and it is essential to locate a powerful way to stumble on and remove these threats before they can do any harm. Cryptography algorithms, while no longer replacing traditional malware detection techniques, can supplement these methods by providing a further layer of safety. The paper will evaluate present cryptography strategies and discover their applications in malware detection, specializing in using multi-signature hashes, key-delivery algorithms, and other related technologies. It will also look at how these cryptography-primarily based techniques may govern malware proliferation and, in the long run, shield computer systems from virus assaults. Ultimately, the paper will speak about the capacity of applied cryptography algorithms as a device towards malicious code and speak viable destiny research instructions and implementations.

articleTitle: Using Long Short-Term Memory Units for Time Series Forecasting
abstract: This paper specializes in using long short-time period memory (LSTM) networks for time collection forecasting. LSTM is a form of artificial recurrent neural network (RNN) that is especially properly-applicable to analyze from enjoy over long sequences of statistics. Not like conventional recurrent networks, LSTM networks can technique input sequences in each instruction, while also allowing for the protection of lengthy-time period dependencies and rapid convergence. It's far shown that these characteristics of LSTM networks allow them to be used efficaciously for forecasting time series consisting of inventory performance and electricity tendencies. Strategies inclusive of feeding the LSTM network data in a time step layout, the use of peephole connections, stacking a couple of layers and early stopping are discussed. Results are then presented and mentioned, demonstrating that LSTM networks can research complex lengthy-time period dependencies in time series facts and correctly forecast destiny values.

articleTitle: Software Project Estimation Using Machine Learning
abstract: The major purpose of the project is to investigate a range of machine learning techniques in order to improve the accuracy of projecting costs and efforts for software development projects. Numerous strategies in software effort estimation have been investigated in order to develop models with the best accuracy. Our primary goal is to determine the important variables and factors that influence the costs and efforts necessary for software development. To solve the accuracy issues, we're building an Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) model that uses the Analogous Estimation technique. The performance of the model will then be compared to that of existing models such as the Constructive Cost Model (COCOMO), K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), and Support Vector Machine (SVM). This method enables us to successfully combine Machine Learning with the Analogous Estimation methodology, thereby boosting the precision of software project estimates for more dependable outcomes.

articleTitle: NLP-Powered Short Video Enrichment System
abstract: Recommendation systems have received a lot of attention lately due to their pivotal role in guiding users through the overwhelming volumes of information available online. This paper explores the integration of Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques into recommendation systems to enhance their performance and user experience. The growth of the users has been increasing daily, to give them the satisfaction they want when scrolling through the feed. We have made a recommendation system using prominent technology. The system connects the user faster with their desired videos. To make a better system we have used React, Firebase, and Flask as the crucial elements of our work. We recommend the top 5 reels using some aspects. The aspects are hashtags, descriptions, and user id.

articleTitle: Fine-Tuned Convolutional Neural Network Model for Rice Leaf Disease Prediction
abstract: Rice stands as a crucial sustenance for the majority of the global population, underscoring its cultivation's significance within agriculture. Nonetheless, the vitality of rice crops is persistently imperilled by a multitude of leaf diseases, culminating in substantial declines in yield. Prompt and accurate diagnosis of these diseases holds paramount importance for effective disease management and safeguarding food security. In recent times, convolutional neural networks (CNNs), have been identified as remarkable models in achieving optimal results in image-processing tasks, including the identification of plant diseases and health diseases. The proposed work has been employed with a CNN model for rice leaf disease classification. The open-source data repository “Kaggle” has been used as the source of the rice leaf disease dataset collection. Further, the CNN model has been trained for the automatic recognition and classification of four different kinds of rice leave diseases namely bacterial blight, blast, brown spot, and tungro. To build this CNN model, fine-tuning has been performed by changing the number of epochs and learning rate along with optimizers. The results show that the model has achieved the highest accuracy of 93.33% at epoch 14, whereas, at epoch 75 it has been identified as 75.56%. Furthermore, when the epoch was again increased to 100, the accuracy started to increase and resulted in 81.53% at epoch 100. In future, the model can be trained with the augmented images to achieve optimal results in the increased number of epochs.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Portable Network Analyzer for In-line Sensor Measurements
abstract: Any sensor utilization is largely dependent upon its electronics integration and portability. This work represents systematic work done on integration of a resonance-based sensor to appropriate electronic interface unit (EIU) and design-cumdevelopment of appropriate vector network analyzer (VNA) to demonstrate a complete portable resonance sensor. Complementary Split Ring Resonator (CSRR) at 130 MHz is initially simulated and later fabricated on FR4 substrate copper clad. The development of the EIU addresses the limitations of traditional VNAs, offering a portable, adaptable, and budgetfriendly alternative. The experimental framework encompasses the ATmega328P microcontroller-based EIU and CSRR sensor. The EIU is optimized to identify the material based on resonance shifts obtained for various materials (Air, DI Water, Dimethylformamide (DMF), and Ethanol) and their concentrations. An efficient, reliable, and accessible approach is demonstrated for various technological applications for in-line testing and evaluation of hazardous ambiance.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Face Recognition with SNN
abstract: This idea presents a face recognition (FER) algorithm using a deep Siamese neural network (SNN) that stores local patterns of images in a similar space. We create networks to show similarity between pairs of ideas by comparing features with design. Additionally, we developed a new image matching (i.e., positive-negative matching) technique to introduce our Siamese model. Our Siamese model has a proven and accepted model for learning in an integrated environment. The validation method reduces the class variance by reducing the distance between features drawn from the same class, whereas a validation procedure raises the class variance by widening the gap between characteristics drawn from different classes. By using four layers of IoT we successfully implemented the multimodal authentication system with the Biometric and Face Recognition System as a mode for the authentication. In this project machine learning with IoT to make fulfill the product requirements and a more secure authentication system.

articleTitle: Model and Simulation of Electric Power Steering System in Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
abstract: In depth analysis of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM) based on the mathematical model , and characteristics and structure of the assist motor for Electric Power Steering(EPS) system, hysteresis current tracking control strategy has been proposed and adopted.The paper establishes the simulation models of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor and hysteresis current tracking control system based on Matlab/Simulink to research on the torque、 response speed and anti-jamming capability for <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{A 0}$</tex> class car at low, medium and high speed. The results verify the control strategy.

articleTitle: Investigating Innovative User Interfaces for Data Visualization and Analysis
abstract: This paper will explore current studies and developments in consumer interfaces for records visualization and analysis. Mainly that specialize in how innovative consumer interfaces can make choices better than present-day ones. The studies will look at various consumer interfaces, discover and explore their strengths and weaknesses, and discuss opportunities for further studies and innovation in this location. Examples of revolutionary consumer interfaces discussed within the paper might be evaluated for their capability to grow a person's information and engagement with records, lessen the cognitive load, improve enjoyment, and better combine documents with meaningful visualizations. The consequences of this research could be priceless in terms of assisting in designing effective and person-pleasant document visualization consumer interfaces on multiple systems, including desktop, mobile devices, and virtual pills.

articleTitle: Chicken Disease Classification from Faeces Samples Using a Fine-Tuned EfficientNet B5 Model
abstract: Poultry farming is critical for providing the world's protein requirement, but it feces challenges such as viral infections that influence bird health and production. It is critical to obtain a diagnosis as soon as possible in order to combat the many chicken diseases. This study aims to expand the field of poultry disease diagnostics by using advanced deep learning techniques to diagnose common chicken diseases using fecal samples. The goal of this study is to employ deep learning methods, specifically the EfficientNet B5 model, to classify four common chicken diseases: coccidiosis, salmonella, Newcastle disease, and healthy birds, with a total of 8000 fecal images. In the study, the Adam optimizer was utilized to simulate 15 epochs and 32 batch sizes in order to fine-tune the EfficientNetB5 transfer learning model. The fine-tuned transfer learning model has a 95% overall accuracy. The study's potential benefit rests in its ability to speed disease identification processes, reducing economic losses and enhancing the overall sustainability of poultry production systems.

articleTitle: Simulation Experiment of Young's Two-Slit Interference based on LabVIEW
abstract: In the context of the integration of information technology and education, this work based on LabVIEW to carry out the simulation of yang 's double slit interference experiment. The human-computer interaction of incident light wavelengthλ, double slit distanced, slit screen distanceD, light intensity and other physical quantities is realized. Visualize and visualize abstract and difficult physical phenomena and principles. It can also generate executable files through VI and share them through Internet to supplement digital teaching resources.

articleTitle: Elevating News Summarization: Long Short-Term Memory Empowerment for Enriched Content Synthesis in Machine Learning
abstract: It's critical to keep up with current happenings in today's fast-paced culture. Due to their hectic schedules, many people, however, find it difficult to keep up with the broad news. To address this issue, we developed a system that effectively summarizes news stories and provides succinct and illuminating summaries. The Text Ranking algorithm is used by our system to extract headline information and produce concise summaries. A headlining module built on a seq-to-seq model and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) architecture has also been added. Techniques for Natural Language Processing (NLP) are used to preprocess data and enhance the summary procedure. Recurrent neural networks and LSTM are comparable in that they both excel at capturing longdistance word associations in input sequences. We've created a user-friendly website using these elements to improve accessibility. By empowering people to stay informed without having to read lengthy news pieces, this method responds to the demands of our fast-paced lifestyles.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Machine Learning Model to Identify Green Zones
abstract: Green zones are locations or regions where the air quality is deemed to be good or healthy for the general public in the context of air quality. The Air Quality Index (AQI), a numerical scale intended to convey how contaminated the air is and what potential health impacts may be of concern, is commonly used to identify these zones. This work proposes a thorough and reliable model that focuses on important variables like nitrogen dioxide (NO2), sulfur dioxide (SO2), and respirable suspended particulate matter (RSPM) in order to find green areas with great air quality. The model reliably measures the Air Quality Index (AQI) and creates a clear threshold for designating places with good air quality through the use of historical air quality data and sophisticated machine learning algorithms. The results of this study have important ramifications for environmental, public health, and urban planning policy, offering vital insights to promote sustainable development and produce healthier living conditions for locals.

articleTitle: Predictive Modelling of Bipolar Disorder Utilizing Advanced Machine Learning Techniques
abstract: A complex mental health disease called bipolar disorder is characterised by recurrent manic and depressive episodes. For effective treatment planning and management, bipolar illness must be predicted accurately and promptly. Recently, machine learning approaches have popularity in the healthcare industry and have exhibited encouraging results in the diagnosis of certain medical conditions. This paper offers a thorough examination of machine learning methods for bipolar disorder prediction modelling. This study's objective is to look at the potential of cutting-edge machine learning models for more accurate and reliable bipolar disorder prediction. Numerous machine learning techniques, which are not restricted to decision trees, support vector machines, random forests, logistic regression, and neural networks are utilised to develop prediction models. The models are trained and evaluated using a sizable and representative dataset that includes characteristics of those with bipolar disorder, both clinically and demographically.

articleTitle: Detection of Cotton Plants Using the YOLOv7 Deep Learning Model
abstract: Detecting objects in a real environment presents challenges due to fluctuating lighting and diverse object attributes. This study elucidates a deep learning (DL) object detection model for recognizing cotton plants. The DL-driven YOLOv7 model was developed for expedited recognition of cotton plants, leveraging its rapid inference capabilities. Employing a convolutional neural network (CNN), the object detection model was instantiated. The developed object detection was executed in Anaconda software to identify the cotton plants from input images. This advancement holds the potential to automate cotton farming tasks like precise applications, optimized pesticide usage, pest management, robotic harvesting, and targeted weeding. After 100 epochs, the YOLOv7 model achieved bounding box and object loss of 2.12% and 1.32%, respectively. Precision, recall, F1 score, and mAP were determined as 1.00 at 0.696 confidence, 097 at 0.000 confidence, 0.87 at 0.151 confidence, and 0.879 at 0.5 confidence, respectively.

articleTitle: A T-Slot Loaded Wideband Hexagonal Patch Antenna for Modern Radar Systems
abstract: This paper presents a wideband hexagonal patch antenna for radar tracking applications. The hexagonal patch is loaded with a T shape slot to increase the bandwidth. A pair of square slots and slanted edge cuts are incorporated in the ground plane to improve the gain at higher frequencies. The proposed antenna is integrated on an FR4 substrate and has a dimension of 40mm × 40mm. Parametric studies on various antenna geometries have been performed to examine their effects on antenna characteristics. The results reveal that the antenna operates over 2.48 GHz resulting in wide bandwidth of 5.6 GHz. It is also demonstrated that the gain and radiation efficiency in the desired band are better than 3.4 dB and 94%, respectively. The results evident that this design may be suitable for modern radar systems due to wide bandwidth and stable radiation characteristics.

articleTitle: Heart Stroke Prediction using Machine Learning
abstract: The system proposed in this paper specifies. An overlook that monitors stroke prediction. Prediction is done based on the condition of the patient, the ascribe, the diseases he has, and the influences of those diseases that lead to a stroke, early prediction of heart stroke risk can help in timely Intercede to minimize the risk of stroke, by making use of Machine learning algorithms, for stroke prediction. This study aims to develop a machine-learning model that can accurately predict a stroke. The data collected for the study include the clinical and demographic characteristics of the patients. Either had a stroke or are in danger of having one. On the preprocessed dataset, various machine learning models are trained, including logistic regression, decision trees, random forests, and the KNN model, Naive Bayes. Accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score are a few examples of standard assessment metrics that are used to assess each model's performance. The models are also tested using a confusion matrix to determine how well they can distinguish between individuals at high and low risk of having a stroke. Stroke is a leading cause of death worldwide, and early identification of individuals at risk can significantly improve outcomes, and help people be cautious and take preventative measures. Machine learning algorithms have been well suited and their flexibility in predicting stroke risk by analyzing large datasets of patient information. This review provides an outlook on recent research on stroke prediction using machine learning, including the types of data used, the algorithms employed, and the performance metrics reported. Machine learning algorithms have been applied to these data sources to identify patterns and develop predictive models. F1-Score of 96% was achieved in this study using the XGBoost classifier. The applied machine learning algorithms show potential for improving stroke risk prediction, by signifying a pattern, studying the case study, and outlying factors.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Management System for University Lab Equipment Based on RFID Technology
abstract: With the gradual expansion of the scale of running schools in China, the number of laboratory equipments are also increasing, which brings great challenges to the asset management. Most universities still adopt the traditional management mode at present, which wastes manpower and material resources and has low efficiency. Based on the RFID technology of the IoT and compatible with the original asset system, this paper builds an intelligent management system, which can realize the functions of convenient asset storage, quick asset inventory, daily inspection and repair of assets. Can clearly and accurately track and record the detailed information of equipment in and out, effectively prevent the loss of valuable assets. The intelligent and digital management of university laboratory equipment has been realized, which has greatly reduced the workload of experimental managers and improved the level of asset management.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Efficiency of Wallace Tree Multipliers Through Optimized ECSLA Design
abstract: In most digital design arithmetic units, the basic building blocks are adder and multiplier. Multiplier architecture in modern VLSI circuits and digital signal processing must gain the essential parameters of high speed, low power, and small area requirements. Wallace tree multiplier is superior in its performance characteristics such as faster switching speed and requires less power as compared to other multipliers. In this paper, an 8-bit Wallace multiplier is designed using an enhanced Carry select adder (ECSLA) in four stages for the efficient addition of partial products. A multiplier is structured using the Wallace algorithm with an optimized implementation of 4-bit ECSLA in each stage to achieve a minimum propagation delay, lower power consumption, and smaller size. Each ECSLA is formalized with binary to excess-1 (BEC) logic further to meet the requirements of the current scenario. In an average of Conventional array Multipliers, the proposed Wallace tree multiplier achieved a 57% reduction in area, 88 % reduction in delay, 75 % reduction in power, and 97 % reduction in energy.

articleTitle: CNN-based Approach for Classification of Rice Varieties
abstract: Due to its importance as a worldwide staple crop, rice is crucial in guaranteeing the food security of billions of people. Due to a broad range of rice varieties, each of which has specific properties and characteristics, accurate categorization of rice variations is essential for agricultural practices, commerce, and culinary uses. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are an excellent option for tackling the difficulties of rice variety categorization since they have become a potent deep-learning technique. A CNN model for the precise and efficient categorization of rice types is presented in this study. An extensive set of 75,000 images from five different types of rice (Arborio, Basmati, Ipsala, Jasmine, and Karacadag) was assembled for model training and assessment. To facilitate unbiased performance measurement, the dataset was partitioned at random into a training batch of 60,000 images and a test batch of 15,000 images. CNNs can learn hierarchical representations of visual input, allowing them to recognize complex patterns and connections within images, making them ideally suited for computer vision applications, notably image classification. This skill is essential for classifying rice varieties since it allows for detecting minute variations across rice kinds. The research's findings are encouraging because the proposed CNN model had a remarkable accuracy on the test set of 97.31%. This high degree of precision supports the model's outstanding capacity to distinguish between the five annotated classes of rice varieties, demonstrating the promise of deep learning methods in solving complex agricultural problems. The efficacy of this CNN-based strategy will significantly impact the agriculture industry. Accurate rice variety identification gives farmers the flexibility to modify growing techniques per particular needs while maintaining the purity and legitimacy of the final product for the food business.

articleTitle: Robust Gray-Scale Image Watermarkingusing Symlet Wavelet Decomposition using Hybrid Approach
abstract: Amongst digital requirements, gray-scale image watermarking-capacity is the crucial issue that has to be effectively handled. A method of utilizing a blind watermarking scheme to insert a gray-scale image into another gray-scale image of a different size is proposed in order to mark the same. This method achieves a logically good perceptual analogy by measuring the appropriate (PSNR) and (SSIM) index. To extract LL bands, the technique uses sym 4 discrete wavelet transformation at a single level (DWT), where most of the image's features are kept. A trustworthy rectangular matrix of computationally viable areas of the updated image is then obtained using a singular value decomposition (SVD), first utilized to obtain a set of elements sufficient to describe the full image. The technique is resistant to attacks from motion blur, JPEG compression, pepper and salt, Gaussian, speckle, median, and Gaussian lowpass filters, as well as attacks from sharpening and histogram equalization. An increasingly popular strategy for securing copyright protection and identifying data owners is watermarking. The representation of the image determines the watermark embedding techniques, and each domain has its own set of advantages and disadvantages.

articleTitle: TailSafe: A Pig Head-to-Rear Contact Detection System Using Convolutional Neural Networks
abstract: Pig tail biting poses significant challenges in pig farm monitoring, serving as an indicator of underlying pen issues. Existing monitoring methods are limited in their scalability and invasiveness. The goal of the study is to ascertain the capability of the YOLOv5 (You Only Look Once) algorithm with CSPDarknet53 as the backbone in detecting pig heads and pig rears. An exploratory approach to determine the optimal YOLO model training hyperparameters for detection (image size, batch size, epoch) and for interaction (image size and Intersection over Union (IoU) thresholds) was utilized. The detected pig parts will be utilized to determine the presence of head-to-rear contact in pig pen images using the computation of the part's IoU compared to a calibrated interaction threshold. The topmost performing detection model was obtained by the configuration of 600×600 input size, batch size 8 and epoch 100 with highest mean average precision (mAP) at 0.930, 0.929 precision and 0.895 recall. Likewise, it was also the topmost performing model to ascertain interaction with input image size of 500×500 and IoU threshold of 0.05 in the interaction dataset. This configuration generated 76% accuracy, 90% recall, 62% precision, 73% F1-score, and 0.776 normalized Matthews Correlation Coefficient. This study introduces TailSafe, a simple decision support tool utilizing YOLOv5 and convolutional neural networks, enabling farmers to diagnose pig pen issues through potential tail biting outbreaks. TailSafe comprises two components: a detection method to identify pig heads and rears, and an interaction method to compute head-to-rear IoUs for contact identification.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Power, Temperature and Hardware Utilization on Implementation of 4-Bit Comparator
abstract: Several developing nations are experiencing acute energy shortages at present. Due to the research and development of an energy-efficient 4-bit comparator utilizing the Vivado software framework and several FPGA families, environmentally conscious communication has evolved. In search of the most power-efficient FPGA series, two distinct FPGA families, Kintex and Virtex, have been created, each with seven series. The power consumption of the Kintex and Virtex families is 1.007 Watt and 4.009 Watt, respectively. Comparing the temperatures of the Kintex and Virtex, which are 58.1 degrees Celsius and 72.8 degrees Celsius, respectively. Kintex is comparable to other FPGA families in its energy efficiency. This procedure preserves energy for the future. Kintex board is also cheaper than Virtex board.

articleTitle: Linear Polarization Division Multiplexing Based Optical Wireless Communication Incorporating Improved DSP
abstract: Digital signal processing (DSP) is essential for realizing the full potential of multilevel modulation schemes in communication systems. It ensures that signals are reliably detected, corrected, and optimized for various channel conditions, making it possible to achieve higher data rates, improved spectral efficiency, and enhanced overall performance in modern communication networks. In this work, an improved DSP is introduced in the receiver of linear polarization division multiplexed (LPDM) 256-quadrature amplitude modulation (256-QAM) supporting inter-satellite optical wireless communication (IsOWC). Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization procedure (GSOP), time-domain equalization algorithm (TEDA), improved Viterbi algorithm (IVA), and least mean square (LMS) algorithms are employed in improved DSP. The proposed system is compared with the 256-QAM/conventional DSP (CDSP), and LPDM-256QAM/CDSP in terms of log BER. Results revealed that proposed system is highly efficient and covered 26,000 km at 160 Gbps in comparisons to 21,000 using 256-QAM/CDSP and 22,000 with LPDM-256-QAM/CDSP.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Approach to Analyse Sentiment on Social Media
abstract: Scholars have put a lot of effort into sentiment analysis over the last ten years, the computerised extraction of positive or negative attitude statements from text. Alongside developing technologies, the popularity of internet users has been rising quickly. These people frequently share their thoughts on social networks, personal blogs, and online review sites. They hold both favourable and unfavourable opinions on various individuals, groups, locations, occasions, and concepts. We can now begin to sift out social feelings, owing to the capabilities offered by techniques used to process massive amounts of text, such as machine learning and natural language processing. In this study, we explore some of the problems in thought extraction as well as some of the methods used to overcome these difficulties. Beyond just polarity, our approach of studying social media sentiment on Twitter yields insights that are used for product profiling, trend research, and forecasting. Positive outcomes have demonstrated that the strategy may be improved to better serve the requirements of the corporate environment by sentiment analysis on social media.

articleTitle: Design of a Right Hand Circularly Polarized Antenna Using PIN Diodes for Satellite Applications
abstract: A circularly polarized antenna loaded with PIN diodes is proposed for satellite applications. The antenna consists of double circular rings connected by metallic strips for controlling the frequency ratio between upper and lower frequencies. A pair of L shaped strips are appended in the inner ring to produce right hand circular polarization according to the positions and directions of the PIN diodes (BAP64-02). The antenna is fed by a coaxial probe whose position controls the circular polarization and gives omnidirectional patterns. The antenna features 10 dB impedance bandwidths of 40 MHz and 45 MHz at lower band (1.176 GHz) and upper band (1.575 GHz), respectively. Furthermore, the proposed antenna has axial ratio (AR) d 3 dB in the desired band and a small frequency ratio of 1.33.

articleTitle: A Mediapipe-Based Hand Gesture Recognition Home Automation System
abstract: As one gets older, his/her mobility tends to decrease. Therefore, simple tasks such as getting up to switch the lights on or turning the fan off can become difficult. Thus, it became imperative to create a system which allows them to perform these tasks - a “Hand Recognition based Home Automation System”. Starting with the research unraveled different ways of implementation of the hand gesture recognition. After considering the functionalities and drawbacks of various methodologies, a library called MediaPipe, was the one that resonated best with this project. This paper includes analysis and comparison of various types of models on a hand gesture dataset - HaGRID.

articleTitle: Stock Price Prediction using Deep Learning and Sentiment Analysis
abstract: Shares of publicly traded businesses are traded on the stock market. An accurate prediction of stock price movement produces profits for investors. Due to being dynamic and nonlinear in nature, accurate stock price prediction is very challenging and complex. However, studies in this field demonstrate that the stock price may be forecast with some degree of accuracy. This paper presents a stock price prediction model using deep learning and news sentiment analysis. Firstly, the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) architecture was applied on NIFTY 50 data imported from Yahoo finance (pertaining to March 2017 - March 2022) to obtain the batch/epoch settings that ensured the best performance. Secondly, news sentiment data was imported for the same period and analysed for its polarity and subjectivity, Thirdly, CAT Booster and Random Forests were applied on the finance dataset augmented with news sentiment parameters to predict stock values during March 2022 to April 2023 based on the last closing prices of March 2022. Primary results indicate that the LSTM model with 100 epochs and 6 layers yielded the best prediction accuracy based on past financial trends whereas the CAT Booster model performed marginally better that Random Forest in predicting stock values based on past financial data and news sentiments.

articleTitle: The Framework Using Rerouting and LSTM to Keep an Eye on the 5G Backhaul Network
abstract: Scalability in 5G as well as Multi-access Edge Computing systems may be achieved with the help of SDN. It has been recommended to migrate the data plane elements to share the workload of SDN controllers more evenly. To enable network flows that demand low latency communications, we suggest a proactive load balancing strategy on the SDN control plane, as opposed to the reactive procedures used by most prior research. In order to avoid load imbalances and prepare ahead for data plane migrations, we first predict the demand of SDN controllers. Second, we improve load balancing while adhering to delay limitations by optimising the migration procedures. They are both initially routed through distinct techniques, and the need of activating the reroute mechanism is determined by calculating the movement value of the difference in link utilisation. To anticipate the workload on SDN controllers, we first build two prediction models using LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) techniques. Then, we compute the accuracies and prediction errors of these two systems and compare them. The results show that compared to the ARIMA model, the LSTM framework is 55% more reliable when generating long-term forecasts. After recasting the issue as a non-linear binary algorithm and proving its NPcompleteness, we provide a reinforcement learning technique for deciding which data plane pieces need to be migrated and when, given constraints on acceptable latency. The simulation findings show that the suggested method is quite close to ideal.

articleTitle: Advancing Pneumonia Detection Using Deep Learning
abstract: Deep learning has made significant advancements and transformative contributions to various aspects of the medical field. Its applications range from medical image analysis to diagnosis and prediction of diseases such as pneumonia. A type of infection known as pneumonia is brought on by bacteria, viruses, or fungus. It results in fluid or pus accumulation in the lungs' air sacs, called alveoli, which results in difficulty to breath. Early detection of pneumonia is crucial for avoiding adverse effects, including death. X-ray imaging is the most frequently used method for detecting pneumonia, although there are other methods as well, such as pulse oximetry and CT scans. The primary goal of this work is to create a precise model that aids in the detection of pneumonia and the category which it belongs to i.e., viral Pneumonia, bacterial Pneumonia. As part of the diagnosis, determine pneumonia using chest X-ray pictures. In the proposed work, deep learning Models like Inception V3 and MobileNetV2 are used to leverage their deep architectures and powerful feature learning capabilities to efficiently On the basis of evaluation criteria like accuracy, precision, and recall on the dataset of chest X-ray images, the suggested model's efficacy is then assessed. The existing work for Pneumonia Detection is Convolution Neural Networks (CNN) which achieved an accuracy of 84.12% this accuracy can be improved by the proposed model.

articleTitle: Arduino Based Smart Vacuum Cleaner Robot
abstract: The innovative Smart Vacuum Cleaner Robot, based on Arduino technology, offers an intelligent and cuttingedge solution for automated household cleaning. This abstract offers a concise overview of its remarkable features and functionalities. The primary aim of this state-of-the-art robot is to eliminate the tedious manual vacuuming by employing autonomous navigation and highly efficient cleaning mechanisms. Powered by an Arduino microcontroller, it serves as the robot's central control unit, enabling seamless operation and user interaction. Vital data from proximity sensors, cliff sensors, and floor detection sensors inform its path, allowing it to navigate effortlessly around obstacles, detect drop-offs, and identify various floor surfaces, thereby enhancing its versatility and cleaning effectiveness.

articleTitle: The Deep Transfer Learning for Sensor-Based Human Activity Recognition Using Class Augmentation
abstract: Sensor modality diversity as well as data annotation shortage are common challenges for sensing-based human activity recognizing (HAR) in smartphone settings. In light of this finding, we developed a graph-inspired machine learning strategy for the sensor-based HAR challenges, and we used this strategy to the construction of a deep learning transfer learning machine that provides a preliminary answer to each of these two difficult issues. To accomplish sensorbased HAR tasks, we introduce the Hara-ResTLCNN, a multilayer residue structural integrated graph convolutional neural network (CNN). The results of the experiment on the PAMAP2 as well as mHealth sets of data show that our ResTLCNN is successful at collecting the properties of actions, with median precision of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$98.18{{\%}}$</tex> as well as <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$99.07{{\%}}$</tex>, respectively, similar to existing sensor-based HAR models. Moreover, the ResTLCNN model exhibits superior transferability as well as few-shot learning efficiency in the deep learning transfer trials. Th

articleTitle: Enhancement of Safe Machine Cutting Tool Using Computer Vision
abstract: Metal cutting operations are essential in various manufacturing processes, but they pose significant safety risks to workers. This research project aims to enhance the safety and efficiency of metal cutting operations through the application of computer vision technology. An intelligent monitoring system will be developed, utilizing cameras and image processing algorithms to detect potential safety hazards in real-time. Through a detailed analysis of current metal-cutting practices, a set of safety measures and best practices will be proposed to reduce accidents and injuries. Personal safety equipment, safe work practices, and secure cutting instruments are some of these precautions. To foster a culture of safety, workers and supervisors will receive training on safe cutting practices and hazard identification. The ultimate goal is to promote safe and efficient metal cutting operations while minimizing the risk of accidents and injuries to workers. By leveraging computer vision technology, the project seeks to significantly enhance worker safety by detecting potential hazards in real-time and enabling immediate intervention and corrective action.

articleTitle: Comparing Conventional Machine Learning and Large-Language Models for Human Stress Detection Using Social Media Posts
abstract: Mental stress has become a prevalent concern in today's fast-paced and demanding society, leading to detrimental effects on individuals' mental and physical well-being. Early detection and management of stress are crucial for maintaining a healthy lifestyle and preventing the development of chronic conditions. Stress manifests in various forms, including physiological symptoms, behavioral symptoms, Cognitive symptoms, Physical symptoms techniques have provided promising avenues for automating stress detection and monitoring processes. Earlier work has focused on wearables and physiological data, which are limited due to availability of such devices. One critical source of information relating to people's mental state, wellbeing and stress is the numerous posts made on social media. This provides a low barrier, without needing any special wearables and can provide early indicators of stress. In this paper we compare various machine learning techniques including both specifically trained models and general large language models (LLM), like OpenAI's GPT models that can be used for detecting stress based on user's social media content. We observe that the LLMs achieve very high recall (up to 99%), much higher than the best configured specifically trained conventional ML models (∼83%) with similar or higher precision and overall accuracy.

articleTitle: UAV Based System For Detection in Integrated Insect Management for Agriculture Using Deep Learning
abstract: This abstract describes about a system that uses Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) with high resolution cameras and deep learning algorithms to detect insects in agriculture. This device would make it possible to quickly and precisely detect insects in crops and determine their species and infestation degree . The same technology can also identify other problems affecting crops, like fertilizer shortages or water stress. The deep learning program can find patterns and signs of these problems by examining the images acquired by the UAV, enabling farmers to take appropriate action before serious damage happens. This method has the potential to greatly reduce the time and resources needed for manual crop scouting and monitoring, as well as enhance insect detection precision and lower the use of insecticides. An important factor of using deep learning is not only it detects insects but also classify them into useful and harmful category.

articleTitle: The Face Generation for Emotion Analysis Using Deep Neural Networks
abstract: Facial expression recognition (FER) using deep learning from short training sets remains challenging despite its significance to human-machine interactions. This study provides a unique generative adversarial network approach for transforming expressionless face photographs into those depicting a range of emotions to address the problem of insufficient training data for deep learning for FER. A novel GAN architecture is devised, using a generator with two coding devices with two decoders, two discriminators, and a feature extractor, to combat the distortions and overfitting that may result from training GANs on small training datasets. In order to accomplish this, the proposed GAN architecture makes use of the mechanism of a feature map to discover regional include deviations among images in both the source and target domain, which not only allows it to generate appealing facial expression pictures, but also to preserve the initial signs in input neutral pictures of faces. The suggested GAN was utilised to add photographs with up to seven distinct face expressions to the training dataset, which improved the FER accuracy of the deep neural networks tested.

articleTitle: Harnessing Character-level Dynamics and Word-level Semantics: A New Perspective on Twitter Sentiment Analysis
abstract: In recent years, Sentiment Analysis has emerged as an indispensable component of social media analysis. It not only allows understanding public opinion on various issues, but also aids in monitoring real-time trends and sentiments, critical for domains such as brand management, market research, political campaign management, and crisis management. Central to the effectiveness of sentiment analysis is the extraction of meaningful features from the text data, with sentence embeddings being a vital component in capturing semantic relationships and sentence structures. This paper presents a novel approach to Twitter sentiment analysis that exploits sentence embeddings derived from Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD). DMD, a dimensionality reduction technique, enables us to capture the underlying dynamics of character transitions in tweets and to construct expressive sentence embeddings. The advantage of DMD lies in its ability to represent complex patterns and dependencies within the tweet text, thereby improving the richness of the derived sentence embeddings. Additionally, we investigate the use of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for sentiment classification, harnessing the power of relational modeling in the context of Twitter data. We also delve into word-level analysis with different emotion-based embeddings, assessing their impact on the sentiment classification performance. Our methodology integrates character-level analysis, graph-based modeling, and word-level semantics, providing a comprehensive, multi-layered approach to sentiment analysis on Twitter. Our experiments yield insightful results, highlighting the potential of DMD-based embeddings and the importance of high-quality, context-rich word embeddings in sentiment analysis tasks. These findings contribute to our understanding of sentiment analysis on social media platforms and suggest promising directions for future research in this field.

articleTitle: Multi-Class Alzheimer's Disease Classification Using a Fine-Tuned InceptionV3 Pretrained Model: A Step Towards Diagnosis and Prediction
abstract: Alzheimer's disease is a degenerative neurologic condition that results in brain shrinkage and neuronal death. The most prevalent kind of memory loss also known as dementia, Alzheimer's disease gradually deteriorates thinking and social connections by damaging the brain cells. To facilitate early identification of Alzheimer's disease using brain Magnetic Resonance Imaging, it is important to design an automated method for the identification and classification of this disease. This system ought to have the capability to accurately identify and categorize individuals who exhibit symptoms of dementia. This work is focused on applying the technique of transfer learning by implication of segmented MRI images of the brain for detecting cognitive dysfunction as well as Alzheimer's disease at initial and different stages. This technique involves fine-tuning a convolutional network that has already been trained, specifically InceptionV3 for the classification of the segmented brain images. Alzheimer's dataset, which includes various images of the brain for four different stages of Alzheimer's, has been employed for effective training and testing of the proposed framework. The model displays great accuracy outcomes in categorizing the MRI images of 96.01% with a very low loss of 0.27 along with training accuracy of 96.41% with a loss of 0.24. This research can be further utilized in the medical field for diagnosing Alzheimer in its early stages.

articleTitle: Efficient Congestion Control Through Energy and Traffic-Aware Clustering In Future Wireless Sensor Networks
abstract: When the aggregated capacity of a channel is surpassed by the amount of data flowing across it, a condition known as congestion occurs in wireless sensor networks (WSNs). Because retransmission of every unacknowledged packet is not an optimal solution in terms of energy for resource-restricted sensor nodes, the result is overflowing of the buffer at each receiving sensor node. This eventually leads to a reduction in the packet delivery ratio, the dropping of the packets, and a degradation of the network throughput. Since the routing problem has been shown to be NP-hard and it has been revealed that a heuristic-based method outperforms their traditional counterparts, routing is one of the most common strategies for lowering node energy consumption and boosting throughput in WSNs. In addition, routing is one of the most popular ways for raising throughput. As a result, there is a need for optimum routing solutions for the WSNs of the future, taking into consideration both the energy and traffic factors. This research will only focus on wireless sensor networks (WSNs for short). The suggested protocol will be referred to as Energy and Traffic-aware Clustering for Congestion Control (ETCCC) throughout this article. In graphs compared ETCCC performances with three recent protocol names.

articleTitle: The Study of Artificial Neural Networks and Deep Learning for Weather Prediction
abstract: The Internet of Things, or IoT, is already a crucial component of tomorrow's solutions, from the most advanced manufacturing to the most basic human needs. Everyone is interested in this new technology because it can give inanimate items a new degree of intelligence and automate judgements. Data-intensive apps, however, are more likely to fall victim to cybercriminals. Therefore, researchers are always looking at new ways to make IoT edge nodes securely connected to each other. Affordable and low-power IoT nodes have poorer computing capability, yet this is a necessary tradeoff. However, a secure communication layer is hardwareintensive and resource-intensive. Algorithms for lightweight cryptography (LWC) provide hope for reducing computational complexity without sacrificing security. We evaluate the efficiency of 32 LWC algorithms in comparison to popular algorithms on three different IoT devices (Raspberry Pi Zero W, iMX233 and Raspberry Pi 3,) with the goal of addressing the problem of securing the IoT's underlying network layer. The LWC standardisation procedure has been revised for a second time, and the National Institute of Technology and Standards has chosen 32 authenticated encryptions and their corresponding data algorithms. These algorithms are evaluated for their impact on the embedded systems intended for use as IoT sensor nodes in terms of battery life, random access storage utilization, and implementation period. The research findings will aid future investigations into the best platform and LWC algorithm for Internet of Things use.

articleTitle: Enabling Scalable Applications with Intelligent Distributed Data Processing
abstract: This paper discusses the enabling of scalable programs with smart disbursed information processing. Scaling programs can be challenging, mainly when dealing with massive datasets. Existing scaling answers often rely on conventional database-reliant architectures, which usually require massive manual attempts and significant investments in hardware and software. Clever dispensed information processing offers an alternative technique to scalability. With this technique, facts can be processed successfully and with accelerated degrees of automation using intelligent algorithms and distributed computing. This paper presents a top-level view of the ideas in the back of slick disbursed information processing and examines the benefits and challenges associated with this technique. Key ideas addressed in this paper include using utility-precise AI algorithms, dispensed computing, and data correlations. Sooner or later, the report highlights the critical trade-off between scalability and cost regarding the usage of wise disbursed statistics processing.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis of Multilevel Inverters: Topologies, Control Strategies, and Modulation Techniques
abstract: The capability of multilevel inverters (MLI) to handle high power within medium voltage settings is one of the reasons why they are gaining popularity in today's market. This research was carried out with the intention of providing a comparison of all possible topologies, modulation methods, and control systems. As a result of the high levels of total harmonic distortion (THD) produced by conventional modulating methods, the primary emphasis of this article is on determining which combination of approaches is optimal for each and every MLI application. Phase shifting (PS) carrier-based pulse width modulation, phase disposition (PD) carrier-based pulse width modulation, phase opposition disposition (POD) carrier-based pulse width modulation, and alternate phase opposition disposition (APOD) carrier-based pulse width modulation are the presented techniques that are evaluated via the lens of total harmonic distortion (THD), which is described and compared. When compared to the other methods, the inverter that utilizes COPWM demonstrates superior performance in terms of obtaining a higher fundamental RMS output voltage.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Recommendation System for Retail Marketing
abstract: In the modern world, online shopping is extensively popular among humanity. People use online shopping for almost all products and services due to the excellent offers and convenience. Nearly every online service provides shopping assistance to its users through recommendation systems. These recommendations will increase the profit and sales of that firm. At the same time, such a system will assist the customers in product selection and gives additional discounts. However, using such recommendation algorithms in retail marketing is a broad area, and the research scope is still open. In this study, we aim to develop a recommendation system for a retail store by promoting online shopping. The study used transaction data from a supermarket to generate association rules using the well-known methods; Apriori and FP-Growth. Also, we used a recipe information dataset to give recipe recommendations through keyword searching. The results demonstrate that recipe recommendations will improve the system's efficiency from time to time. Also, the system will generate intelligent suggestions based on user preferences. Our study will be beneficial for retail stores to maintain a decent relationship with their customers.

articleTitle: Integrated of BMS and MCU Architecture for L1, L2, and L3 Category EVs
abstract: An electric vehicle requires several critical components for operation, including the battery pack managed by a battery management system (BMS) and the electric motor controlled by a motor control unit (MCU). The BMS ensures battery safety and longevity by managing charging, monitoring temperature, and preventing overcharging/discharge, and MCU regulates motor speed/torque for optimal performance. Current vehicle designs typically incorporate separate BMS and MCU units, which can increase complexity, cost, and weight. This project proposes an integrated BMS and MCU architecture for L1, L2, and L3 category electric vehicles, which combines the functions of both units into a single control unit. This project aims to optimize efficiency and reduce costs while maintaining performance and safety standards. The integrated control unit will also function as a vehicle control unit (VCU), providing a user interface for the driver to monitor and control vehicle functions such as speed, battery charge level, and range.

articleTitle: Transforming Automotive Industries Using PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) with Advanced Tools and AutoCode Generation
abstract: Autonomous vehicles are still evolving in Industry 4.0 and moving closer to becoming a reality. As technology advances in the context of intelligent world capabilities for selfdriving cars, systems become more complicated and humans as engineers must employ several techniques to produce a product with fewer flaws. The graphical representation of technological developments is rising quickly over time and will reach its apex soon. Since it is extremely difficult to create a product from zero in this market, developers may benefit greatly from the industry's cutting-edge tools like MATLAB & Simulink for creation, analysis, simulation, testing, and verification. These tools for software development offer excellent solutions at every stage of creating a strong and efficient targeted goal. The selfdriving car and its advancements, including ADAS levels, functional building blocks, smart sensors, sensor fusion capabilities, and the integration of these physical systems with cutting-edge software tools to address problems that arise in the real world, are the focus of this research. Additionally, autonomous cars can use interdisciplinary elements to strengthen them. Finally, we have proposed a strategy that entails building an effective architecture, employing data optimization techniques for efficient data processing, using the V-Model testing and verification cycle for autonomous cars, and integrating Auto Code generation into independent standalone application deployment features.

articleTitle: Regression-Driven Predictive Model to Estimate Learners' Performance through Multisource Data
abstract: Predictive modeling plays an essential role in comprehending and estimating the academic performance of learners within educational environments. This research introduces an innovative approach centered around regression analysis to forecast learners' achievements by harnessing data from various sources. By amalgamating a diverse array of data, including demographic particulars, previous academic records, lifestyle behaviors, forum participation, and engagement metrics, a holistic examination of factors influencing performance is achieved. The core of the predictive model is built on regression analysis, which capitalizes on the relationships between predictor variables and the target variable to establish a predictive framework. The methodology includes data collection, preprocessing, dataset partitioning, training using five regression algorithms (Random Forest, XGBoost, k-Nearest Neighbors, Gradient Boosting Regression Trees, and Support Vector Regression), and performance assessment using metrics like Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and, Accuracy. Results unveil insights into combined data-algorithm patterns, highlighting data source impact. Distinct categories' influence underscores data's multifaceted role in model accuracy. This underscores regression-driven models' potential for precise performance estimates, contributing to understanding the complex dynamics that drive successful online learning outcomes.

articleTitle: Drowsiness Detection for Drivers using Hybrid T-Distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding with Convolutional Neural Network
abstract: Drowsiness Detection (DD) is the procedure of identifying signs of drowsiness in individuals, especially in critical situations like driving, heavy machinery operation, or aircraft piloting. Hybrid Bi-directional Long Short Term Memory with Convolutional Neural Network (HBLSTM-CNN) was proposed for driver's DD. At first, an eye dataset was gathered and subsequently subjected to pre-processing using a shape predictor. The pre-processed images are initially analyzed using a BiLSTM to identify the most prominent characteristics, which are subsequently subjected to additional processing in a CNN to serve the purpose of DD. Nonetheless, as the data's dimensionality grows, BiLSTM demands more computational resources, including memory and processing power. So in this paper, Hybrid t-distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding with CNN (Ht-SNE-CNN) is introduced for driver's DD. In Ht-SNE-CNN, t-SNE is utilized for reducing dimensionality because of its inherent simplicity, obviating the requirement to train a sophisticated model. It directly computes a lower-dimensional depiction of the data while emphasizing the preservation of local similarities. This inherent simplicity frequently leads to faster and more direct utilization, particularly when handling high-dimensional data. The reduced data are given as input to CNN for driver's DD. The experimental findings demonstrate that the suggested HtSNE-CNN outperforms HBLSTM-CNN with regard to exactness, precision, and recall for detecting driver drowsiness.

articleTitle: Fostering Precise Tomato Disease Detection: A Novel Deep Learning Approach for Agricultural Sustainability
abstract: Tomatoes play a significant role in daily diets worldwide. India stands out as a leading global tomato producer. However, despite this status, the tomato crop faces escalating challenges due to emerging diseases. While tomatoes offer potential health benefits against various human ailments, safeguarding tomato plants from diverse diseases remains crucial. While prevailing CNN models demonstrate proficiency in disease detection, achieving precise disease identification with minimal computational burden remains a formidable endeavour. This study introduces a novel plant disease detection methodology, coupled with an optimized hybrid deep learning approach, aimed at enhancing detection accuracy. The proposed framework amalgamates cutting-edge deep learning architectures, such as EfficientNet, AlexNet, and VGG16, to categorize plant diseases. This entails a sequential process involving image capture, image preprocessing, segmentation, feature extraction, and disease and endeavours classification through the innovative voting strategy. Evaluation of the method employs diverse metrics, revealing that among the assessed CNN models, EfficientNet leads with an exceptional accuracy of 98.74%. VGG16 follows closely at 97.36%, trailed by AlexNet at 95.57%. This research bears significance in enabling farmers to bolster crop yields and amplify food production, offering early-stage plant disease detection with minimal computational intricacies.

Author Keywords: EfficientNet, VGG16, AlexNet, plant village dataset

articleTitle: Enhancing Phishing Website Detection with Feature Credibility Score and Weighted Threshold using Neural Networks
abstract: Phishing attacks continue to pose a significant threat to individuals and the broader online ecosystem, exploiting sophisticated tactics to deceive users into revealing sensitive information. Leveraging the capabilities of neural networks, which excel at learning from extensive datasets, has shown promised results in detecting these malicious phishing websites. However, during the training of neural network models, they often encounter challenges related to the underrepresentation of certain features, which can limit their overall effectiveness. We introduce a Feature Credibility Score (FCS) and a Weighted Threshold to facilitate the selection of the most appropriate features. Feature Credibility Score (FCS) highlights significant features based on their correlation with the target variable, enhancing the model's interpretability. Meanwhile, Weighted Threshold adapts feature selection according to the dataset's nuances, offering a tailored approach for optimal performance. Together, these advancements address the challenges of overfitting, improve feature selection, and offer a customizable approach to optimizing model performance, ultimately strengthening the cybersecurity defence against phishing attacks.

articleTitle: Quantum Neural Network for Time Series Forecasting: Harnessing Quantum Computing's Potential in Predictive Modeling
abstract: Time series forecasting is a critical problem with applications in various fields, such as finance, energy, and environmental science. While classical machine learning methods have shown significant progress in this domain, the advent of quantum machine learning introduces a new perspective to address the complexities of time series prediction. In this research, we propose a novel Quantum Neural Network (QNN) approach for time series forecasting, leveraging the unique capabilities of quantum computing to capture intricate temporal dependencies and exploit quantum parallelism. By encoding time series data into quantum states and designing quantum circuits for processing, the QNN aims to achieve improved predictive accuracy compared to classical neural networks. Through extensive experiments on diverse time series datasets, we demonstrate the potential of our QNN framework and discuss the future prospects of quantum-powered time series prediction in real-world applications.

articleTitle: Comparing Automated vs. Manual Approaches for Information Retrieval
abstract: This paper compares one-of-a-kind techniques used for statistics Retrieval, mainly automated and guide. Automated procedures use algorithmic methods, internet crawlers, herbal language processing, search engines, etc., to accumulate and prepare facts from the net. Manual strategies rent human judgment for surfing and deciding on relevant records from online sources. The paper evaluates the blessings and downsides of both tactics and concludes that each must be combined to yield pleasing consequences. The benefits of automated methods are better coverage of online content, faster retrieval, and fee effectiveness when used for big-scale research. On the other hand, the guide method gives extra management and versatility, allowing additional specialized search criteria. A hybrid technique, in which manual methods are used to refine the effects of automatic searches, is suggested to yield better consequences. The mixed form is anticipated to be more green and more powerful.

articleTitle: Pre-processing Techniques for Performing Hotel Review Sentiment Analysis
abstract: In recent times, AI researchers have shown an increasing fascination with sentiment analysis, primarily due to its promising potential for profitable commercial uses. The initial stage of text mining in a Sentiment Analysis system involves crucial pre-processing steps. Given the frequent deviations from grammar and spelling norms in textual data, these steps become essential for data refinement. Moreover, prior to commencing the analysis it, pre-processing plays an essential part in standardizing the text. The main target of this investigation is to emphasize the importance of pre-processing techniques and showcase their capacity to enhance system accuracy. The study delves into diverse pre-processing techniques and compares their respective levels of accuracy. This comparative assessment aims to pinpoint the most effective strategies. In addition to a comprehensive evaluation of each method, the study delves into the rationale behind the observed accuracy enhancements. It's widely acknowledged that sentiments are often encapsulated in reviews, as individuals, particularly those who are enthusiastic or socially engaged, tend to articulate their opinions through this medium. Such reviews not only capture the viewpoints of their creators but also encapsulate their emotions. Given the unstructured nature of this textual content, effective handling necessitates the application of pre-processing techniques to prepare the data. Subsequently, the pre-processed data serves as a foundation for feature extraction. Approaches utilized to extract features encompass a range of methods, encompassing Bag of Words (BoW), Term Frequency - Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF), word embeddings, and Characteristics acquired through Natural Language Processing (NLP), such as word frequency and noun enumeration. These techniques constitute only a portion of the diverse methods employed.

articleTitle: Enhancing Security and Resource Optimization in IoT Applications with Blockchain Inclusion
abstract: The rapid proliferation of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has ushered in a new era of connectivity and data-driven applications. However, optimizing the allocation of resources within IoT networks is a pressing challenge. This research explores a novel approach to resource optimization, combining blockchain technology with enhanced security measures, while addressing the critical concerns of time and energy consumption.
