articleTitle: Deciphering Blockchain Networks: Advanced Insights Into Cryptocurrency Transaction Analysis and Network Dynamics
abstract: Blockchain innovation has changed how monetary exchanges are directed, especially in the domain of digital forms of money. This paper dives into the many-sided universe of blockchain networks, offering progressed bits of knowledge into digital money exchange investigation and the hidden elements of these decentralized organizations. As of late, cryptographic forms of money have acquired huge prevalence, drawing in the two financial backers and scientists. To reveal insight into the inward functions of blockchain networks, we utilize a complex methodology that joins information investigation, network hypothesis, and cryptographic standards. Our exploration digs into different features of cryptographic money exchanges, including their namelessness, recognizability, and protection concerns. We investigate novel methods for de-anonymizing exchanges and following assets across the blockchain, revealing insight into the difficulties and valuable open doors for upgrading protection in this space. This incorporates an assessment of exchange affirmation times, network adaptability, and agreement systems. By acquiring a more profound comprehension of these elements, we mean to add to the continuous talk encompassing the versatility and security of blockchain networks.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of MMC Interconnect Converter Based on Adaptive Virtual Synchronous Machine
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the traditional virtual synchronizer control cannot adaptively change the dynamic inertia level of the system according to the frequency change, this paper proposes an MMC interconnect converter control strategy based on adaptive parametric virtual synchronizer. Firstly, a virtual synchronous machine control strategy for MMC interconnect converter is designed based on the principle of power transfer, which utilizes the throughput characteristics of the power supply and load within the AC and DC microgrids to provide inertia for the AC frequency and DC bus voltage; secondly, an adaptive strategy of rotational inertia and damping coefficients is introduced on the basis of virtual synchronous machine control, so that through the adaptive change of the virtual parameters, the system can adjust the dynamic inertia level following the change of frequency, under the prerequisite of guaranteeing the system's steady-state performance. Secondly, the system can follow the change of frequency to adjust the system inertia level, which further improves the dynamic response of the AC frequency and DC bus voltage, and at the same time, improves the inertia level of the whole system in the condition of insufficient power of the microsource or increased load. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed scheme are verified by simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis of Blockchain for Applicability in User Authentication
abstract: With the advent of advanced technologies there has been a spike in the online accounts, which leads to the need of authentication to verify the identity of a user. Authentication is essentials to prevent cyber-attacks. Current technologies possess several loopholes which can be exploited to fake the identity of a user plus the risks associated with centralized authentication system can be easily tackled by using a distributed and decentralized blockchain based solution. Blockchain based user authentication is more safe than traditional system as the records for each user will be stored on blockchain and there will be no need to produce keys or similar data each time when authentication is requested. Blockchain based solution can also resolve issues related to authentication of device identity for secure communication in Internet of Things (IoT) as well as role-based access can be implements.

articleTitle: L-WaveBlock: A Novel Feature Extractor Leveraging Wavelets for Generative Adversarial Networks
abstract: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) have risen to prominence in the field of deep learning, facilitating the generation of realistic data from random noise. The effectiveness of GANs often depends on the quality of feature extraction, a critical aspect of their architecture. This paper introduces L-WaveBlock, a novel and robust feature extractor that leverages the capabilities of the Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) with deep learning methodologies. L-WaveBlock is catered to quicken the convergence of GAN generators while simultaneously enhancing their performance. The paper demonstrates the remarkable utility of L-WaveBlock across three datasets, a road satellite imagery dataset, the CelebA dataset and the GoPro dataset, showcasing its ability to ease feature extraction and make it more efficient. By utilizing DWT, L-WaveBlock efficiently captures the intricate details of both structural and textural details, and further partitions feature maps into orthogonal subbands across multiple scales while preserving essential information at the same time. This streamlined process translates into accelerated results, elevating the overall efficiency of GAN-based image generation. Not only does it lead to faster convergence, but also gives competent results on every dataset by employing the L-WaveBlock. The proposed method achieves an Inception Score of 3.6959 and a Structural Similarity Index of 0.4261 on the maps dataset, a Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio of 29.05 and a Structural Similarity Index of 0.874 on the CelebA dataset. The proposed method performs competently to the state-of-the-art for the image denoising dataset, albeit not better, but still leads to faster convergence than conventional methods. With this, L-WaveBlock emerges as a robust and efficient tool for enhancing GAN-based image generation, demonstrating superior convergence speed and competitive performance across multiple datasets for image resolution, image generation and image denoising.

articleTitle: Drowsiness Detection Using CNN Architecture
abstract: Nowadays, road accidents occur owing to the distractions of people who drives the vehicles by Internal or External factors. Using of Mobile phones and driving continuously for several hours are some of the reasons of driver distraction. Among these, the main distractions faced by drivers are drowsiness. Specifically, a driver turns to sleep while driving causes an accident. Latest studies reveal that approximately 20% of vehicle hits have caused by drowsy drivers. And now, these types of accidents can be detected by using modern software technologies. In that, Deep learning is a category of Artificial Intelligence (AI) concepts, which imitate the way humans, gain certain types of knowledge. Deep Learning plays a vital role in health care industry also. The main characteristic of deep learning is, it can built a model automatically by self-learning. In deep learning, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is a type of deep neural networks, which is applied to investigate visual imagery. In this research work, a CNN model will be built to identify the drowsiness of the driver by observing the driver's face reactions. The driver drowsiness dataset is downloaded from data-flair website and trained with CNN architecture. In this work, an image of driver's face will be captured through web camera and compared with trained images .If matches occur, an alarm will be given to make awareness to the driver and to avoid accidents.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Study of Algorithms for the Analysis of Algorithms
abstract: At the heart of modern computing, lies algorithms, which enable the processing of vast datasets and complex analytical tasks. Having a comprehensive understanding of these concepts is paramount in computer science, finding application in software development, system optimization, and computational theory. We discuss 5 key techniques of analysis in this paper. The 5 key analysis techniques – asymptotic, symbolic, recurrence, data flow and amortized are explored theoretically and graphically. Some well-known algorithms and their implementation are presented under their respective techniques. Asymptotic Analysis examines the Big O notation and its growth rates of algorithms. Amortized analysis addresses the average-case performance of algorithms and presents a method to understand how costly operations are balanced by more efficient ones. Symbolic analysis involves reasoning about program behavior symbolically rather than thorough execution. Data Flow analysis, the final technique explored elucidates how this techniques aids in identifying variable dependencies, dead code, and security risks, making it invaluable for software analysis and optimization. These techniques and their usages and applications are discussed with the aim of facilitating new researchers. This comprehensive study will help the new and expert researchers to provide the wider understanding of analysis techniques. This study is helpful in furthering study of analysis of algorithms.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in Cross-Cultural Studies: Past, Present and Future Directions
abstract: This research gives a thorough bibliometric analysis of 172 publications from the Scopus database with a focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI) in cross-cultural studies. It looks at publishing patterns, illustrious journals, significant writers, organizations, and nations in the industry. The results help researchers choose trustworthy journals for publishing by offering insightful information about this domain's development and tendencies. Future studies can concentrate on creating sophisticated models that properly incorporates AI in understanding different cultures and conducting studies that contributes toward incorporating novel architectures, optimization strategies, and more variables. Emotions and AI sentiments may be more effectively incorporated by combining sentiment research tools, such as natural language processing and social media analysis.

articleTitle: Hybrid Electric Vehicles with V2X Topology and Smart Energy Management: An Overview of Their Potential and Limitations
abstract: Hybrid electric vehicles combine an internal combustion engine and an electric motor, allowing the vehicle to switch between different power sources depending on driving conditions and energy needs. Smart Energy Management System (SEMS)intelligently manages the flow of energy between battery, engine and vehicle to optimize fuel consumption and reduce emissions. Eco-friendly hybrid electric vehicles with SEMS and V2X topology are an innovative solution to reduce the environmental impact of traffic while improving fuel efficiency and vehicle performance. V2X topology can be used for smart energy management system in HEVs with the usage of the vehicle's battery to give energy back to the grid or home, integrating renewable energy sources, and furnishing energy effective routing information to the driver. These strategies can help reduce energy consumption, promote the use of renewable energy sources, and ameliorate the overall energy effectiveness of the HEV. Several key technologies and components are required to make this new eco-friendly hybrid electric vehicle a reality, including efficient hybrid drive systems, advanced energy storage systems and advanced V2X communication networks. Additionally, the vehicle design should incorporate lightweight and aerodynamic materials to further improve fuel efficiency. A comprehensive overview of the parameters that need to be considered for HEV implementation is discussed in this paper. The paper discusses the benefits of HEVs with V2X topology and smart energy management, including increased efficiency, reduced emissions, and improved grid stability. It also highlights the challenges associated with these technologies. The paper concludes that while HEVs with V2X topology and smart energy management have significant potential, further research and development are needed to fully realize their benefits.

articleTitle: A Study of Literature on Deep Learning-Driven Sentimental Evaluation in Text
abstract: Currently being used in many different industries, including medical, agriculture, and business, DL: deep learning) is a rapid-fire, thrilling area of study in natural language processing and image processing in addition This is primarily because utilizing DL has several benefits, including automated feature extraction, processing a huge number of parameters, and more accurate findings. A brief description of SA, text preprocessing requirements, performance indicators, and the function of DL models in SA are given in this study. This paper's major goal is to examine how the DL method may enhance SA's performance in comparison to conventional machine learning techniques for text-based analysis. Text classification may be used for complicated phrases with two opposing emotions that produce two different feelings about the same occurrence since the DL model is more successful for NLP research. We draw the conclusion that by means of a convolutional neural network methodology is more accurate than other methods after analyzing this body of material. The report also demonstrates that employing the DL approach is not the only way to address mixed emotions, broadening the focus of future studies.

articleTitle: The Dynamic Vision Sensor Stereo Vision Calibration Inspired by Biology
abstract: The bio-inspired Dynamic Vision Sensor's (DVS) ability to get event-based vision with excellent temporal precision, a wide dynamic range, and low power consumption is increasing its appeal. Some examples of where this can be useful include in surveillance, robotics, and self-navigating in hazardous or otherwise unpredictable environments. In this research, we explain how to offer event-based vision for 3D reconstruction of dynamic scenes using a pair of fixed DVS in stereo. With an emphasis on cooperative stereo, we propose a new method that can cut the observed average error by over 50% compared to the state-of-the-art. In order to examine the method's sensitivity to parameter modification and to compare it to other methods, we make use of a publicly accessible real-time data collection for stereo event data.

articleTitle: An Energy-Efficient Downlink Resource Allocation In Cellular IoT H-CRANs
abstract: In order to maximize the efficiency with which wireless resources are put to use by many users in an OFDMA network, we investigate the intertwined problems of subchannel assignments and power allocation in this research. To address this non-convex as well as dynamic optimization issue in the presence of co-channel interference, we introduce multi-agent reinforcement learning (MADRL) oriented techniques in contrast to traditional single-agent algorithms. First, we use a multi-agent deep predictable policy gradient (MADDPG) system to dynamically results the transmission strength for each user based on the current channel gain, then we update the weights of everyone neural network in order to optimize the distribution of resources policy and achieve the maximum possible rate for each cell. The convergence and effectiveness of the suggested algorithms are shown by simulation results.

articleTitle: Image Fusion Using Spectral Selective Correlation In Multiband Coding For Medical Image
abstract: Image processing has gained a broader usage for multiple domains in recent time. Advancement in the area of automated diagnosis tool using imaging applications has outcome with advanced methods of information processing and retrieval systems in many real time applications. Preserving detailed information with minimum coefficient representation is a major need in various critical applications such as medical domain. In recent, image fusion has evolved as an approach to develop multi-modality images, which are more informative compared to the conventional medical image representation. Transformed domain multi-modality approach is observed to be a promising solution in recent. Multi-modal fusion is developed based on feature-based technique on transformed information. However, the finer resolutions in transformed domain are observed to be redundant resulting into a processing overhead. The overhead impacts the representation accuracy, and delay decreasing the efficiency of image fusion. To overcome the overhead issue in image fusion approach, this paper outlines a method of spectral correlation in energy level for medical image fusion. Outlined correlative approach process on spectral density and limits the selection of coefficient with minimal loss of information. An adaptive threshold computation for selection of coefficient is proposed. Observations of the proposed approach illustrated a comparatively improved performance in fusion factor, fusion symmetry and entropy measure for medical image processing.

articleTitle: Internet of Things for Sustainable Agriculture
abstract: Agriculture and food security are being threatened by the problems of urbanization, Industrialization, Commercial markets, degradation of soil, insufficient resource, a lack of water, lack of labor, and global warming. Because of this, it is crucial to manage land and water resources sustainably in order to increase production and solve these issues. Here is Smart agriculture implementing the Internet of Things (IoT) that uses advanced techniques and methods by incorporating Artificial Intelligence to solve all the problems to achieve massive changes in agricultural technologies in terms of production, Quality, Quantity, and Security. These reviews aim at various implementations of the IoT in the agricultural field naming as smart agriculture where the Machine Learning and Deep Learning involves. That enhances the agriculture to adopt latest trends, and technology in agriculture.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Public Transportation: Aadhaar- Enabled- Smart Ticketing for Seamless Travel Experiences
abstract: In the realm of public transportation, the process of ticket generation and issuance to higher authorities can be quite cumbersome. At locations like bus stands and railway stations, individuals are provided with a paper ticket by an official, a procedure that typically consumes a significant amount of time, often requiring people to wait in long queues. In the era of digital transformation, the integration of Aadhaar, India's unique identification system, with smart ticketing systems has emerged as a pioneering solution to streamline and enhance the efficiency of public transportation and various other services. Aadhaar, a biometric and demographic database, has become the cornerstone of identity verification in India, and its fusion with smart ticketing technologies has opened new avenues for secure, convenient, and seamless transactions. This paper explores the concept of smart ticketing using Aadhaar card as a travel card using QR code, in this system ticket fare is automatically reduced if the person is senior citizen or physically disabled, also tracks travel history of a person, the proposed system helps in Helps in management of data in transportation departments, finally text message received by the passenger. The integration leverages Aadhaar's robust biometric authentication and digital identity features to create a user-friendly, contactless, and highly secure ticketing system. It enhances user convenience by eliminating the need for physical tickets, cards, or tokens, reducing the risk of loss or theft. Moreover, it fosters transparency and accountability in the ticketing process, curbing fraudulent activities.

articleTitle: The Reinforcement-Learning-Based Adaptive Neighbor Discovery Algorithm for Data Transmission Enabled IoT
abstract: The Doppler effect, severe multipath, as well as fluctuating impulse response all contribute to the unfavorable temporal unpredictability of the passageway circumstances in underwater systems. In these cases, energy efficiency is of utmost importance since nodes' battery are permanent and are unable to be swapped out. Therefore, in this study, we provide a reinforcement learning strategy for submerged multichip networks of communication with the goal of extending network lifespan and improving the efficiency of underwater channel broadcasts. The relay device may choose the most effective next hop node to transfer data toward a distant gateway device, which can then connect to the terrestrial internet, thanks to the proposed method's use of a Markov undersea channels theory to describe the link state. It is shown via simulation results that the suggested strategy reduces energy usage and improves latency effectiveness, extending the lifespan of the system.

articleTitle: Robust Face Detection and Identification using HOG-based Features and Machine Learning
abstract: This paper focuses on integrating face recognition into educational websites. The method involves webcam data collection from three subjects, followed by preprocessing steps like resizing, grayscale conversion, histogram equalization, and median blur. The Haar Cascade Classifier aids real-time face detection, while the Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) facilitates feature extraction, yielding around 15,000 features per image. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is applied for dimensionality reduction. The study evaluates classifiers: Logistic Regression, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Random Forest (RF), and Support Vector Machine (SVM), with Logistic Regression achieving 99.54% accuracy. This comprehensive approach enhances website security and user experience, showcasing the synergy of preprocessing, advanced feature extraction, and effective classification for robust face recognition. Future prospects involve deep learning integration, real-time processing, and adaptability enhancement.

articleTitle: Traffic Aware Clustering for Congestion Control in Future Wireless Sensor Networks
abstract: As data traffic exceeds the total capacity of the channel, congestion in wireless sensor networks (WSNs) has become a pressing problem in the current setting. Overflowing the buffer at each receiving sensor node causes packet drops, decreases the packet delivery ratio, and degrades the throughput of the network because retransmitting each unacknowledged packet is not an optimal energy solution for resource-constrained nodes. One of the most popular methods to reduce node power consumption and increase throughput in WSNs is routing, which is based on heuristics rather than algorithms because the routing problem is NP-hard and heuristics work better than traditional approaches. Considering the connection energy, packet loss rate, and congestion level, the forward ant constructs a number of congestion-free paths from the source to the sink node, and the backward ant calculates the number of successful paths traveling from the sink to the source node. When determining the best route to take, Huffman coding takes into account the percentage of packets dropped along each of several possible routes found through ant colony optimization. Ultimately, simulation findings show that the proposed approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods with respect to average energy consumption, latency, throughput, and packet delivery ratio.

articleTitle: Maximum Bandwidth Allocation in Underwater Fibre Optic Networks
abstract: This paper offers an overview of the most Bandwidth Allocation hassle in underwater fiber optic networks. The bandwidth in optical fiber networks is traditionally allotted according to the users' needs for the guaranteed satisfaction of the carrier (QoS.). However, because of the specific characteristics of Underwater Optical Fiber Networks and the constrained capability of the hyperlink, it is miles necessary to layout exceptional bandwidth allocation algorithms for allocating frequencies reusing the subsea optical fiber network efficiently and looking forward to the wishes of a couple of users. While traditional techniques treat all users equally, the maximum Bandwidth Allocation algorithm does not forget traits like a priority, call for size, occupancy element, and others to allocate the available bandwidth for this reason. This paper opinions the distinctive methods of the most Bandwidth Allocation trouble and their application for Underwater Optical Fibre Networks. Furthermore, it offers numerous scenarios to acquire the premier wide variety of slots for allocating customers based on their priority and demand size. The paper also presents specific techniques for allocating and adapting the to-be-had network slots to meet customers' changing needs. This paper demonstrates the promising performance of the most Bandwidth Allocation set of rules compared to conventional algorithms, showing the desire to customize those procedures for precise packages, including UOFN.

articleTitle: Protecting the Cyberphysical System Against Intrusion Dection
abstract: As CPS applications have a growing influence across a wide range of industries, CPS security has emerged as a crucial area of study. CPS security calls for a different approach than conventional IT security due to the interdependence of cyber and physical elements. As part of our comprehensive CPS security methods, we offer a federated learning-based threat detection technique in this study. First, we design a convolutional neural network with a gated recurrent unit to provide a novel deep learning-enabled intrusion detection method for industrial CPSs. To build an advanced intrusion detection system without sacrificing individual data privacy, Our second contribution is the development of a federated learning structure for use by a wide variety of industrial CPSs. To further ensure the safety and confidentiality of model parameters during training, a secure communication protocols is developed using the Paillier cryptosystem. Extensive tests on a real-world industrial CPS data set demonstrate the CNN-GRU scheme's superiority over cutting-edge methods and its high effectiveness in recognising various cyber-attacks against industrial CPSs.

articleTitle: The Wireless Sensor Network Communication Coverage
abstract: A coverage issue in wireless sensor networks (WSNs) measures how well nodes that sense monitor an organization field. This issue has garnered attention throughout the years, prompting different covering procedures. First, the method locates Focus Target Nodes (FTNs) as well as utilizes the Genetic method (GA) to design node paths. Second, mutation and configurable cutoff factors govern event domains nodes. Optimizing clustering renders node grouping uniform throughout, improving global target node search and reducing energy usage. Third, the adaption function ensures goal position consistency and node monitoring range. To increase network coverage and lifespan, optimization is done. Finally, simulation findings demonstrate that the suggested method outperforms the other three methods used in the present study by 11.27% and 16.35% in network coverage, lifetime, etc., as well as 13.95% in network energy overhead, proving its stability and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing National Security: An Analysis of Quantum Computing's Impact on Government and Defense
abstract: A new paradigm in computing called quantum computing has the potential to change many industries, including the military and government. The purpose of this study is to examine the applications, opportunities, difficulties, and prospects of quantum computing in these fields. The paper provides a comprehensive introduction to quantum computing, highlighting its distinctions from conventional computing, and discussing a range of quantum computing technologies. It examines the present and foreseeable uses of quantum computing in government and defense, including high-performance computing, cybersecurity and encryption, intelligence and surveillance, and logistics. Additionally, it looks at how quantum computing might advance national security, facilitate better decision-making, and speed up research and development. Also, it discusses issues with quantum computing, such as its exorbitant cost, security issues as well as a trained personnel shortage. The paper concludes by examining the potential applications of quantum computing in these fields, including their integration with conventional computing systems, the research and development of quantum technologies, public-private sector partnerships, and their potential to spur innovation and alter military and governmental operations. The report comes to the conclusion that, despite the difficulties, quantum computing holds great promise for transforming the public and defense sectors. More research and development are essential to accomplish this promise.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Classification Using ResNet-50
abstract: One of the most common cancers that is impacting a lot of individuals is brain cancer. The illness now poses a threat to life. Early detection is important to make life-saving interventions. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is a powerful tool for detecting various brain abnormalities and is widely utilized by radiologists and physicians. We have proposed a Deep Learning-based convolutional neural network technique to identify different types of brain cancers. The proposed model makes use of larger datasets with five classes (meningiomas, gliomas, pituitary, Neurocitoma, Schwannoma tumors). It is based on a Residual Network (ResNet-50), and it is designed with a specific architecture for identifying complex data features. This approach aids medical professionals in deciding if a disease is present or not. Based on Deep Learning technology, it provides a more precise, efficient, and quick way to identify brain tumors. The proposed approach achieves an accuracy of 99.08%. The experimental findings show how effective the suggested strategy for BT multi-class categorization is.

articleTitle: The Use of Game Theoretic Based Algorithms for Dynamic Resource Allocation in Vehicular Cloud Computing Systems
abstract: The broad use of virtualization of hardware, service-oriented architecture, autonomic and utility computing, and the availability of inexpensive processors and storage devices have all contributed to the expansion of cloud computing. Now that we live in the age of cloud computing, all autonomous vehicles may communicate with one another to increase travel security and motorist convenience. Collecting and storing massive volumes of data on traffic is a major difficulty posed by the idea of fully linked automobiles. We suggest combining cloud computing along with vehicular networks so that cars may pool their processing power, data storage, and communication channels. The suggested design has three clouds: one in each vehicle, one along the road, and one in the middle. To efficiently divide up cloud assets, a game-theoretic strategy is introduced. Resource reservation is used as a solution for virtual machine migration caused by vehicle movement.

articleTitle: Image to Text: Comprehensive Review on Deep Learning Based Unsupervised Image Captioning
abstract: The task of image captioning has seen considerable success using deep neural networks. This assessment offers a thorough overview of the most cutting-edge approaches for deep learning-based unsupervised image captioning. In order to bridge the gap between computer vision and natural language processing, the effort of creating meaningful textual captions for images is known as image captioning. Without using annotated image-caption pairings for training, unsupervised approaches try to provide captions. The review examines a variety of techniques, including generative adversarial networks (GANs), pre-training, transfer learning, and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for extracting visual features, as well as recurrent neural networks (RNNs) or transformer models for language modelling. Researchers and practitioners can benefit from this survey's observations, classification of methodologies, and recommendations for the future of deep learning-based unsupervised image captioning.

articleTitle: Generative Adversarial Networks for Self-Supervised Transfer Learning in Medical Image Classification
abstract: Self-supervised transfer mastering for clinical picture analysis is a method that uses deep getting-to-know procedures to research large units of medical imaging facts without using guide labels. By way of using switch getting to know, the version can come across diffused patterns from the facts that are not easily located with the aid of the medical doctors or researchers. This method can diffuse clinical imaging packages consisting of type, segmentation, and item detection. The self-supervised transfer studying technique involves educating an artificial intelligence (AI) model on a set of scientific picas with available labels. The version is then tested on a set of clinical pix that have not been visible before, and the AI version then adjusts its parameters to come across styles and functions that the labels may have neglected. The advantage of the use of self-supervised transfer getting to know for medical image analysis is that it gets rid of the need to spend time creating labels for the photos and, as a substitute, allows the model to study themselves. Further, the model can detect small capabilities and patterns that may be ignored through manual labeling, leading to more excellent correct outcomes…

articleTitle: Exploring Smart Cities: Definitions, Advantages, Challenges, and Security Considerations for Urban Transformation
abstract: The concept of “smart cities” has gained a lot of attention in recent years as urban regions struggle with issues including population development, resource management, and environmental sustainability. The goal of this research paper is to give a thorough introduction to the idea of smart cities by examining their definition, essential elements, and prospective advantages. Smart cities aim to improve quality of life, encourage economic growth, and guarantee resource efficiency by utilizing cutting-edge technologies and data-driven solutions. This paper also covers the difficulties and factors to be considered when putting smart city ideas into practice and provides prominent global examples. The paper also examines security attacks, their asset-related threats, and proposes countermeasures, and will provide a thorough understanding of smart cities, setting the groundwork for future research into how they might change urban ecosystems.

articleTitle: Machine Learning in the Quantum Era
abstract: Machine Learning (ML) has been extensively utilized in various scientific and engineering domains. But the inherent constraints and computational complexity that arise in classical machine learning are particularly evident when dealing with large-scale, high-dimensional datasets or when attempting to solve intricate optimisation problems. Quantum systems exhibit unconventional patterns that are typically not effectively generated by traditional systems and can also tackle high dimensional and large size datasets efficiently. Therefore, it is believed that quantum computing systems may outperform traditional computing devices in machine learning tasks. Quantum Machine Learning (QML) has emerged as a rapidly developing field that combines the concepts of quantum mechanics and machine learning to solve complex problems across various disciplines. The domain of quantum machine learning investigates the development and execution of quantum software with the potential to facilitate machine learning at a much superior pace compared to traditional computers. However, the major challenges encountered are hardware limitations, noise, and development of quantum algorithms. The objective of this paper is to provide an insight on the foundational principles, essential algorithms, various associated platforms, potential applications and challenges being faced by QML. As data continues to grow in size and complexity, together with the emergence of nonlinear and high-dimensional real-world situations, the computing benefits offered by QML have the potential to facilitate significant advancements in the fields of healthcare, finance, robotics, logistics, communication, and cyber security. This paper presents the basis for future research work related to development of quantum algorithms in the domain of machine learning.

articleTitle: Monitoring of Mangrove Ecosystem Area for Coastal Region of Mumbai
abstract: Remote sensing is an important way to gather information about the Earth's surface and atmosphere. It has a wide application in environmental monitoring and scientific research. One of the data obtained from remote sensing are multispectral images. In this research paper, these multispectral images of the Mumbai coast's mangroves are examined. Mangroves are shrubs that grow in coastal regions and play an important role as they provide an infrastructure for habitation by holding the soil near water reducing high tides. By calculating the area of mangroves, we can identify the areas that may be at risk of degradation or loss. In remote sensing, observations can be obtained from multispectral images through vegetation indices. The vegetation index helps us to bifurcate greenery from other objects. The most useful vegetation index of all the other vegetation indices is the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), as it is highly sensitive to changes in vegetation density and can detect vegetation dynamics over time. NDVI values are very useful for determining different objects such as crop fields, trees, residential areas, rocky areas, muddy areas, and watery areas. The Hue Saturation Value (HSV) color space is being used over the Red, Green, Blue (RGB) image, as this color space makes it easier to adjust color thresholds, filters, and other image processing operations. This paper describes the area detection of sparse mangroves through satellite images using the NDVI and HSV color spaces.

articleTitle: Enhancing Efficiency and Security in Transport and Trucking Firms through Co-operative Intelligent Transportation System
abstract: Global frugality depends on the transportation and trucking industry to carry out the efficient movement of products and goods. However, problems like functional inefficiencies and security concerns keep this diligence disturbed. The proposed system aims to create an integrated Cooperative Intelligent Transportation System (C-ITS) that will improve security and efficiency in transportation and trucking businesses in order to tackle these issues. The study work consist of two modules address the allocation and deallocation of vehicles to drivers and the maintenance of gate passes for loaded cars. A comprehensive approach supports the investigation, comprising a theoretical framework, a review of the literature, and a practical application. Data collected during the allocation and allocation process, along with the creation of gate passes, are used to measure the effectiveness of the recommended modules. The module s highlight the potential to improve efficiency, boost security, and simplify internal operations in trucking and transportation firms. Achieving the maximum benefit from Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) requires making the best effective use of the equipment that is being built and the vast amount of data that it provides. We suggest that the design and management of transportation networks particularly benefit greatly from the application of operations research. The focus of the paper is on Advanced Fleet Management Systems, Electronic Business, City Logistics, and Freight ITS. The study work discusses the main challenges, technical obstacles, and achievements before showing how improved operations research-based decision-support software could significantly improve Freight ITS performance over time.

articleTitle: Text to Photo-Realistic Image Synthesis using Generative Adversarial Networks
abstract: Innovative design patterns have traditionally been constrained by time-consuming and expertise-intensive methods, limiting diversity and creativity in design. To overcome these challenges, our research focuses on revolutionizing the design process by leveraging Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs). Our goal is to offer an affordable and cutting-edge solution that enables the creation of unique design patterns based on user input text. By harnessing the power of GANs, we can generate high-resolution images, reducing the reliance on expensive designers and fostering creativity and idea generation in the design sector. Our methodology involves building upon a diverse dataset of sunflower images and associated text data borrowed from the Oxford-102 flowers dataset. We meticulously collect, clean, and normalize this dataset to ensure optimal training. U sing an encoder-decoder architecture, we train a GAN -based generative model to produce remarkable sunflower patterns. To enhance usability, we have developed a user-friendly graphical user interface (GUI) that allows users to input text and receive corresponding sunflower images seamlessly. Our current model has exhibited promising results, achieving an inception score of 3.45 ± 0.05 in generating sunflower patterns. These outcomes demonstrate the feasibility of our approach, which not only reduces design costs but also fosters innovation and ingenuity within the industry. By making this solution publicly accessible, we aim to support local businesses and individuals with limited finances in creating distinctive design patterns.

articleTitle: Tuning in to Personalized Music: A Spotify API-Based Hybrid Recommendation System Integrating Content-Based and Popularity-Based Approaches
abstract: This research paper offers a comprehensive approach for constructing a successful music recommendation system that integrates popularity- and content-based approaches. The suggested method intends to improve music discovery for users in an era of expansive music libraries and personalized user experiences. It makes use of the Spotify API to compile thorough track data and employs data preparation methods to guarantee data quality. The recommendation engine is the center of the research. Song recommendations are personalized by a content-based algorithm that bases them on aural features. In addition, a hybrid model balances user preferences and trending music by weighting track popularity by release date. A user-friendly GUI is included to make it easier for users to interact, allowing users to input their favorite music and get recommendations right away. Although the code serves as the basis for a strong recommendation system, later versions can include performance criteria for evaluation, such as accuracy, precision, and recall. This study contributes to the constantly developing field of music technology and user pleasure by providing a foundation for the improvement of music recommendation systems.

articleTitle: PySpark-Powered ML Models for Accurate Spam Detection in Messages
abstract: The process of text classification for the purpose of spam detection relies on the principles of natural language processing (NLP) with the objective of automating the identification and categorization of messages into either spam or ham classifications. Our research endeavor involves the determination of the optimal machine learning model that yields the highest accuracy in segregating undesired messages or emails. The procedure for text classification was executed through the utilization of PySpark, employing a variety of machine learning algorithms such as Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine, Decision Trees, and Random Forest. The dataset used for the experiments was sourced from Kaggle, a publicly accessible repository. In order to rectify data imbalance, Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE) was employed to ensure an equal representation of both spam and ham instances. The outcome of our study prominently designates the support vector machine (SVM) as the most precise machine learning model, demonstrating an F1 score of 97.93 and an accuracy score of 97.9.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning with Fuzzy Inference System for Prediction of Crop-sowing Windows
abstract: Advanced farming techniques leverage Internet of Thing (IoT)-compatible crop monitoring to collect real-time data on crop conditions, enabling precision agriculture by optimizing resource usage and enhancing decision-making for increased crop yield and sustainability. An IoT monitoring system was instrumental in analyzing data on the correlation between crop yield, weather parameters, and insect reproduction, revealing the environmental factors conducive to increased pest breeding conditions. An Optimized Fuzzy Inference System (OFIS) was proposed for IoT-compatible crop monitoring to identify the crop-sowing window. In the beginning, a wireless sensor network was set up in the field to collect meteorological information, which was then evaluated using a Fuzzy Inference System (FIS). Within this analysis, optimization of linguistic variables was achieved through the utilization of a Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithm (MOEA). However, MOEA computationally expensive and require more manual parameter tuning to fine tune the linguistic variables in FIS. So in this article, Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) is introduced which adapt and learn complex linguistic variable optimizations with minimal manual parameter tuning, making it more versatile and potentially efficient for FIS optimization. DRL, a sub domain within machine learning, integrates Deep Neural Networks (DNN) with reinforcement learning techniques. Within the realm of DRL, an agent engages with its surroundings, makes decisions, gains rewards, and gradually refines its actions for optimization. The experimental results prove that the proposed DRL-FIS has high accuracy, True Positive (TP) rate and low False Positive (FP) rate than OFIS for identification of cropsowing window.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network Combining Image Augmentation and Regularization Techniques for Retinal Detachment Prediction
abstract: Retinal Detachment (RD) is a serious ophthalmology disorder that can lead to complete blindness if not treated on time. The ophthalmologist will advise laser surgery, freezing treatment, or another type of surgery depending on the amount of retinal-detected. Early detection can increase the chances of successful retinal reattachment. This work investigates the role of the Convolutional Neural Network for feature extraction and classification of images into RD and non- RD fundus images. In this paper, we have tested the performance using augmentation and regularization techniques; hence, the authors used dropout and early stopping methods for regularization in retinal detachment prediction. In evaluating original datasets, the dropout regularization method gives better statistical metrics in terms of accuracy, specificity, precision, and F1 score values of 97.94 %, 99.00%, 98.52%, and 97.43% respectively. This study would enhance mechanisms to detect and recognize them for further clinical decisions.

articleTitle: The Defending Mobile Ad Hoc Networks from Anonymity Threats with an Identity-less, OnDemand Routing Scheme
abstract: We call a network that can be rapidly formed and rearranged on the fly a “mobile ad hoc network” (MANET). Because of its decentralized administration and lack of stable infrastructure, this sort of network design is best suited for temporary connections. It is challenging to offer quality of service (QoS) and safety-aware routing in such a network because of its unstable architecture and limited resources. The basic objective of safe and trust-based immediately multiple routes transportation is to find a route from origin to target that fulfills at least two end-to-end QoS requirements. Using a variant of the widely used ad hoc ondemand multiple-pathway distance vector technique, this study assesses the idea. The researchers provide a mesh-based multipath navigation system for effective communication in MANET, complete with a secure nearby position trust validation mechanism and a superior link optimum route search using the Dolphin Echolocation Algorithm. Our suggested routing protocol has been shown to improve packet delivery percentage, packet latency, overheads, and security against attacks and weaknesses in both analytical and numerical evaluations of its performance.

articleTitle: A Comparative Review of Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) in 4G and 5G Networks: Advancements, Challenges, and Future Directions
abstract: The rapid evolution of mobile communication networks has ushered in the era of 5G, characterized by enhanced data rates, ultra-low latency, and massive Internet of Things (IoT) connectivity. This review paper examines the performance of Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) in 4G and 5G networks. It focuses on the advancements and challenges specific to 5G, including increased bandwidth, advanced modulation schemes, and dynamic spectrum allocation. The paper explores enhancements in 5G TCP mechanisms, such as improved congestion control and lowlatency design. It reviews existing literature on TCP performance in both 4G and 5G networks, highlighting improvements and considerations for 5G. Challenges in deploying TCP over 5G, such as increased signaling overhead and legacy system compatibility, are discussed. The paper identifies areas for further research to enhance TCP performance in 5G networks.

articleTitle: NexGuard: Industrial Cyber-Physical System Défense Using Ensemble Feature Selection and Explainable Deep Learning Techniques
abstract: In recent years, industrial cyber-physical systems (ICPS) have advanced rapidly, resulting in sophisticated and intelligent networks of industrial devices and systems. These networks, while offering increased efficiency and interconnectivity, have become susceptible to sophisticated cyber threats. Traditional intrusion detection systems (IDS) fall short of effectively identifying and mitigating these challenges due to the multifaceted nature of modern attacks and the complexity of ICPS. This paper introduces an explainable AI-based intrusion detection system (XAI-IDS), specifically designed to enhance security in ICPS. The purpose of this study is to propose an ensemble-based filter feature selection method (EFFS) for selecting the most relevant features and then use Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) to evaluate the impact of the different features on the prediction. Additionally, we utilise an optimised classifier based on GRULSTM to determine intrusions into the ICPS network and classify attacks efficiently. We use Bayesian optimisation as the hyperparameter optimizer to fine-tune the GRU-LSTM model. Furthermore, our approach improves previous systems in attack detection accuracy, false-positive rate, and computational complexity.

articleTitle: Building Intelligent Automated Real-Time Data Analysis Systems Through Machine Learning
abstract: This paper explores the capacity of using gadget-get-to-know-based facts evaluation structures to build intelligent, automated real-time statistics analysis systems. It examines the demanding situations present points evaluation systems pose and proposes a unique remedy. The proposed method leverages supervised and unsupervised devices and learning strategies to enable deep information on complex datasets. It then makes use of predictive skills to make clever selections with the aid of comparing input facts about databases. ultimately, the paper describes a case to demonstrate the effectiveness of this proposed machine and outlines implications for comparable implementations in the enterprise. This work is precious for information scientists and commercial enterprise decision-makers, as it outlines an ability to deploy reliable and accurate records analysis structures.

articleTitle: Robust Criminal Identification System for Recognition of Obscure and Hidden Faces
abstract: This study delves into the development and implementation of Robust Criminal Identification System for Recognition of Obscure and Hidden Faces utilizing a fusion of the Haar Cascade Classifier and LBPH Face Recognizer. The methodology encompasses three fundamental phases: data collection, training, and real-time testing. During data collection, diverse facial images, including specific regions like eyes, nose, mouth, and the entire face, are sourced from webcams, existing image repositories, and video streams, employing the Haar Cascade Classifier for efficient face detection. Following this, the LBPH Face Recognizer is utilized to build a recognition model trained on a dataset associating grayscale facial images with criminal IDs. In the real-time testing phase, the model is applied to video streams for face detection and recognition. The system presents recognized names and associated confidence scores, rendering it a valuable tool for law enforcement and criminal identification. Notably, a significant advancement and the novelty of this project lie in its capability to accurately detect faces even when individuals are wearing glasses or masks, enhancing its practicality and efficiency in real-world scenarios. The project achieves a commendable accuracy rate of 92.56%, showcasing the potency and reliability of this combined approach. This study underscores the harmonious integration of these two algorithms, offering a practical, accessible, and highly effective means to bolster public safety and security through the Facial Detection & Recognition-based Criminal Identification System.

articleTitle: Touchless User Interface for Sketching Using Hand Gesture Recognition
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) technologies have a significant impact on developments in research and creative processes. With the quick development of computer vision, the extensive need for interaction with machines and humans is growing. Hand gesture recognition is often used in intelligent furniture, robot control and other meaningful use gestures using hand can be represented to give meaningful data or information. With current development in computing, the traditional writing and teaching methods are insufficient because it still uses mouse, keyboard, and touch pens. This paper proposes a solution by creating a Touchless User Interface (TUI). TUI uses hand gestures to sketch on the air without using the keyboard or mouse which is captured and reflected on the screen. The app developed for the same consists of tools such as circles, rectangles, lines, freehand drawing, and eraser which can be selected and drawn in the air, the system captures the respective shape or structure and reflects it on the screen. Human hands may be split from a complex background and identified in real time which is done using convolutional neural network. Thus, touchless user interface is developed with experimental accuracy of 98.48%.

The suggested approach was tested using typical benchmark datasets and yielded encouraging results. Because the system can create natural language captions and convert them to voice, it May be used in diverse applications, consisting of media accessibility & assistive technology.

articleTitle: EDUC: Early Detection of Ulcerative Colitis Using Efficient Net B2 Model
abstract: Ulcers tend be a sign of a number of dangerous conditions that impact the digestive system in humans. In order to identify and treat ulcers, particularly those in the small intestine that are difficult to see with traditional techniques, wireless capsule endoscopy is widely used. Because wireless capsule endoscopy produces a significant number of images throughout the inspection process, doctors view computer-aided ulcer identification as a lifesaver. In this work, an Efficient Net B2 model is developed with SGD and RMSProp optimizer to detect ulcerative colitis diseases to improve quality of life. The wireless capsule endoscopy picture dataset is used by the Efficient Net B2 model classification model to extract the key features, which it then divides into four groups, including “normal or healthy lives,” “esophagitis,” “polyps,” and “ulcerative colitis.” The performance of the developed classifier model is evaluated based on accuracy. The performance of the Efficienet B2 classifier with RMSProp optimizers achieves 92.63% accuracy and EfficientNetB2 with the SGD optimizer achieves accuracy of 94.63%.

articleTitle: Answer Type Prediction: Unveiling the Power of Deep Learning Models
abstract: Answer type prediction plays a crucial role in natural language question answering systems, enabling the generation of relevant SPARQL queries, a query language for retrieving data from RDF databases. This research paper focuses on answer type prediction for SPARQL query generation. Answer type prediction involves identifying the expected type of the answer to a given question, such as a person's name, a location, or a numerical value. By accurately predicting the answer type, the subsequent SPARQL query generation process can be tailored to retrieve the desired information from a knowledge base. The proposed work evaluates the performance of four deep learning models, which include GRU (Gated Recurrent Unit), Bi-GRU, LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory), and Bi-LSTM. The study's conclusion highlights GRU as the top-performing model for predicting the answer type based on the analysis of input natural language queries. The performance of the answer type prediction model is evaluated on a publicly available dataset, demonstrating its effectiveness in achieving an accuracy of 81% using GRU. The results obtained from the study emphasize the importance of accurate answer type prediction and provide promising outcomes.

articleTitle: Secure Communication for Healthcare Using Homomorphic Encryption: A Comparative Study
abstract: Cryptography is a branch of engineering that deals with sending information in a secured manner [1,2]. In the traditional cryptography, the message to be encrypted is called as plain text and the encrypted information is called as cipher text. After the successful transmission of information in a secured manner, the receiver decrypts the information for further processing. However, some security sensitive applications like healthcare demands a higher degree of security. Advancements in the modern cryptographic systems facilitated to process data without actually decrypting it. This would overcome the possibility of a third party to leak the sensitive information, as third party like clouds are relied for processing the information. Homomorphic encryption is a special class of cryptography wherein the data is processed in the encrypted domain itself. This adds to degree of security assured and can be highly useful for privacy preserving applications like voting, rating, healthcare etc. In this paper we have made an attempt to study and compare three popular homomorphic encryption schemes where the data is encrypted and the processed in the encrypted domain.

articleTitle: Optimizing Heat Sink Size for a Given Heat Source
abstract: In the context of a heat sink employed to dissipate heat from a source, thermal energy transfers from the heat source to the heat sink's base through conduction. From there, it moves toward the fins, where it is further transferred to the cooling fluid primarily through convection and, to a lesser extent, through radiation. As the base size of the heat sink is increased relative to the contact area of the heat source, the conductive resistance diminishes. Moreover, enhancing the surface area results in a greater rate of convective heat transfer. Therefore, larger heat sinks with more mass and a higher surface area can dissipate more heat through conduction and convection. However, the rate of heat dissipation increases at a diminishing rate with increasing size and may become uneconomic beyond a certain point. In many situations, it is challenging to have a significantly larger heat sink (in terms of base size and fin height) than the size of the heat source due to space and weight limitations, and the coolant pumping costs. While this concept is intuitive and supported by established theories, it is necessary to investigate how increase in heat dissipation the relationship between the increase in heat dissipation rate and the increase in size to optimize it for a given context. Unfortunately, this relationship has received scant research. This study aims to explore this relationship, optimizing heat dissipation rate while minimizing weight and pressure drop for a given context. Copper heat sinks with square bases of various sizes were employed, using deionized water as coolant. Simulation results indicate that increasing the base size initially boosts the heat dissipation rate, but beyond a certain point, the increase becomes insignificant and economically unfeasible.

articleTitle: Driver Drowsiness Detection using OpenCV and DLib
abstract: The proposed system aims to enhance transportation safety by reducing the occurrence of accidents caused by driver fatigue and drowsiness, a prevalent issue in recent times. To detect signs of drowsiness and fatigue in drivers, various facial and body gestures are analyzed, including tired eyes and yawning. Our system uses multiple features such as blinking and yawning frequency and the Eye Aspect Ratio(EAR) to calculate the ratio of distances between the distance between the eyelids and the length of one eye and locates 68 key points which is crucial for detecting drowsiness. Similarly, Yawning is detected by calculating the distance between the upper and lower lip and comparing it to a threshold value. Our proposed system achieving an accuracy of over 90 % for all tested cases of lighting conditions and spectacles is expected to reduce the number of accidents and contribute to the advancement of technology aimed at reducing fatalities resulting from road accidents.

abstract: This has concluded that high angular resolution diffusion-weighted imaging is reproducible, and it may be a capable medical tool for assessing cognitive and motor impairments in Parkinson's sickness sufferers. articleTitle: Prediction of Length of Stay in Hospitals using Ensemble Machine Learning Models
abstract: Length of Stay(LOS) refers to the duration of time that an individual spends in the hospital. Understanding and effectively managing LOS can lead to improved operational efficiency, cost reduction, and enhanced customer experience. articleTitle: Vendor-to-Retailer Vegetables and Fruits Ordering Application Using Time Series Algorithm
abstract: In this paper, we propose a vendor-to-retailers vegetable and fruit ordering application that streamlines the supply chain process. The application provides a platform for vendors and retailers to interact and conduct business transactions in a seamless and efficient manner. Vendors can use the application to upload their available inventory, pricing, and delivery schedules, while retailers can use the application to place orders, track deliveries, and make payments. The application is built on a user-friendly interface that allows vendors and retailers to easily navigate and manage their accounts. The system also employs a time series algorithm to predict future demand and optimize the allocation of vegetables and fruits to different retailers. The algorithm uses historical sales data and other relevant factors, such as seasonality and weather patterns, to provide accurate and timely forecasts. This can help vendors to make informed decisions about inventory management, production planning, and pricing strategies. It also improves the efficiency and enhance customer satisfaction by ensuring that fresh produce is available when and where it is needed.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Convolutional Neural Network for COVID-19 and Pneumonia Prediction
abstract: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome and COVID-19 is a harmful illness which can be transmitted by small particles of saliva or mucus that evaporate whenever a sick person sneezes or coughs. It spreads quickly through close interaction with a person who has been infected, or contact with surfaces or objects that have been already contaminated with the virus. Pneumonia is another infectious disease which can be brought on by an infection from a bacterium in the lungs' alveoli. The occurrence of inflamed infected lung tissue shows the production of pus. Experts execute physical assessments on their patients and use various tests such as chest X-rays, ultrasounds, and lung biopsies to identify whether the patient has any disease. The late diagnosis and misdiagnosis of the disease may lead to death. Nowadays, the development of deep learning is assisting doctors in diagnosing patients with COVID-19 or pneumonia and many other lifethreatening diseases. The proposed work uses X-ray images substituted to a CNN-based deep learning approach for predicting whether a patient is affected by the covid-19 or pneumonia. The proposed model has been developed by using a dataset containing 9,208 images. During the process of model development, the results have been demonstrated in accuracy as 98%. This work is capable of determining and predicting four different classes namely COVID-19, bacterial pneumonia, viral pneumonia, and normal lungs in the chest X-ray images dataset.

articleTitle: Design of Appliance Control Prototype with Voice Command Using IoT for Physically Disabled People
abstract: In today's contemporary society, we have access to advanced systems and technologies designed to fulfill our fun-damental requirements, with the Internet of Things (IoT) being a prominent example. However, it's essential to recognize that individuals with physical challenges or disabilities often require additional support and innovative assistive devices. Among these individuals, those with visual impairments have unique needs, as they often rely on external assistance for various daily activities, including managing household appliances such as lights and fans. To address these challenges, there is a growing need for solutions that empower visually impaired individuals to control essential electrical appliances within their homes autonomously. In this work, a system for mobility-impaired people is designed to manage electrical appliances using an Android Mobile application on a smartphone or tablet with voice control using IoT. The prototype is a low-cost model designed using components like an Ultrasonic sensor, OLED module, and Smartphone for Android app. Personal support with built-in Google platform embedded in ESP8266-based Node MCU development board and integrated Sinric Pro applications excess for distant monitoring capability. This could be implemented in any home automation for the mobility impaired.

articleTitle: Mastering Interference Management in 6G Networks via Spectrum Sharing Algorithms
abstract: This paper discusses the interference management in 6G networks thru spectrum sharing algorithms. articleTitle: Grip-Vision: Enhancing Object Handling with Computer Vision-Based Grip Classification
abstract: The hand is the primary functional part of the human body. Due to various traumatic injuries or accidents, people are suffering from upper extremity amputations. This paper presents a detailed description of the system which is to be integrated with the artificial hand for amputees. This computer vision-based approach is aimed at classifying objects based on the grip required for lifting them using the canny edge detection method and feature descriptors like BRISK. Experimentation is done on household objects like bottles, cups, and mobile phones with the help of state of art Machine Learning models and classifiers like Random Forest, SVM, Decision Tree, and KNN. The trained model can classify the objects based on their required grips with the highest accuracy scores of both the KNN classifier and Random Forest classifier that is 91.86% and 90.27% respectively with the proper output of the classified grip.

articleTitle: Time Series Generation Adversarial Network Controller Based on Optimal Control of Micro-Grids
abstract: The traditional micro-grid co-generation control framework contains two time scales, which may lead to the incoherence problem. In order to avoid the incoherence problem, this paper proposes a smart generation control framework with a unified time scale, based on which a timeseries generative adversarial network controller for optimal control of micro-grids is proposed. The proposed time-series generative adversarial network controller contains reinforcement learning, generator deep neural network and discriminator deep neural network. The generator deep neural network generates predicted states based on multiple historical states, multiple historical actions, and multiple longterm actions. The discriminator deep neural network, on the other hand, determines whether the data from the generator deep neural network or real-life data. Numerical simulation results under an IEEE 300-bus power system validate that the proposed time-series generative adversarial network controller can simultaneously achieve higher control performance and smaller long-term economic cost than conventional control algorithms and optimization algorithms.

articleTitle: Build a Model for Speech Emotion Recognition using Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM)
abstract: Emotions play a profoundly influential role in the human mental experience. However, in the present generation, both humans and machines lack the ability to fully perceive and express emotions. The primary goal of Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) is to enhance the man-machine interface. SER involves extracting emotional states from datasets obtained from speech signals. The system's ultimate goal is to achieve high accuracy in detecting emotions, including angry, calm, fearful, happy, and sad emotions. This is accomplished by employing suitable techniques for feature extraction and machine learning algorithms, such as the Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM). The implementation of this model has significant implications for improving humanmachine interactions and enhancing various applications that necessitate emotion recognition, including healthcare, education, marketing, and advertising. As a result, model is adaptable to different emotions and its overall effectiveness make it a valuable tool in this domain.

articleTitle: Real Time Monitoring of Soil Parameters with User-Friendly Application
abstract: The agriculture sector in India has been dealing with issues in amplifying the yield usefulness from past many years. The poor performance of agricultural monitoring of crop categories is one of the reasons for slowing down process of agriculture in India. The yield of a crop is more often determined by the amount of water available. We propose IoT based soil monitoring system, with which growers can inspect soil moisture, temperature, and humidity data on an Android mobile application. It also makes the provision for the user to get informed about crops, that are suitable according to the season, soil quality and other parameters in that region. This project aims to develop a system for monitoring soil parameters in real-time using the ESP32 LilyGO TTGO sensor. The system's low-power mode and deep-sleep capabilities ensure long battery life, making it ideal for deployment in remote areas with limit power availability. This paper presents a cost-effective and dependable solution for monitoring soil parameters that could prove beneficial to the agriculture industry, environmental monitoring, and soil research. We have developed an app to enhance user experience and make the use of our product even more accessible. The app is designed with a user-friendly interface that provides seamless navigation and easy access to all features of the product. With this app, users can control and monitor the product's functionalities from their mobile devices. The app offers a range of features, including real-time data monitoring, remote control, and automated alerts for critical events.

articleTitle: Multiband Slotted Microstrip Antenna for Terahertz Applications
abstract: This study presents the analysis and design of a microstrip rectangular patch antenna with multiband operations intended for Terahertz frequency applications. articleTitle: Unsupervised Person Re-Identification Using Similarity Score
abstract: Unsupervised person re-identification is a challenging task in computer vision that aims to match individuals across multiple non-overlapping camera views without the need for annotated training data. In this research, we propose a novel approach for unsupervised person re-identification using similarity scores. Our method leverages the concept of similarity scores to measure the likeness between individuals based on their visual appearance. We employ resnet to extract robust and discriminative features from the person images. These features are then used to compute pairwise similarity scores between all possible image pairs. In conclusion, our unsupervised person re-identification method utilizing similarity scores offers a promising solution for addressing problem to match individuals. The proposed approach demonstrates superior performance and robustness, opening avenues for various applications such as video surveillance, crowd analysis, and person tracking in real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Solutions for Evolving Injection Attack Landscape
abstract: The detection and mitigation of injection attacks have become crucial due to growing reliance on computer networks and the possibility of cyberattacks in the Internet of Things(IoT) environment. To improve the security of software programs and systems, this study investigates the use of machine learning(ML) techniques for identifying signs of injection attacks. Through extensive testing and evaluation, different ML methods are trained and evaluated on datasets comprising both valid inputs and injection attacks. Accuracy, recall, precision, and F1-score are performance metrics used to measure how well the models can distinguish between legitimate and malicious inputs. The findings show that the ML algorithms used can effectively identify injection attacks, and the high accuracy rates attained support their potential as effective defence strategies. This study sets the path for future improvements and optimisations in cybersecurity tactics while also advancing our understanding of the viability and effectiveness of ML-based approaches in preventing injection attacks. The incorporation of such ML-based detection devices offers an anticipatory and adaptive solution to reduce the growing threat of injection assaults as digital systems continue to develop. The paper uses the SQL injection attack detection dataset to forecast injection attacks that make use of different ML methods, namely LR, RF, SVM, and NB. The best attack detection method has been determined using performance metrics such as accuracy, sensitivity, precision, and F1-score. The LR, RF and SVM models, with accuracy ratings of 94.40%, 91.19%, and 81.78%, respectively, are followed by the NB model, which has the highest accuracy rating of 97.73 %.

abstract: There is a growing demand for multivalue logic due to the rising complexity of digital circuits based on binary logic.
