The suggested architecture of ternary NOR gate has advantages in several domains such as data compression, quantum computing, and signal processing applications.

articleTitle: Play Store App Rating Prediction Using Machine Learning & Deep Learning Regression Techniques
abstract: The rating & review of an app in the App Store or Play Store plays an essential role for end users to get information about the app based on other people's experiences with that app. The reviews might be context-based, but the ratings give a firsthand impression to the users, simply looking at scores out of five. In this paper, we have performed multivariate analysis on the Google Play Analysis Dataset to determine the critical features and prune off the redundant ones, followed by which we compared the accuracy of various regression models in predicting the ratings of various apps in the dataset.

articleTitle: DACSO - Data Acumen Solutions
abstract: In recent years, there has been a growing demand for effective Data Exploration methodologies. The limitations of traditional manual approaches, known for their time-consuming nature and susceptibility to errors, have spurred the development of automated systems. This paper introduces Data Acumen Solutions (DACSO), a web-based platform designed to address these challenges. The primary objective is to amplify an analyst's insight into a given dataset and its inherent structure. DACSO aims to provide specific outputs that analysts typically seek, including a wellfitting, cost-effective model, identification of outliers, parameter estimates, and key factors. Additionally, DACSO features a streamlined machine learning process, allowing users to define target variables, select training and testing sets, and choose from four machine learning models for a preliminary accuracy estimate. Our findings affirm that DACSO stands out as a reliable, secure, and swift system, positioning it as a valuable tool for organizations seeking efficient data management solutions.

articleTitle: Adaptive Fusion Techniques for Image Super-Resolution
abstract: This research paper presents a thorough analysis of Image Super-Resolution (ISR) methods, covering their historical evolution, challenges, recent advances, and significance across domains. It explores both traditional interpolation-based and data-driven machine learning approaches, examining factors like image priors, network architectures, and the importance of domain-specific datasets and data augmentation. The paper also delves into ensemble models and addresses ongoing challenges in the field. It concludes with a comprehensive comparison of ISR methods, considering strengths, weaknesses, and applicability, offering a valuable resource for researchers and practitioners in the computer vision community and paving the way for future developments in image super-resolution.

Author Keywords: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for Super Resolution

articleTitle: Smart Helmet and Health Monitoring Kit for Mining Workers
abstract: For mine workers, this project proposed a Smart Helmet and Health Monitoring System. The system incorporates sensors such the DHT sensor, MQ-07 gas sensor, ultrasonic sensor, and health-based oximeter, Temperature sensor. To track and examine gathered data, it makes use of the data visualization and analysis platform ThingSpeak. The sensors in the Smart Helmet track environmental factors and physiological indicators, and ThingSpeak gives managers and safety staff remote access to real-time data visualization. Data analysis using machine learning algorithms enables predictive maintenance, early diagnosis of health issues, and prompt alert generation. This device has the ability to change mining safety regulations and guarantee worker well- being by boosting safety and continuous health monitoring.

articleTitle: Feasibility of Cervical Spine Fracture Detection Using Non-Conventional Slices
abstract: Cervical spine fractures are a medical emergency that must be dealt with within a certain period. It can lead to paralysis or severe life-threatening effects if there is a delay in the identification of fractures. It can be treated well if detected in the early stages. A system that automates the process of fracture detection in the cervical spine would assist radiologists and doctors in detecting fractures faster and overcoming diagnostic or human errors. This can be achieved with the help of Computer-assisted detection (CAD) systems. We propose a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based approach for the automated detection of cervical spine fractures. We have provided a proof of concept using the sagittal and coronal slices generated from axial view CT scans to predict fractures in the cervical spine. The system performs a binary classification task of detecting fracture and non-fracture cases in the cervical spine. We have used a dataset provided by the Radiology Society of North America which contains 2,018 records with a marginal difference in the number of positive and negative cases.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Resonating Rhythmical Vibrator for Mind Refreshment

articleTitle: Deep Ensembles for Improving Time Series Predictions with Deep Learning
abstract: Proposes a unique technique to enhance the accuracy of deep mastering fashions for time series predictions. By combining existing deep getting-to-know models into an ensemble, the authors could reduce the last prediction's mean absolute percent errors (MAPE) by using up to 16. The method assumes that distinct models can discover one-of-a-kind traits of a problem, and combining them into an ensemble can result in improved performance. The authors exemplified the use of the proposed technique with several one-of-a-kind real-world datasets. They showed that their method can outperform conventional time-collection forecasting fashions, which include ARIMA and LSTM, through a widespread margin. The paper offers valuable insights into the capacity of ensembles and is of interest to researchers and practitioners alike.

articleTitle: Optimizing Advanced Neural Network Architectures to Enhance the Accuracy of Extracting Online Information
abstract: The extraction of records from online assets has become increasingly important for organizations to remain competitive. This requires using state-of-the-art records analytics gear, including deep getting based totally models, to better extract meaningful statistics from web resources. One of the demanding situations is to broaden extra superior neural community architectures, which can increase the records extraction accuracy. This paper explores the capacity of such architectures for enhancing the accuracy of statistics extraction from online resources. It critiques advances in deep studying fashions, encompassing CNNs, RNN and generative hostile networks. It describes how those methods may be implemented to optimize the accuracy of fact extraction from online sources. The paper additionally evaluates case studies to illustrate how these fashions can be used to beautify the accuracy of extracting online records. Sooner or later, it provides suggestions on how companies can optimize their online form extraction strategies to enhance accuracy.

articleTitle: Applying Advanced Neural Network Architectures to Improve Extracting Effectiveness of Textual Information
abstract: This paper investigates the capacity of applying advanced neural community architectures to enhance the effectiveness of extracting statistics from textual content. The study tested a selection of different architectures, inclusive of Recurrent Neural network (RNN), Convolutional Neural community (CNN), and lengthy short-term reminiscence (LSTM), and in comparison, the performance of them on a dataset including text from educational articles. Via experimentation, the paper concluded that LSTM architectures showed the best extraction performance compared to different architectures. They found robust proof of their capability to play an essential position in enhancing the effectiveness of statistics extraction from textual content. Additionally, the paper executed a detailed evaluation of the distinct architectures, an excellent way to discover their strengths and weaknesses in extracting information. It may be used to remove useless architectures and tailor architectures to unique obligations. Overall, this paper offers valuable insights into using advanced neural network architectures to enhance the performance of text-based statistics extraction duties and paves the way for similar research in this discipline.

articleTitle: Land Registry System using Blockchain With Multiple Nodes
abstract: This research paper presents the design and implementation of a land registry system using multiple nodes with Geth, a command-line interface for running Ethereum nodes. The system is designed to address the issues of security and efficiency in the current land registration system. The system uses a distributed database with multiple nodes to store land records, providing redundancy and fault tolerance. The use of a distributed database also ensures that no single point of failure exists, improving the system's reliability. To ensure that the land records are impenetrable and cannot be changed without permission, the system makes use of the Ethereum blockchain. A consensus mechanism is used to implement the blockchain, ensuring that every node on the network concurs with the database's current state. The use of a consensus algorithm ensures that the system is secure and resilient to attacks. To automate the transfer of land ownership, the system also includes a smart contract framework. The smart contract system ensures that all parties involved in a land transaction agree on the terms of the transaction before it is executed. This reduces the possibility of land transaction conflicts. The system was developed using Geth, a commandline interface for managing Ethereum nodes. The system was tested using a simulated network of nodes and was found to be reliable and efficient. The system showed high throughput and low latency, which qualified it for usage in a production setting.

articleTitle: Keyword-Based Information Retrieval Model for the Dark Web
abstract: Due to its encryption networks and websites that cannot be found via traditional search engines, searching for specific information on the dark web poses unique challenges. The lack of an indexing mechanism requires an improvised searching mechanism on the dark web. This paper presents retrieving information on the dark web. The proposed method utilizes a keyword-driven ranking system to show relevant dark web content. Within a crawled dataset of dark web websites, a given set of websites is ranked using keyword analysis, cosine similarity, and GloVe embeddings. Initially, keywords are selected to ensure that they pertain to the content contained within the dataset. Choosing appropriate keywords determines how accurately the crawled dataset represents the various topics. A comprehensive keyword analysis is then performed on each website's content, scoring each keyword based on importance. A retrieval model combines these scores to create composite scores, which indicate whether a website is relevant to a search query. The websites are sorted in descending order based on their combined keyword scores. Using user keywords, the presented work identifies the most relevant results from dark web onion services.

articleTitle: Oral Tumor Detection based on Convolution Neural Network
abstract: Mouth cancer that is thriving in the world continuously. The discovery of oral possibly harmful problems, which convey a gamble of forming into disease, frequently gives the best opportunities to restoring the infection and is thusly essential for further developing bleakness furthermore, mortality results from oral malignant growth. The use of an effective method for extracting features from an image is the goal of this study. In image processing, the purpose of the feature extraction technique is to represent the image in its unique and compact form of single values or matrix vectors. Automatic feature extraction from an image without any processing is known as low level feature extraction. The intention of this research is to progress a convolution neural network (CNN) for the detection of oral tumour, which can accurately classify images of oral tumor and can assist in early diagnosis.

articleTitle: An Efficient Fine-Tuned Convolutional Neural Network Model for Apple Leaf Disease Classification
abstract: A 70% of the Indian population is financed by agriculture, which is an essential mode of survival. A significant portion of Indian farmers still employ traditional farming methods due to their limited technical knowledge. This deficiency has a detrimental impact on both the quality and quantity of agricultural produce. The productivity of the agricultural sector is additionally hindered by the prevalence of various plant diseases that adversely affect fruits, stems, and leaves. The preservation of healthy leaves is paramount for promoting rapid plant growth, which in turn leads to higher food yields and increased income generation. For plants to grow quickly, preserving healthy leaves is highly desirable. This leads to an increase in food production and source of income. Nowadays, farmers use spraying pesticides, which have adverse impacts on human health. Identifying the presence of diseases in plant leaves is crucial for agricultural professionals. It is essential to adopt improved approaches to accurately identify leaf diseases. This work presents a methodology involving a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model to identify the presence of diseases in apple leaves. The implementation of the proposed model significantly enhances disease recognition accuracy. The experimentation involves two distinct epochs: the 30 and 50. In the 30th epoch, the training phase achieves an accuracy of 98.91%, while the validation phase attains an accuracy of 88.95%. Furthermore, in the 50th epoch, validation accuracy has been improved and reaches 91.52%.

articleTitle: Cuckoo-LS Algorithm: A Promising Solution for Real-World Economic Load Dispatch Challenges
abstract: This paper, introduce a novel hybrid optimization algorithm, Local Search Integrated Cuckoo Search, to address the challenge of achieving optimal power generation costs while adhering to both equality and inequality constraints. This study involves a comparative analysis with the Cuckoo Search Algorithm (CSA), revealing that CuckooLS outperforms CSA in terms of efficiency and effectiveness by balancing the exploration and exploitation. To validate the performance of our proposed algorithm, conducted extensive testing on the IEEE 30-bus system. The results obtained demonstrate the superior capabilities of Cuckoo-LS in optimizing power generation costs while ensuring compliance with critical constraints. This research contributes to the advancement of optimization techniques in the field of power systems and offers a promising solution for addressing realworld power generation challenges.

articleTitle: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Automation Using Machine Learning Algorithm
abstract: CRM automation, is analytic as well as very important aspect of modern businesses, Effectual CRM can help organizations improve customer satisfaction, retention, and sales. However, managing customer relationships manually can be time-consuming and vulnerable. This has led to the development of CRM automation tools that can rationalize and optimize CRM processes. Machine learning algorithms have emerged as spring up tools for automating CRM processes. Machine learning algorithms have the tendency to survey large datasets of customer information and learn from patterns to make predictions which can also lead to developing alterations for the problem that gets highlighted with the help of these machine learning algorithms. This research paper provides an overview of the use of machine learning algorithms in CRM automation. The paper encompasses and discusses various types of variations in CRM automation, including customer attributes, purchase history, and social media activity. Machine learning algorithms can examine these data sources to predict customer behaviour, identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities, and improve customer segmentation. One of the key advantages of using machine learning algorithms in CRM automation is their ability to capability to improve over time. Machine learning algorithms can learn from customer interactions and feedback to improve their accuracy and effectiveness. One of the major challenges is the quality and availability of data. Inconsistent data quality, missing data, and biased data can significantly impact the accuracy of machine learning models. Machine Learning algorithms used in CRM automation Regression algorithms, classification, K – means clustering, Support Vector Machines (SVM). In conclusion, this research paper highlights the potential of machine learning algorithms for automating CRM processes. The use of machine learning algorithms can help organizations enhance their CRM efforts, improving customer relationship.

articleTitle: Augmenting Data Analysis Through Innovative Visualization Techniques
abstract: This paper examines new and progressive methods in information visualization for analysis and selectionmaking. It explains various traits of records that might be made less burdensome to apprehend via visuals, which include graphs, pictures, and other visible representations. It highlights the strength of facts visualization to assist people in interpreting, advantage insights, and conclude from information, making them more green and powerful in their evaluation. The paper covers the significance of records visualization modern and growing techniques and examines how facts analysis and choice-making may be augmented using these stylish visuals. Researchers can use statistics visualization techniques to reach broader audiences and help them understand important information more correctly.

articleTitle: SoC Validation Tools Transformation: Accelerating Test Tools Using Accelerators
abstract: Server System-on-Chip (SoC) design technology is rapidly growing, catering to modern competitive market needs and delivering to broad portfolio from edge to cloud. Latest SoC processors are very powerful in compute and provide multiple new features. Built-in AI, advanced security, advanced I/O & ethernet, high throughput compute dense performance sensitive core, make end-to-end post-silicon validation of these SoCs complex. Functional post-silicon validation is an important pillar in ensuring the functionality of these breakthrough features and uncovering defects before shipping to customers. Along with ensuring architectural correctness, one of the goals of post-silicon validation is to stress test as many scenarios as possible, to ensure product quality within aggressive time-to-market (TTM). Postsilicon Functional Validation generally employs combinations of powerful OS based tools and test sequences to verify & validate complex SoC functions. Sometimes Functional Validation may use Synthetic validation frameworks, directly run on the SystemUnder-Test (SUT) to test architectural features, and verify the results. One such powerful framework in the Intel FV community is the Validation workload (ValWL), which provides set of validation applications, libraries, and configuration files to build pseudo-random tests covering a variety of system logic scenarios. ValWL is tightly coupled with System Validation Operating System, uses the kernel drivers and libraries, and runs completely on the SUT. With aggressive time-to-market trends and, it is imperative to optimize post-silicon validation execution for maximum coverage and efficiency. Discussed in this paper is the method to use the latest Hardware Accelerator IPs in the Xeon SoCs to optimize the ValWL Framework while validating the SUT. Validation efficiency is increased significantly increasing the confidence in the design while minimally impacting TTM.

articleTitle: An E-Healthcare System Enhancement Via a Dynamic Cloud-Computing Platform
abstract: By using cloud computing services instead of purchasing and maintaining your own hardware and software, you may save a significant amount of money each year. The advantage is that it reduces you the time, cost and effort. This cloud computing technology is more profitable in the healthcare system because it has the ability to store an enormous number of medical health information. We all know that the healthcare system plays a major role in all nations. Numerous EMRs may be safely stored on the cloud using cloud computing technologies, and patients can be certain that their information will remain private. The information will be more secure and safe so that no one can access it illegally. By using this technology the healthcare management can access the patient information very easily. So it will be the best technology for e- health care system.

articleTitle: Malaria Categorization Using an Autonomous CNN System in Conjunction with Data Augmentation
abstract: A major worldwide health issue continues to be malaria, a potentially fatal infectious illness spread by mosquitoes and caused by parasites called Plasmodium. An early and precise diagnosis is essential for the condition to be treated and controlled effectively. Deep learning (DL) methods, in specific Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), have freshly established promising results in a variety of picture identification applications, including the detection of malaria. The development of an automated malaria classification system employing CNNs and data augmentation is the main goal of this study. A sizable number of blood smear pictures, some labeled as “Parasitized” (infested with Plasmodium parasites), are present in the dataset used for training and assessment. In order to increase model generalization and solve the lack of labeled data, data augmentation structures including rotation, flipping, and scaling are used to extract more varied samples from the existing pictures. The findings show that the CNN model, in conjunction with data augmentation, achieves good accuracy and achievement in differentiating among “Parasitized” and “Uninfected” blood smear pictures. The danger of overfitting is decreased by the use of data augmentation, which also aids in the model's capacity to simplify effectively to novel data. By advancing automated malaria detection, this study might help medical professionals in places with a shortage of resources and knowledge. To maximize their beneficial effects on malaria management and control efforts, such models must be carefully integrated into the current healthcare infrastructures. This demands careful consideration of ethical and legal issues.

articleTitle: A Deep Dive into Information and Cybersecurity Frameworks
abstract: Data is essential for the survival of businesses in the highly competitive business world of today, but it is also continuously at risk of gone missing. The loss of confidential data can have detrimental consequences for both corporations and individuals. The term “cybersecurity” indicates to the practice of keeping private information safe online. Organizations can enhance their resilience against cybercrime and effectively achieve their cybersecurity objectives by following to the criteria prescribed by recognized safety norms. When it comes to cybersecurity, however, it can be difficult for firms to decide which standard is best to embrace. By studying the practices of other businesses, companies can better determine which cybersecurity guidelines and systems to implement. This report presents an in-depth analysis of the most widely employed such systems in the market to aid organizations in selecting the one that best meets their safetycritical objectives.

articleTitle: Product Review Assistance Based on Feature Sentiment Analysis Using NLP
abstract: In today's digital era, customers face challenges in making confident purchasing decisions due to the overwhelming volume of online product reviews. Simultaneously, manufacturers struggle to extract meaningful insights from this vast amount of feedback. There is a pressing need for a system that can efficiently analyze product reviews, offer valuable insights, and bridge the gap between customers and manufacturers, enabling informed choices and product enhancements in the real world. As a solution to this problem, in this work we propose a method which analyses the product reviews along with the extraction of product features and in result defining the overall sentiment towards the product by the consumers with respect to its good and bad features. The proposed methodology includes use of custom dataset with the help of web scrapping (flask), dependency parsing, sentiment prediction of reviews using BERT and matrix method to determine the feature sentiment.

articleTitle: GARP - A Hybrid Preprocessing Technique for Semantic Segmentation of Satellite Images with U-Net Architecture
abstract: Accurate and intricate semantic segmentation of satellite images holds paramount significance across diverse domains, facilitating precise land cover classification and object identification. This paper introduces a novel hybrid preprocessing technique, GARP (Gamma Correction, Laplacian kernel and Histogram Equalization) for accurate and precise pre-processing. The work also compares the results obtained from GARP with those obtained from existing techniques like Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE), gamma correction, histogram equalization, and Laplacian Kernel. Furthermore, the research conducts an evaluation across three distinct loss functions-Jaccard loss, Focal loss, and Binary Cross-Entropy loss. Notably, the U-Net architecture, renowned for its efficacy in medical imaging, is tailored to satellite imagery, further boosting performance. The proposed approach integrates the benefits of Histogram Equalization, Gamma Correction and Laplacian Kernel with the U-Net framework. The outcome substantiate the excellence of this approach, yielding remarkable performance metrics: a mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) of 0.78, a Dice score (DSC) of 0.87, and an Area Error Ratio (AER) of 0.172. These results provide a significant 63.2 % decrease in AER, 8.2 % increase in the Dice score and a 8.6 % improvement in the mIoU when compared with results obtained on original images (without any pre-processing). The paper essentially provides a helpful framework for pursuing precise and effective semantic segmentation in satellite image analysis.

articleTitle: Examining the Impact of Machine Learning on Streamlining Data Analysis in Real-Time
abstract: Information compression and source coding are critical additives of modern communication and information storage technologies. To make sure reliability, fault-tolerant technologies are hard to guarantee that the facts reaches its destination intact and with none major loss in quality or volume. This paper specializes in exploring existing faulttolerant technologies in each records compression and source coding, and seeks to discover the most promising techniques for future development on this subject. Present fault-tolerant algorithms and strategies will be studied, and evaluated based on their effectiveness and capability for added development. The most useful strategies for enhancing fault tolerance and growing facts compression and source coding efficiency can be discussed. In this, unique interest is given to underlying principles as well as practical factors which are necessary for a success implementation in a actual-international machine. Ultimately, destiny potentialities for fault-tolerant facts compression and supply coding technology could be articulated…

articleTitle: Grunwald-Letnikov Fractional Differential Based Convolutional Neural Network for Devanagari Text Recognition
abstract: Character recognition is an indispensable task in the area of pattern recognition. The character set that is to be recognized determines the complexity of the character recognition problem. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is an advanced approach of deep learning for the identification of character problems. The character recognition process is dependent on various factors such as fragmented lines, several font sizes, different illumination conditions, etc., and the impact of these factors is found in the recognition process. In this paper, an illumination robust CNN is suggested using a GLFD mask. MobileNet-v2 is utilized as the original CNN network. The process is assessed using the Devanagari Handwritten Character Dataset (DHCD) database. The results illustrate that the suggested approach has achieved better results than the original network.

articleTitle: Design of a High-Sensitive Chipless RFID Sensor for Surface Crack Characterization on Metals
abstract: This paper presents the design of a high-sensitivity chipless RFID sensor tag with a modified depolarizing circular patch for surface crack characterization on metals. The sensor response was realized using a cross-polarization reading, and induced dual resonance frequencies from the incident waves. The circular patch resonates at frequencies of 2.766 GHz and 3.204 GHz with four L-shaped tip-loaded resonators as identification encoders. The surface cracks in vertical, horizontal, and diagonal orientations with varying crack widths and depths in sub-millimeter resolution are simulated. It is observed that the designed patch is sensitive to detect a minimum crack resolution of 0.1 mm for varying crack widths and depths. The average computed gradient of simulated sensor upper frequencies is 27.5 MHz and 58.5 MHz for varying crack depths and widths in vertical orientation. Similarly, varying frequency gradients between dual resonances were observed for other orientations.

articleTitle: Efficient High-Gain Operational Amplifier Design for Σ-Δ ADCs in VLSI
abstract: This paper presents a two-stage high gain singleended operational amplifier design for Σ-Δ analog-to-digital converters (ADCs) in very-large-scale-integration (VLSI) technology. The high-gain operational amplifier design eliminates wasted drain current at the output of the operational amplifier. The first stage of the amplifier, differential pair with active load, provides high gain. The second common source stage provides a high output voltage swing. The high-gain operational amplifiers (two-stage singleended configuration) with a gain of more than 80dB and bandwidths between 3.5MHz to 5MHz have been designed and simulated using Cadence Virtuoso Analog Design Environment in 90nm and 180nm standard CMOS processes.

articleTitle: Identifying Common Pest and Disease of Lettuce Plants Using Convolutional Neural Network
abstract: Some of the most crucial factors that can influence the quality and quantity of harvested produce are soil fertility, water availability, climate, pests, and diseases. Pests and diseases have been a major problem for farmers in the production of crops, where they have caused up to 40% of the total global crop production. The model aims to determine the wellness of lettuce plants by identifying common pests and diseases through the use of image recognition techniques with deep learning called the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The model detects pests and diseases of lettuce plants such as anthracnose, leaf drop, powdery mildew, septoria leaf spot, big vein, bottom rot, and downy mildew based on their physical and observable characteristics. The training and testing of the model will be done over a dataset created specifically for the model. A 10-fold crossvalidation will then be performed to verify the models’ accuracy. Categorical cross-entropy is utilized to ensure the model has no outlier predictions with huge errors against the observed data, making the system accurate and effective. The CNN model garnered the highest accuracy of 95.72% with 97.03% precision, 95.12% recall, and a 95.84% F1 score.

articleTitle: Data Mining Classification Techniques to Analyze the TV Market Data
abstract: WEKA has expansive capabilities, which include Data Mining Algorithms similar to Random Forest, J48, Multilayer Perceptron, and Naive Bayes. In this paper, trouble has been made to compare the analysis of several categorization systems. A dataset of television request analysis was used as the base for this analysis, which was carried out with the aid of WEKA. Several data mining approaches are applied to the dataset, including J48, naive Bayes, and arbitrary timber. Applying four classifiers while taking the operating system into consideration for the analysis of the television request. Grounded on the accuracy percentage a conclusion is shown in this paper.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Deep-Learning Model CNN Used for Multi-Class Classification of Apple Leaf Disease
abstract: This article provides a comprehensive study on the detection and classification of three significant diseases that affect apple fruits and leaves. These diseases include black rot, scab, and rust. The research was conducted with the use of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). The illnesses are referred to by the symptoms that they cause, which are known as black rot, scab, and rust. This Paper features a curated dataset that contains a wide variety of high-resolution photographs of apple leaves in both healthy and diseased states. By using the capabilities of CNNs, we can achieve remarkable accuracy in differentiating between the many types of disease, which paves the way for earlier diagnosis and more individualized treatment of disease. Our findings not only contribute to the advancement of precision agriculture but also give insightful information on the use of deep learning in the diagnosis of agricultural illnesses. Our model classified the disease with 92.5% accuracy.

articleTitle: RFID Based Embedded System for Automatic Identity and Body Temperature Screening in the Working Environment
abstract: Monitoring human body temperature is an important aspect that plays a crucial role in maintaining a safe, healthy, and productive working environment. This paper presents an RFID based embedded system for recording the identity and body temperature of people in an industrial or institutional working environment. A prototype is developed and demonstrated using a commercial RFID tag attached to the person and a temperature screening module connected to the RFID reader. When a person with a tag enters the hotspot zone of the reader, the identity part will be automatically recorded, and the temperature sensor is facilitated in such a way that the infrared waves will hit the forehead or forearm of the individual. An ultrasonic sensor with distance logic is used to maintain the accuracy of body temperature measurements and prevent the misreading of ambient temperature as body temperature. The RSSI feature of an RFID tag is used to eliminate the ambiguity in mapping between the identity of a person and his body temperature. The acquired data from the module is transferred to the Thingspeak IoT platform to enable remote monitoring of body temperature. It is observed that the proposed RFID-based embedded system is a costeffective, non-contact, and remote monitoring solution to enhance the safety of people in the working environment.

articleTitle: A Framework for Automatic Detection of Traffic Violations
abstract: Automatic detection of violations is a wellstudied area of research. Detection of traffic regulations violations and recognition of the violating vehicles using automated techniques can efficiently replace the requirement of traffic police with virtual traffic police. Detection of violations includes detecting motorcyclists without helmets and triple riding. Also, the automated number plate recognition system plays a crucial role in identifying defaulters and simplifying traffic jams. This paper proposes automated techniques for the detection and classification of vehicles violating traffic rules and also for tracking stolen vehicles or uncertified vehicles.

articleTitle: Eye Disease Classification Using ResNet-18 Deep Learning Architecture
abstract: The present study aims to investigate the crucial topic of automated categorization of eye diseases using medical photographs by utilizing the capabilities of the ResNet-18 model. The purpose of doing this research derives from the positive outcomes documented in recent studies that have employed ResNet-18 for comparable objectives. This study introduces a customized ResNet-18 model architecture explicitly designed for classifying eye illness images into four categories with significant medicinal properties. The methodology employed in this study utilizes a dataset consisting of 4,217 photos of eye diseases. The model was trained over 30 iterations, using a batch size 128 and default learning rates. The results demonstrate a noteworthy accomplishment, as the ResNet-18 model suggested in this study achieved a commendable accuracy rate of 94%. This highlights the model's efficacy in distinguishing between various eye illnesses, offering substantial enhancements in the precision and effectiveness of diagnostic protocols. The research findings are significant, as they lay the foundation for advancing automated systems that can efficiently and precisely identify eye disorders. This has the potential to bring about a transformative impact on the field of ophthalmic diagnostics and enhance the quality of patient treatment.

articleTitle: Identifying the Orientation of Active Janus Colloids in Dilute Limit
abstract: An active Janus colloid consists of a passive face and an active face that can transfer surrounding energy into its motion. The structure and dynamics of the system are deeply related to the position and orientation of each colloid. Despite the extensive studies based on the positional information of individual colloids, the effect of the orientational information is less explored experimentally due to the challenge in orientation identification at the single particle level. Here, a new method of identifying the orientation of Janus colloids is proposed, which combines the traditional Hough circle transform and a novel refining technique based on the axial correlation function. The center position of the whole Janus colloid and the active part were identified, followed by the refinement of the later one. The orientation of each Janus colloid in a dilute solution was overlaid onto the original image and the clear improvement in the orientational identification was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Water Quality Prediction Using Random Forest Algorithm
abstract: Water is an essential requirement for every living thing in the globe. The massive growth of technology helps to attain water purity and quality for the betterment of people. Because of industries, chemical wastes mingle with water resources by contaminating water and land. People who drink the contaminated water suffer from waterborne diseases like cholera, Diarrhea, typhoid, etc. Water scarcity has been rapidly increasing with the increase in population and pollution. Nearly two lakh people are dying in India due to water scarcity and waterborne diseases. So we came forward to solve a complex problem regarding water. This article suggests a machine learning-based method for determining the purity of water. This method uses a collection of water quality variables, including pH, turbidity, conductivity, and temperature, to train a model using a classification algorithm. The model's accuracy in determining the purity of the water is next assessed using a new set of data. The outcomes show how effective the suggested method is at assessing the purity of the water. Consequently, this method is a reliable and efficient tool for determining the purity of water, which can significantly lower the danger of water pollution. Monitoring water quality to regulate it, safeguard public health, and save the environment is crucial. With the support of various machine learning classifiers and related stacking ensemble models, the WQI was primarily used to categorize the WQ data. Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest (RF), Logistic Regression (LR), Decision Tree (DT), and Naive Bayes are a few of the classifiers that were used. In total, 3996 samples collected during nine years were included in the dataset used for the study, along with supporting data.

articleTitle: A New Low Power RTL Optimized 16-Bit Fixed Point ALU Using Hybrid Adder Logic
abstract: This paper proposes a new architecture of low power, fast and RTL optimized 16-bit ALU. The proposed design is simulated in the SpartanTM-3 family FPGA using Xilinx ISE 14.7. Proposed model is designed by introducing an RTL optimized hybrid adder unit. The optimization is achieved by introducing the RLOA method. The proposed ALU is consuming 27.46mw power for 16-bit operations at a bit rate of 2MBps.

articleTitle: Fabrication & Development of Mobile Operated Cleaning & Sanitizing Bot
abstract: Healthy living is influenced directly by proper hygiene and cleanliness, which also influences our houses and surroundings. We've done a study and developed a design and operation model of a floor cleaning robot with this goal in mind. Cleanliness has recently become a crucial component of enhancing one's health. The proposed model is automated so as to reduce labor and offer convenient, quick, and effective cleaning accentuating any interior area. Dust is a serious threat to human health which is observed in every residence, hospital, hotel rooms, dorm rooms, schools, and universities. Due to their Ability to arbitrarily cut labor expenses, automatic machine cleaners are essential in modern life. The majority of these cleaning products are made to specifically satisfy the needs of consumers. They are a collection of different fixed elements such as the chassis, a few motors, and several electromechanical devices. This paper describes a functional model of a cleaning device that could be operated at home with only handful of resources.

articleTitle: Design of Novel Oral Submucous Fibrosis Mouth Opening Device
abstract: The primary goal of treating oral submucous fibrosis are to lessen patients' discomfort and stop the growth of malignancy. Mouth exercise physiotherapy is regarded as a mainstay for enhancing mouth opening, either on its own or in conjunction with other modalities. The objective of the current work is to design a mouth opening device for such patients and identify the suitable material to give comprehensive information on its design. The device is fabricated and is suitable for patients with minimum mouth opening of 3mm.The lower lever arms' unique design profile provides tangential contact with the bolt head throughout motion for effective effort transmission. The device is presently under clinical trial.

articleTitle: UART (Universal Asynchronous Receiver Transmitter) for Serial Data Communication: Design and Implementation on FPGA Platform
abstract: The Universal Asynchronous Receiver Transmitter (UART) is a widely used hardware interface for serial communication between a computer or microcontroller and external devices. UART is often integrated into microcontrollers, microprocessors, and other embedded systems to facilitate data transmission and reception. UART is a versatile and straightforward communication interface, making it a popular choice for various embedded systems and communication scenarios. Its simplicity and widespread support in hardware and software make it a reliable and essential component of many electronic devices. The design and implementation of a UART in Verilog are demonstrated in this work. The transmitter, receiver, FIFO buffer, and baud generator sub-modules make up the top module of the top-level design, which is implemented on the FPGA. To prevent data loss, the UART Protocol was created with a FIFO (First in First out) memory buffer. Utilising Xilinx ISE 14.7, the simulation and synthesis are carried out. The Spartan-3E FPGA board has successfully verified the design. The Spartan3E FPGA's LEDs will provide output from the data that is delivered.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of M-δ (Delta) Decomposition for RISAT1 Hybrid Polarimetric SAR Image
abstract: The advancements in VLSI technology due to availability of multimillion gate FPGAs with built-in Processor cores have given scope for implementation of m-δ (delta) decomposition method for processing Hybrid polarimetric SAR images of RISATl satellite. The FPGA implementation is done for spot-based scene images as limited volume of data is involved. This approach for FPGA implementation along with growing trends of miniaturization in future has the potential for Small Satellite SAR Missions with on-board processing of SAR images. It will improve turn-around-time, reduce the downlink data to be transmitted, and also gives potential for direct delivery to end user. Preliminary experimental results are encouraging.

articleTitle: Implementing Automated Reasoning in Natural Language Processing
abstract: herbal language processing (NLP) is an unexpectedly advancing field state-of-the-art synthetic intelligence and system ultra-modern.
