articleTitle: Haptic Glove for Deaf and Dumb People Using Arduino Nano
abstract: A microcontroller-based system has been created to measure finger movements using hand-specific flex sensors. The system is designed as a wearable glove and utilizes five flex sensors to detect wrist bending corresponding to specific finger gestures. Each finger on the palm has a set of flex sensors to capture the movements accurately. The flex sensors change their resistance values based on the bending angle formed during finger movements. As the fingers bend, the resistance increases proportionally. The heart of the system is an extensively used eight-bit microcontroller, the ATMega328P, which features an internally 10-bit multiplexed Analog-to-Digital converter to handle the sensor signals effectively. While designing the glove, some critical considerations include calibration and accommodating variations in finger size, height, and thickness among different patients. Accurate measurements of these parameters are essential to prevent overlapping of the finger gestures and ensure reliable gesture recognition.

articleTitle: Enhancing Security and Performance of AODV Protocol Using Bloom Filter with Congestion-Aware Load Balancing in Wireless Sensor Networks
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN), which enable diversity and agility in the process of establishing communication among nodes or hubs, play an essential role in the present digital ecosystem. The Ad-hoc On-demand Distance Vector (AODV) protocol is one of the wireless sensor network's (WSN) most used protocols. Nonetheless, the combined difficulties of security vulnerabilities and network congestion might make it more difficult to use effectively. This research presents a novel strategy for improving the safety and effectiveness of the AODV protocol by combining a Bloom Filter mechanism with a congestion-aware load balancing algorithm. Using this combination, the researchers were able to create a unique solution. The redesigned protocol was assessed based on a variety of performance measures once it was put into action with Java serving as the major tool. The findings revealed a discernible rise in the Packet Delivery Ratio (PDR), as well as improvements in throughput, latency, and energy efficiency. These sorts of enhancements not only fortify the network against prospective dangers but also optimize its performance, consequently enhancing the capability and malleability of WSNs to function in a wide range of contexts.

articleTitle: Design and Fabrication of Sierpinski Fractal-Based MIMO Antenna for Sub 6GHz and IOT Applications
abstract: Modern and next-generation communication requires compact and low-profile antennae that are fabricated easily with multi-purpose applications function. This paper proposes the design and fabrication of fractal inspired MIMO antenna for sub 6GHz, IOT and wireless communication. The proposed antenna design is based on Sierpinski fractal geometry, which is integrated into radiating elements of the antenna to realize multi-band characteristics, high gain, and isolation among the elements. A compact MIMO configuration having four ports is described in this paper. It operates in the sub 6GHz range of frequencies. The simulated peak gain achieved by the proposed antenna design is 3.8dBi. Peak Antenna efficiency is about 85%. Other performance parameters like Directivity and mutual coupling K value are 5.25 dBi and 0.0009, respectively, and the proposed designs are implemented using IE3D software, and results are validated with VNA.

articleTitle: Security of Medical Multimodality Images for Telemedicine Using PDESNet Encryption Standard
abstract: The telemedicine approach is a famous medical assistance service in worldwide, in this process diagnosis records like Scan reports, X-ray, CT and all other radiology reports analysis has been done with doctors. Many times, sending and receiving of these images from one point to many points, due to this security has been reduced. The multimodality images are major key diagnosis elements to detect disease of patients, these multimodality images security also been reduced due to low encryption techniques. In this work an advanced cryptographic encryption technique i.e Parallel Data encryption Standard (PDESNet) algorithm. The PDES is a modern novel algorithm can provide security to multimodal images from transmission to storage part. Finally summarize the proposed algorithm with existed models in terms of PSNR, BER, NC, MSE, accuracy and recall.

articleTitle: Real-Time Facial Emotion Detection Using Machine Learning
abstract: In recent years, the advancements in Machine Learning (ML) and Computer Vision (CV) techniques have facilitated the development of “Real-time Facial Emotion Detection” systems. These platforms find utility in a range of domains, encompassing human-computer Engagement, psychology, and human emotion analysis and provides a novel approach for “Real-time Facial Emotion Detection Using Machine Learning” (RFEDUML) algorithms. The proposed system utilizes ML functionalities, particularly “Convolutional Neural Networks” (CNNs), to analyze and classify facial emotions from live pictures.

Author Keywords: Real-Time Facial Emotion Detection Using Machine Learning (RFEDUML)

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing for Extracting Meaningful Insights from Textual Information
abstract: Natural language processing (NLP) is becoming more and more vital in extracting significant insights from diverse varieties of textual records. Current trends in AI and device mastering have made it viable to extract tangible insights from natural language facts. NLP is becoming increasingly famous and is used in many areas, which include sentiment analysis and extracting topics from one-of-a-kind textual content kinds. NLP algorithms may interpret diverse fabrics by removing fundamental systems and styles from the statistics. This can assist in picking out the underlying context of the textual content, and by studying unstructured information, influential trends and insights may be located. Furthermore, NLP can automatically generate summaries of prolonged files, categorize textual content to unique subjects, and translate exclusive languages. In conclusion, NLP is a precious tool for extracting significant insights from textual facts.

articleTitle: Parkinson's Disease Detection Using Machine Learning: Review
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a neurological condition marked by a gradual decline in mental and motor skills. For prompt intervention and better patient care, a rapid and correct diagnosis of PD is essential. Machine learning (ML) has become a potent technique for the early identification and diagnosis of Parkinson's disease in recent years. The state-of-theart ML methods utilized for PD detection are thoroughly reviewed in this review paper, with an emphasis on their advantages, disadvantages, and possible uses.

articleTitle: Multiband Patch Antenna utilizing E, L and U-slots for Satellite Communication
abstract: The proposed antenna design incorporates multiple rectangular slots on the patch surface to enhance its bandwidth and radiation characteristics. The slot dimensions are optimized for maximum radiation efficiency and gain within the desired frequency bands. The antenna's compact size and low profile make it suitable for satellite applications with limited space requirements. Simulation results show excellent performance regarding radiation pattern, return loss and impedance matching. The proposed antenna with E, L, and U slots significantly improves over traditional microstrip patch antennas and provides an efficient solution for satellite communication in the desired frequency bands.

articleTitle: Arduino Uno Programming based New Five Level Inverter for Photovoltaic Applications
abstract: This article presents a novel five-level transformer-based inverter with inherent boosting abilities specially designed for photovoltaic applications. The key distinction of this proposed inverter lies in its three-leg configuration and a single transformer with an increasing output voltage of twice the input voltage, which results in a smaller size, more cost-effective and less complex inverter circuit. Additionally, this innovative design features fewer components, lower total voltage requirements, reduced voltage rate of change (dv/dt), and a decreased number of active devices compared to its counterparts. The article provides a comprehensive explanation of the circuit's operation and principles. It underscores the utilization of Arduino programming to generate the required control pulses for this five-level inverter. Finally, simulation results are included to validate the feasibility and performance of the proposed inverter, both in steady-state and dynamic operating conditions.

articleTitle: Binary Classification of Mucormycosis Infection Severity using Transfer Learning with VGG16
abstract: Mucormycosis, one of the significant fungal illnesses caused by the fungus Mucormycetes, is a rare and fatal disease. It is found all over the environment. People with weakened immune systems are more prone to get sick rapidly, including those with diabetes or COVID-19 history. Mucormycosis can affect the eyes and quickly spread to the brain if it enters through the nose, sinuses, or lungs. Existing research in the medical domain shows that deep learning techniques are a promising solution for assisting medical practitioners in making quick decisions. This study aims to use transfer learning with a predefined VGG16 model to create a classifier that can distinguish between mild and severe Mucormycosis illness symptoms. The neural network is trained, validated, and tested by loading black fungus dataset. The accuracy is calculated by varying the number of images. The results show that the proposed model gives an accuracy of 92% for 520 input images.

articleTitle: Content Caching Utilizing Scalable Video Coding (SVC) in Wireless Edge Networks
abstract: It is possible to enhance video streaming efficiency and lessen the stress on origin servers by prefetching well-liked videos into the local caches of edge nodes. Scalable Video Coding (SVC) is a video coding standard that allows a video stream to be encoded into multiple layers or “scalability layers,” each providing a different level of video quality and bit rate. This makes it possible to adapt the video stream to different network conditions and device capabilities. Integrating SV C with edge caching can provide several benefits for video streaming. By storing multiple scalability layers in the edge cache, the video stream can be adapted to the network conditions and device capabilities of the end-user. Furthermore, by caching multiple scalability layers, the edge cache can provide more granular control over the video quality delivered to end-users. In this study, we talk about the difficulties that come with scaled videos unique watching requirements and varying content popularity. We give a brief review of the current caching strategies and list the factors to consider when choosing a caching strategy. After that, a case study is presented in which the transmission latency is measured as a performance parameter. In comparison to the current caching systems running without SV C, simulation findings show that taking into account the practical requirements of end users can drastically reduce the content transmission delay.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Optimized Binary Counters and Compressors
abstract: This project employs an innovative approach to design optimized saturated binary counters, such as (7, 3), (15, 4), and other variants, which rely on sorting networks and 4:2 exact compressors. Compressors and counters with high compression ratios are necessary to increase the multiplier process's efficiency. This paper considers odd-even merge sorting for designing counters for medium-range sorting networks using stage-wise pipelining. By determining the trade-off between bit width vs. parameter degradations for different bit ranges, the hardware complexity is optimized compared to bitonic sorting network-based counters. To generate the rearranged sequences in the proposed counter, the inputs of the counters are initially divided into two unequal segments which are then used as inputs for the odd-even merge sorting networks. By adopting this method, the construction of (7,3) counter using one-hot code sequences is achieved. The same process is used to construct (15,4) and (31,5) counters. To optimize 4:2 compressor, the 4:2 exact compressor is designed using NAND gates only. Xilinx Vivado is used to simulate the existing and proposed counters and compressors. The performance of the living and proposed counters and compressors are analyzed and compared using the Cadence Genus synthesis tool, where the technology used 45nm. The comparison results show that the proposed counters and compressors perform better than their equivalents regarding speed, power, and area efficiency. Furthermore, the study explores the impact of this method on a 16*16 exact multiplier, where the counters and compressors are employed for the summation of partial products. Compared to a multiplier using existing bitonic sorting network-based counters and compressors, the proposed approach demonstrates an 8.13% reduction in size and a 15% decrease in power consumption, highlighting its substantial performance improvements.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics Powered by Artificial Intelligence
abstract: The latest improvements in artificial intelligence (AI) and predictive analytics have furnished new possibilities to increase the performance of choice-making techniques. Self-sustaining predictive analytics, which can rely upon the energy of AI technologies, which include natural language processing (NLP) and deep learning, has the potential to automate the complex procedure of information analysis and generate predictions with minimum human intervention. This method can allow records-pushed decision-makers to make selections faster and more appropriately and gain deeper insights into business problems. This paper overviews the opportunities for self-reliant predictive analytics powered by AI. The report will mainly discuss how AI-primarily based predictive analytics can enhance the accuracy and velocity of decision-making approaches and provide insights into client conduct and market trends, which could help inform business techniques. Moreover, the paper may also discover the security dangers posed through self-reliant predictive analytics structures and discuss capacity countermeasures to mitigate those dangers.

articleTitle: Examining the Adoption of Digital Certificates in Information Security Models for Networked Applications
abstract: This abstract examines the adoption of digital certificates to enhance protection fashions for networked applications. Virtual certificates are vital for ensuring statistics integrity and authorization in the net's insecure environment. This summary discusses digital certificates, their features, their benefits and barriers, and the complexity encountered while enforcing them on networked programs. It additionally explores specific cases of digital certificate adoption in numerous industries and assesses their effect on statistics safety. Eventually, this summary outlines the critical assets and organizational commitment required to deploy a digital certificate gadget effectively. In conclusion, virtual certificate systems must continue to be part of the calculations of any data protection model, as they offer reliable authentication and data integrity. The summary discusses the increasing adoption of digital certificates to offer record protection for networked programs. It highlights the diverse advantages that digital certificates provide, together with advanced authentication and better tiers of encryption. It further examines how these mechanisms can assist agencies in monitoring and responding to ability threats and unauthorized right of entry. Subsequently, the summary is on how digital certificates can increase network consideration and mitigate malicious activities…

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Cardiac Arrhythmia Detection using Machine Learning Algorithm for Healthcare Application
abstract: This research paper presents a system for cardiac arrhythmia detection using the AD8232 integrated ECG sensor and machine learning algorithms. The AD8232 sensor offers high-quality ECG signal acquisition, while machine learning enables accurate classification of arrhythmias. The methodology involves for detecting cardiac arrhythmia includes data acquisition, preprocessing, feature extraction, and training of machine learning models. Performance evaluation using metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score confirms the system's effectiveness. The developed system provides a non-invasive and cost-effective solution for continuous monitoring and early detection of cardiac abnormalities, facilitating timely interventions and personalized treatment plans. This paper contributes to improved patient care and diagnostic accuracy in cardiac arrhythmia detection. Analysis of different machine learning algorithm like random forest, logistic Regression, and Gaussian NB are compared by calculating accuracy. Random forest algorithm gives the better accuracy of 92.59.these machine learning model effectively identifies the normal and abnormal ECG pattern for Cardiac Arrhythmia Detection.

articleTitle: Research on Path Planning Method of Dual Robot Based on kmeans-GA Algorithm
abstract: At present, the research on the path planning of dual robot welding mainly focuses on the path length, while the research on the welding time is less. To solve this problem, a path planning method based on kmeans clustering algorithm and genetic algorithm is proposed in this paper. The objective function of path planning is constructed by moving time and welding time during robot welding. Firstly, the algorithm is improved based on the clustering algorithm and solder joint time, and the balanced distribution of solder joint position and time is realized. Then, the running trajectory of a single robot is planned by GA(genetic algorithm). The simulation experiment of a car door panel welding shows that the path planning method in this paper can effectively reduce the working time of dual robot welding and achieve the purpose of optimal welding time.

articleTitle: Enhancing Robustness of Time Series Predictions with Deep Learning Techniques
abstract: The use of deep studying techniques for making time collection predictions has multiplied whole, because of the truth that these techniques have proven to have excellent effects on obligations, which include type, object detection, and herbal language processing. This paper looks at how deep mastering methods can enhance the robustness and accuracy of time collection predictions. The authors explore various processes using extended short-term reminiscence networks, characteristic engineering, and switch learning to make more correct and robust predictions. They also examine the consequences of including noise in the dataset and combining deep getting to know architectures with different devicegaining knowledge of algorithms. Effects show that the deep getting-to-know techniques can lessen prediction mistakes, even if the facts are noisy or incomplete while outperforming conventional strategies. In conclusion, the authors indicate that those deeply gaining systems knowledge can make more fantastic and accurate time collection predictions.

articleTitle: Development of Polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) Functionalized MWCNT Based Flexible Pressure Sensors for Tactile Sensing
abstract: Through this work, polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) functionalized multiwall carbon nanotubes (fMWCNT) flexible tactile sensors, referred as PDMS-fMWCNT have been explored. These sensor elements are designed to further assist a robotic arm to carry out basic activities such as object gripping and slip detection, which would be armed further with sensor arrays, electronic interface and machine-learning algorithms. The response of PDMS-f-MWCNT is compared to the basic PDMS, and the composite shows better response with higher resolution when measuring change in resistance. Structural characterization shows active hydroxyl groups for f-MWCNTs. With changing percentage of MWCNT (1% to 5%), the percolation threshold was achieved at 2%, which showed the optimized piezoresistive response where the maximum change in resistance was 2.79 MΩ. The sensor with 4% doping showed the optimal linear behavior among all sensors with different doping concentrations. The sensor shows good response time (0.36 s) and recovery time (0.24 s) for 5 rad/s of impact frequency. All the sensors had 2mm * 2mm * 4mm dimensions and were highly porous. The fine interplay between the MWCNT percentage, the basic sample resistivity and the sample recovery resulting in the pressure-handing capacity of the samples show that the optimized sample could work as an excellent tactile sensor for multiple applications ranging from robotic industry to healthcare gadgets.

articleTitle: Enhanced Learning Mechanisms for Extracting Relevant Information with Advanced Neural Networks
abstract: Recent advances in synthetic intelligence (AI) technologies, including deep learning, have generated a hobby in growing advanced neural networks for extracting relevant facts from big unstructured datasets. In this painting, we recommend numerous enhanced modern mechanisms to improve the accuracy and speed of the latest information extraction from textual content analytics programs. In particular, we explore the usage of transfer today's semi supervised latest and reinforcement learning tactics to allow the powerful use of brand new categorized and unlabeled education statistics. We propose architectures for combining multiple neural networks and evaluate their performance on various responsibilities. Experimental results on a selection of contemporary benchmark datasets show that our cutting-edge techniques outperform strategies on duties such as text category, sentiment evaluation, and natural language understanding. The proposed more advantageous modern mechanisms may have several potential applications in finance, healthcare, and criminal investigation. Our proposed strategies can be relevant to various AI obligations and represent a critical step in cutting-edge green and correct information extraction from unstructured statistics.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of FinFET Based Ternary Multiplexer
abstract: Multivalue logics have emerged as a considerable advancement in the field of digital electronics, providing solutions to the limitations imposed by binary logic. Ternary logic is considered an innovative tactic within the field of multivalue logic. In this article, an energy efficient ternary multiplexer is designed using standard voltage threshold (SVT) 18nm FinFET model in Virtuoso tool provided by Cadence and its performance is compared with the existing CMOS design. The simulation results obtained shows power consumption as 39.76 μW, transient delay as 0.34ns and power delay product as 13.51 (x 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-15</sup> J) for FinFET based design. The designed ternary multiplexer architecture is beneficial for applications where high speed signal routing is required.

articleTitle: Temporal Patterns and Seasonal Effects in Wind Power Forecasting: A Time Series Analysis
abstract: Harvesting renewable power from Wind and connecting the same to traditional grid system becomes more common in a microgrid architecture. As the traditional power and grid uses a day ahead forecasting for DISCOMS operation, there is a requirement for forecasting these renewable sources before connecting it to the grid. As an intermittent source of energy, it is difficult to predict the power extraction from these sources. The present tariff rate for per unit of electricity may not be applicable to this type of energy i.e., renewable energy particularly wind power. In the presented paper an attempt has been made to extract and predict the wind power and subsequent evaluation of tariff rate based on multi object optimization. A MATLAB model has been used evaluate the performance and tariff rate.

articleTitle: Exploration of Data Analysis in Teaching-Learning Model using R
abstract: Outcome-based learning has become one of the most vital components in the teaching-learning process. It helps students become better at the disciplines they have chosen. Outcomes are a crucial part of faculty and students' comprehension of the purpose and goal of a curriculum or academic program. They are essential in the creation of a program and its curriculum, helping students to learn knowledge and skills. In this paper effectiveness is evaluated using samples of learners from the tertiary level. The efficacy of internet education and learning results during the COVID-19 pandemic are the main topics of the current research. The Covid-19 epidemic in several parts of the world in 2020 has had a negative impact on educational institutions in many different nations. Learners, willingness to participate in a combination of courses as well as their inability to comprehend their fascination in online programmes had been both enhanced. Finding out whether students met the course's learning objectives is the study's main objective. The study's goal is to evaluate the efficiency of both online and traditional classroom education. The study also seeks to identify how instructors teach their online as well as offline classes within scheduled subject hours. Further study using a range of samples is required. Nonetheless, the method used here, included the number of hours spent, availability of technology, time management, availability of internet etc. The primary goal of selecting this discipline aims to see whether individuals are able to acquire information effectively within classes taken online.

articleTitle: The Performance Analysis of Distributed Denial of Service Attacks in Wireless Networks
abstract: Complete studies paper that examines the outcomes that malicious 0.33-celebration actors will have on Wi-Fi networks via dispensed denial of carrier (DDoS) attacks. This paper explores the available numerous assault models and the potential countermeasures that may be applied if you want to mitigate the damage due to such assaults. In addition, this paper focuses on the capability blessings related to deploying preventative measures to lessen the impact of such assaults. Moreover, the paper investigates existing attack trends. It affords an outline of the safety techniques to be had for limiting the harm caused by DDoS attacks in wireless networks. By comparing and analyzing the performance of diverse protection mechanisms, this paper offers an evidenceprimarily based evaluation of the effectiveness of DDoS attack safety answers. ultimately, this paper concludes with the aid of supplying recommended measures for strengthening and ensuring the safety of Wi-Fi networks against malicious actors.

articleTitle: Hypothesis Testing of Gaussian Naïve Bayes Classifier for Liver Disease Classification
abstract: Liver classification often involves the systematic categorization of liver problems or illnesses, taking into account diverse aspects including aetiology, severity, histological characteristics, and clinical manifestations. In the context of scientific inquiry, liver classification pertains to the systematic grouping of liver tissues or disorders according to diverse criteria, with the aim of investigating and comprehending problems associated with the liver. The prevalence of liver disease among patients has shown a steady increase due to excessive alcohol use, exposure to hazardous gases, consumption of contaminated foods such as pickles and cucumbers, and availability of drugs in developing nations. In an effort to assist the pool of experts, this dataset was used to evaluate forecasting systems. Numerous approaches and tactics have been developed via extensive study to facilitate the detection of liver problems. The advancement of various processes and approaches aimed at aiding doctors in the accurate and expeditious diagnosis of liver problems has mostly emerged from research pertaining to the detection of hepatic ailments. The use of this intervention has resulted in enhanced patient outcomes and a better quality of life for individuals. The Gaussian Naive Bayes classifier proposed in this work demonstrates strong performance on the given dataset. Additionally, the findings are presented using scatter plots and joint points, which are essential methodologies in the field of machine learning.

articleTitle: Simulation of DNTT/Pentacene-Based Field Effect Transistor (OFET) and Optimization
abstract: This paper explains the behavior of Bottom Gate Top Contact Organic Field Effect Transistor (OFET) utilizing different materials gold (Au), Aluminum (Al), and Copper Cu as the source and drain electrodes and Al, ITO (Indium Tin Oxide), and highly doped Si as gate electrodes. In addition to electrode materials, here also focused on Pentacene and DNTT(Dinaphthothienothiophene) as semiconductor layers. Our results demonstrate the importance of proper device design, and material selection for achieving high-performance OFETs. Here the resultant shows the use of different sourcedrain electrodes showing similar VGS ID characteristics but the gate electrode affects the device characteristics. The highly doped Si gate electrode is showing improvement in device performance over the other two gate electrodes. We also observed the effect of organic materials on device performance. The DNTT-based device shows high carrier mobility over the Pentacene. Moreover, the effect of thickness is also covered in this manuscript by selecting pentacene as a semiconducting material and observing the small variation in the graph by considering the thickness of 20 to 50 nm with 10 nm increments. The insights gained from this study contribute to the advancement of OFET technology and provide a foundation for further research in organic electronics.

articleTitle: Metamaterial Inspired Multiband Antenna Using SRR
abstract: This article presents metamaterial inspired Multiband Antenna consisting of six split rings. The proposed antenna is 40x40x0.8 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> CPW-fed multiband antenna operating at seven resonances within the frequency range of 112 GHz. The advantages of reduced dispersion and uniplanar design are used to adopt the CPW feeding approach. Miniaturization and multiband are achieved using the suggested SRR configuration. In this work, SRR is a six-time repetitive representation of the ring structure that uses 0.5mm wider rings. The antenna is implemented on a low cost FR4 substrate and is measured using anechoic chamber. The measured performance parameters of the designed antenna are in close proximity of the simulated ones.

articleTitle: Group Activity Recognition in Visual Data Using Deep Learning Framework
abstract: Group activity recognition, a subset of humanactivity recognition, has garnered significant research focus due to its crucial role in comprehending videos. Particularly, group activity recognition (GAR) involves identifying activities performed by a collective of individuals. The primary hurdle in this domain lies in grasping the interplay amongst a group within a scene and how it evolves over time. GAR aims to identify the overall activity of a group, holding substantial potential across applications like sports/surveillance video analysis, social activity comprehension, and video search and retrieval. Effectively comprehending scenes with multiple individuals demands a model that not only characterizes each actor's individual actions in context but also deduces their collective activities. While tackling a video clip, this challenge entails not only recognizing individual actions but also uncovering scene information and the collaborative dynamics among people. Recent advancements have witnessed the emergence of deep network-based techniques and graphical models for addressing group activity recognition. The present study critically evaluates state-of-the-art (SOTA) techniques in group activity recognition, categorizing existing literature into distinct sub-domains. Furthermore, the paper identifies available datasets and highlights prevailing research challenges within the realm of group activity recognition.

articleTitle: Enhancing Speech Emotion Recognition Through Multimodal Fusion and Advanced Feature Extraction Techniques
abstract: Accurate emotion recognition is crucial for enabling computers and intelligent systems to respond emotionally to stimuli. In this study, we implement emotion recognition by leveraging convolutional neural networks (CNNs) within a deep learning framework. Specifically, we adapt an image processing CNN architecture, implemented in Python using the Keras model-level library with the TensorFlow backend. We present a condensed discussion of the theoretical foundation underlying the classification of emotions based on voice parameters. Our findings reveal that our model achieves an average accuracy of 68% in identifying eight distinct emotions: happiness, fear, sadness, neutrality, anger, surprise, and disgust. This performance aligns with the stateof-the-art reported in the scientific literature. Notable contributions of this study include the adaptation of a deep learning model for audio file processing, CNN training using English language recordings, and the development of an experimental software environment for generating test files.

articleTitle: A HealthCare System for the prediction of Brain Tumor Segmentation using Ridgelet Transform and Co-Active Adaptive Neuro Fuzzy Expert System
abstract: Brain Tumor is considered as one of the deadly disease. Its early diagnose can diminish its chances of the disease developing to more severe level. In this proposed work a Smart Healthcare system was developed for the prediction of Brain Tumor segmentation by using Ridgelet Transform and (CANFES) Co-Active Adaptive Neuro Fuzzy Expert System. The tumor segmentation results was obtained using proposed methodology with the different parameters such as Sensitivity, Specificity, Precision, Kappa, Accuracy, False Positive Rate, False Negative Rate, and Hausdroff Distance. Hence the results of proposed CANFES method was compared with other proposed methodologies By successfully applying this CANFES method, an accuracy value of around 97%, specificity of 97.67%, specification of 96%, precision value of 97.85%, FPR value of around 96.19, FNR value of 96.29%, K and HD values of 0.851 and 16.67% respectively was obtained. The resultant of the comparison values shows that the proposed CANFES method shows better results as compared to other conventional methods.

articleTitle: Detection of Mental Stress Levels Using Electroencephalogram Signals(EEG)
abstract: Neuroimaging techniques alongside machine learning algorithms made a huge impact in the medical field. People spend most of their time at work, where they frequently face heavy workloads and time constraints, increasing stress levels. Therefore, a reliable method of stress level evaluation may be crucial for therapeutic intervention and disease prevention. Whereas many neuroimaging methods have been proposed to solely identify mental stress. The use of electroencephalographic (EEG) signals could increase the rate at which mental stress is detected and properly measure stress levels. We use EEG features using the SVM algorithm to improve accuracy and deliver accurate stress levels, which will aid in illness prevention. While traditional self-report measures of stress can be subjective and prone to bias, EEG-based detection of mental stress offers an objective and non-invasive method for quantifying stress levels. In this study, we develop and evaluate a machine learning-based system for the detection of mental stress using EEG signals. We collected EEG data from a group of participants while they performed cognitive tasks designed to induce mental stress. Our results demonstrate that the SVM-based system can accurately detect mental stress levels with an overall classification accuracy. These findings have important implications for stress management interventions, including healthcare, workplace, and education settings, where the detection of mental stress using EEG signals can be applied to improve overall well-being.

articleTitle: An IoT-Enabled Tractor Data Sensing System for Precision Agriculture
abstract: Precision agriculture is an emerging field that aims to optimize agricultural operations by utilizing advanced technologies and data-driven approaches. Precision agriculture relies on data collection and analysis from the field using various sensors and devices. In this paper, we propose and implement an IoT-enabled data sensing system for tractors. This system can be envisaged as having four levels: data collection level, communication level, cloud database and analysis level, and visualization level. The system was deployed on a tractor to collect and analyze data from the field using simple and inexpensive sensors. Using a custom-built web application, the system is able to display performance data of the tractor and its associated agricultural machinery. The performance of the system is assessed by field experiments. The findings indicate that the implementation of the system has the potential to enhance the efficiency and operational capabilities of tractor and agricultural machinery within the context of Precision Agriculture. This technology has the potential to improve the efficiency, and sustainability of agricultural operations.

articleTitle: Image Talk: A Model for Image Caption Generation with Voice
abstract: The automatic creation of written descriptions from photographs represents a crucial point of interaction between computer vision and Natural Language Processing (NLP) in the field of artificial intelligence (AI). This research paper presents an innovative approach to image caption generation employing a hybrid neural architecture that amalgamates Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. This novel methodology pushes the boundaries of image captioning techniques by incorporating cutting-edge techniques like Word2Vec embedding, ensuring the representation of semantic relationships between words in the generated captions. By leveraging the Xception model for robust feature extraction, this study advances the current state-of-the-art in image captioning methodologies. To quantify the efficacy of the proposed approach, comprehensive evaluations are conducted across diverse datasets including MS-COCO. These evaluations encompass rigorous assessment of both the accuracy of the generated captions in depicting the visual context and the fluency of the language employed. Performance metrics including BLEU (Bilingual Evaluation Understudy), METEOR, CIDER and ROUGE are utilized to quantitatively gauge the quality of the generated captions. The integration of a Text-to-Speech (TTS) feature for image captions is an additional enhancement to the proposed model.

articleTitle: A Data-Driven Approach to Forecast Engine Torque of an Agricultural Tractor Across Varied Operational Range Using Machine Learning
abstract: Machine learning has repeatedly found its way into the realm of agricultural applications due to its advantages over traditional frameworks. Their capacity for prediction and forecasting through parallel reasoning stands as their primary strength. This research endeavour aimed to establish a predictive model for engine torque for M-575 tractor across diverse operating conditions. A total of 6 machine-learning models were developed for tractor engine torque prediction, and the Extreme Gradient Boosting Regressor was selected as the emerging optimal choice for machine-learning-based predictive model development. The performance of the developed model was calculated based on the evaluation metrics like the coefficient of determination (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) and mean squared error. Notably, an R2 value of 0.997 for training and 0.971 for testing datasets was achieved, accompanied by a mean squared error of 0.0009 for training and 0.0074 for testing datasets. The findings indicated a direct relationship between engine torque and engine speed under different load and throttle settings. The developed ML algorithm exhibited the ability to accurately forecast engine torque within the given power range, accounting for varying load and throttle configurations (100% and 50%), with a significant level of precision (MAPE = 3.45%). Model validation involved comparing the predicted and actual engine torque data of a specific tractor model, M-575, subjected to testing at FMTTI India.

articleTitle: An Exploration of the Effectiveness of Machine Learning Algorithms for Text Classification
abstract: This paper seeks to discover the effectiveness of various devices in gaining knowledge of algorithms for textual content types. Text class is a vital challenge in natural language processing as it has a selection of packages, from sentiment evaluation to record categorization. Exclusive algorithms were applied to the challenge, including help Vector Machines, Naive Bayes, and okay-nearest Neighbor. The paper will evaluate the overall performance of these algorithms on a dataset composed of textual content documents for one-of-akind category responsibilities. The consequences of the experiments will provide insights into how nicely each algorithm plays and any practical implications of using them for text categories. Furthermore, the paper will discuss the demanding situations and barriers to using these algorithms for text classes. Subsequently, viable guidelines for destiny research could be mentioned.

articleTitle: Music Recommendation System Using Machine Learning
abstract: This research paper is about a music recommendation system that uses machine learning algorithms and binary text classification, we looked at the performance of models and the results which we achieved are: By the Naïve Bayes Classification achieved an accuracy of 75.01%, with the XG Boost Classification we got an accuracy of 100%, going forward Logistic Regression got an accuracy of 78.6%, LGBM Classification we got an accuracy of 100%, Random Forest Classification attain an accuracy of 100<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, By Artificial Neural Network (ANN) an accuracy of 80% got yielded, K-Nearest Neighbors Classification (KNN) we got an accuracy of 96%, Gradient Boost Classification yielded an accuracy of 95.1%, AdaBoost Classification we got an accuracy of 90.04%, and Decision Tree Classification yielded an accuracy of 99.5%. Planning an Integration of personal listening data with public Spotify Dataset for music popularity based on artist and track names, we removed a few to improve the quality of the data by removing less frequently played songs (personal dataset) and compared the remaining songs with the Spotify Features dataset. To use binary classification, we have created a new column of popularity. This column indicates matches with values of 1 and non-matches with values of 0. We then trained and tested the binary text classification using this column. Results show that this method is effective for predicting popularity of song with high accuracy rate. However, we also admit that the generalizability of the model to other Spotify users is limited as the dataset is small and suggest further research to address this issue. Overall, this study provides insights into the possibilities of machine learning algorithms for music recommendations settings depending on the user.
